> **Trust.**  This catalog lists *what* is proven; how much each
> proof still leans on unproved facts is the companion ledger
> [`PROOF-DEBT.md`](PROOF-DEBT.md).  In short: a proof's *bill*
> is the set of `asserted` facts it rests on; an empty bill prints
> `proven modulo 0` (unconditional relative to the kernel -- the
> strongest report), and a non-empty bill carries a `[trust: K]`
> tier equal to its **weakest** leaf's warrant, where `none`
> (a leaf with no warrant at all) is weakest and `proof` strongest.
> The ledger heads with the full glossary and tier table.

- `agree-sym` — forall([l, l2, i], length(l2) = length(l) implies forall([mrj_ in nn], 1 <= mrj_ implies mrj_ <= length(l) implies not(mrj_ = i) implies nth(mrj_, l2) = nth(mrj_, l)) implies forall([mrj_ in nn], 1 <= mrj_ implies mrj_ <= length(l2) implies not(mrj_ = i) implies nth(mrj_, l) = nth(mrj_, l2)))
- `aif-coefficient-bound` — forall([u, c, r, phi, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies c in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies forall([aix_ in u], r <= magnitude(aix_ - c)) implies phi in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([aim_ in rr], forall([aiy_ in trace(pgam, a, b)], magnitude(phi(aiy_)) <= aim_) implies forall([k in nn], magnitude(line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(k)), pgam, dgam, a, b)) <= road-length(dgam, a, b) * (aim_ * recip(r) ^ succ(k)))))

- `aif-cont-const` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([aik_ in cc, h in fun(u, cc)], forall([aix_ in u], h(aix_) == aik_) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, rgy_))))

- `aif-cont-product` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([f, g, h], f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies g in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), g, rgy_)) implies h in fun(u, cc) implies forall([aix_ in u], h(aix_) == f(aix_) * g(aix_)) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, rgy_))))
- `aif-cont-recip-shift` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([c in cc], forall([aix_ in u], not(aix_ = c)) implies forall([h in fun(u, cc)], forall([aix_ in u], h(aix_) == recip(aix_ - c)) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, rgy_)))))

- `aif-cont-shift` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([c in cc, h in fun(u, cc)], forall([aix_ in u], h(aix_) == aix_ - c) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, rgy_))))

- `aif-geometric-partial` — forall([n in nn, aip_, aisv_, aiqv_, aie_], aip_ in cc implies aisv_ in cc implies aiqv_ in cc implies aie_ in cc implies aie_ * (1 - aiqv_ * aisv_) = aisv_ implies cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(aij_, nn, (aip_ * aisv_ ^ succ(aij_)) * aiqv_ ^ aij_), n) = aip_ * aie_ - (aip_ * (aiqv_ * aisv_) ^ n) * aie_)
- `aif-geometric-relation` — forall([w in cc, c in cc, z in cc], not(w = c) implies not(w = z) implies recip(w - z) * (1 - (z - c) * recip(w - c)) = recip(w - c))
- `aif-geometric-remainder` — forall([c in cc, r in rr], 0 < r implies forall([w in cc], r <= magnitude(w - c) implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies forall([aip_ in cc, aim_ in rr], magnitude(aip_) <= aim_ implies forall([k in nn], magnitude(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(aij_, nn, (aip_ * recip(w - c) ^ succ(aij_)) * (z - c) ^ aij_), k) - aip_ * recip(w - z)) in rr and magnitude(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(aij_, nn, (aip_ * recip(w - c) ^ succ(aij_)) * (z - c) ^ aij_), k) - aip_ * recip(w - z)) <= (aim_ * (magnitude(z - c) * recip(r)) ^ k) * recip(r - magnitude(z - c)))))))

- `aif-partial-integrals` — forall([k in nn, u, c, r, phi, pgam, dgam, a, b, z], u subset cc implies c in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies forall([aix_ in u], r <= magnitude(aix_ - c)) implies phi in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies z in cc implies magnitude(z - c) < r implies vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(aij_, nn, (phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(aij_)) * (z - c) ^ aij_), k)) in fun(u, cc) and forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(aij_, nn, (phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(aij_)) * (z - c) ^ aij_), k)), rgy_)) and line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(aij_, nn, (phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(aij_)) * (z - c) ^ aij_), k)), pgam, dgam, a, b) = cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(aitk_, nn, line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(aitk_)), pgam, dgam, a, b) * (z - c) ^ aitk_), k))

- `aif-trace-bounded` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([phi in fun(u, cc)], forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, rgy_)) implies forall([pgam, a, b], is-path(pgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forsome([aim_ in rr], 0 <= aim_ and forall([aiy_ in trace(pgam, a, b)], magnitude(phi(aiy_)) <= aim_)))))

- `amgm-2-sqrt` — forall([a], a in rr and 0 <= a implies forall([b], b in rr and 0 <= b implies sqrt(a * b) <= (/)(a + b, 2)))
- `analytic-at-from-integral-formula` — forall([u, c, r, phi, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies c in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies forall([aix_ in u], r <= magnitude(aix_ - c)) implies phi in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([kap in cc, aiou_], is-open(cc-ms, aiou_) implies ball(cc-ms, c, r) subset aiou_ implies forall([f in fun(aiou_, cc)], forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies f(z) = kap * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - z)), pgam, dgam, a, b)) implies is-analytic-at(f, aiou_, c))))
- `analytic-at-intro` — forall([algf_, algu_], algf_ in fun(algu_, cc) implies forall([algc_ in fun(nn, cc), alga_ in cc, algr_ in rr], 0 < algr_ implies algr_ < cps-radius(algc_) implies ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_) subset algu_ implies forall([algz_ in ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_)], algf_(algz_) = cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, algc_(cpsk_) * (algz_ - alga_) ^ cpsk_))) implies is-open(cc-ms, algu_) implies is-analytic-at(algf_, algu_, alga_)))

- `analytic-from-integral-formula` — forall([u, c, r, phi, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies c in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies forall([aix_ in u], r <= magnitude(aix_ - c)) implies phi in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([kap in cc, f], forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies f(z) = kap * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - z)), pgam, dgam, a, b)) implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies cc-series-converges-to(vnb-lambda(aitk_, nn, (kap * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(aitk_)), pgam, dgam, a, b)) * (z - c) ^ aitk_), f(z)))))
- `analytic-holomorphic-ball` — forall([algf_, algu_, alga_], is-analytic-at(algf_, algu_, alga_) implies forsome([algr_ in rr], 0 < algr_ and ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_) subset algu_ and holomorphic-on(ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_), restrict(algf_, ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_)))))

- `analytic-zeros-finite-in-ball` — forall([u], is-open(cc-ms, u) implies is-connected(cc-ms, u) implies forall([f in fun(u, cc)], forall([acnb_ in u], is-analytic-at(f, u, acnb_)) implies forsome([acne_ in u], not(f(acne_) = 0)) implies forall([acnc_ in cc, acnr_ in rr], closed-ball(cc-ms, acnc_, acnr_) subset u implies card({acnz_ in closed-ball(cc-ms, acnc_, acnr_): f(acnz_) = 0}) in nn)))

- `antiderivable-affine-subst` — forall([phi, ck, lam, p_, q_, aa, bb], phi in fun(rr, rr) implies ck in rr implies lam in rr implies not(lam = 0) implies p_ in rr implies q_ in rr implies p_ < q_ implies is-antiderivable(phi, aa, bb) implies forall([t_ in ccint(p_, q_)], ck + lam * t_ in ccint(aa, bb)) implies forall([t_], t_ in rr and p_ < t_ and t_ < q_ implies aa < ck + lam * t_ and ck + lam * t_ < bb) implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, phi(ck + lam * x)), p_, q_))
- `antiderivable-affine-subst-pos` — forall([phi, ck, lam, p_, q_], phi in fun(rr, rr) implies ck in rr implies lam in rr implies 0 < lam implies p_ in rr implies q_ in rr implies p_ < q_ implies is-antiderivable(phi, ck + lam * p_, ck + lam * q_) implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, phi(ck + lam * x)), p_, q_))

- `antiderivable-scale` — forall([c, phi, a, b], c in rr implies is-antiderivable(phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, c * phi(x)), a, b))
- `antiderivable-sub` — forall([phi, psi, a, b], is-antiderivable(phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivable(psi, a, b) implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, phi(x) - psi(x)), a, b))
- `antiderivable-subinterval` — forall([phi, a, b, lo, hi], is-antiderivable(phi, a, b) implies lo in rr implies hi in rr implies a <= lo implies lo < hi implies hi <= b implies is-antiderivable(phi, lo, hi))
- `antiderivable-uniform-limit` — forall([phifam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr)), psi in fun(rr, rr), a in rr, b in rr], forall([k_ in nn], is-antiderivable(phifam(k_), a, b)) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n_ in nn], forall([k_ in nn], n_ <= k_ implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs(psi(x_) - (phifam(k_))(x_)) <= eps)))) implies is-antiderivable(psi, a, b))
- `antiderivative-add` — forall([f, g, phi, psi, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(g, psi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(vnb-lambda(x, rr, f(x) + g(x)), vnb-lambda(x, rr, phi(x) + psi(x)), a, b))
- `antiderivative-differ-by-constant` — forall([f, g, phi, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(g, phi, a, b) implies forsome([cst_ in rr], forall([s_ in ccint(a, b)], f(s_) = g(s_) + cst_)))
- `antiderivative-endpoint-difference` — forall([f, g, phi, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(g, phi, a, b) implies f(b) - f(a) = g(b) - g(a))
- `antiderivative-endpoints` — forall([f, phi, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies a in rr and b in rr and a < b)
- `antiderivative-family-uniform-limit` — forall([fam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr)), phifam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr)), psi in fun(rr, rr), a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([k_ in nn], is-antiderivative(fam(k_), phifam(k_), a, b) and (fam(k_))(a) = 0) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n_ in nn], forall([k_ in nn], n_ <= k_ implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs(psi(x_) - (phifam(k_))(x_)) <= eps)))) implies forsome([f in fun(rr, rr)], is-antiderivative(f, psi, a, b) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n_ in nn], forall([k_ in nn], n_ <= k_ implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs(f(x_) - (fam(k_))(x_)) <= eps))))))
- `antiderivative-fn-in-fun` — forall([f, phi, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies phi in fun(rr, rr))
- `antiderivative-increment-bound` — forall([h in fun(rr, rr), phi in fun(rr, rr), a in rr, b in rr, m_ in rr], is-antiderivative(h, phi, a, b) implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs(phi(x_)) <= m_) implies forall([u in rr, v in rr], u in ccint(a, b) implies v in ccint(a, b) implies u < v implies abs(h(v) - h(u)) <= m_ * (v - u)))
- `antiderivative-integrand-transfer` — forall([f, phi, psi, a, b], psi in fun(rr, rr) implies is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies forall([x_ in rr], psi(x_) == phi(x_)) implies is-antiderivative(f, psi, a, b))
- `antiderivative-lipschitz` — forall([h in fun(rr, rr), phi in fun(rr, rr), a in rr, b in rr, m_ in rr], is-antiderivative(h, phi, a, b) implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs(phi(x_)) <= m_) implies forall([u in rr, v in rr], u in ccint(a, b) implies v in ccint(a, b) implies abs(h(v) - h(u)) <= m_ * abs(v - u)))
- `antiderivative-map-in-fun` — forall([f, phi, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies f in fun(rr, rr))
- `antiderivative-pair-close` — forall([f in fun(rr, rr), g in fun(rr, rr), phi in fun(rr, rr), psi in fun(rr, rr), a in rr, b in rr, m_ in rr], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(g, psi, a, b) implies f(a) = g(a) implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs(phi(x_) - psi(x_)) <= m_) implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs(f(x_) - g(x_)) <= m_ * (b - a)))
- `antiderivative-scale` — forall([c, f, phi, a, b], c in rr implies is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(vnb-lambda(x, rr, c * f(x)), vnb-lambda(x, rr, c * phi(x)), a, b))
- `antiderivative-shift-const` — forall([f, phi, a, b, c], f in fun(rr, rr) implies phi in fun(rr, rr) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies c in rr implies is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(vnb-lambda(x_, rr, f(x_) - c), phi, a, b))
- `antiderivative-sub` — forall([f, g, phi, psi, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(g, psi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(vnb-lambda(x, rr, f(x) - g(x)), vnb-lambda(x, rr, phi(x) - psi(x)), a, b))
- `antiderivative-subinterval` — forall([f, phi, a, b, lo, hi], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies lo in rr implies hi in rr implies a <= lo implies lo < hi implies hi <= b implies is-antiderivative(f, phi, lo, hi))
- `antiderivative-transfer-ptwise-eq` — forall([f in fun(rr, rr), psi in fun(rr, rr), g, phi, a, b], is-antiderivative(g, phi, a, b) implies forall([x_ in rr], f(x_) = g(x_)) implies forall([x_ in rr], psi(x_) = phi(x_)) implies is-antiderivative(f, psi, a, b))
- `apply-congruence-1` — forall([f, g], f == g implies forall([u], f(u) == g(u)))
- `apply-congruence-2` — forall([f, g], f == g implies forall([u, v], f(u, v) == g(u, v)))
- `ascoli-arzela-sequential` — forall([s, fam], is-compact(s) implies forsome([x], x in pts(s)) implies fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), rr)) implies forall([k in nn], is-continuous(s, rr-ms, fam(k))) implies is-equicontinuous(s, rr-ms, fam) implies pointwise-bounded(s, fam) implies forsome([del], strictly-mono-nn(del) and forsome([g in fun(pts(s), rr)], is-continuous(s, rr-ms, g) and converges-uniformly(s, subseq(fam, del), g))))
- `ascoli-dense-bridge` — forall([s, fam], is-compact(s) implies fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), rr)) implies forall([k in nn], is-continuous(s, rr-ms, fam(k))) implies is-equicontinuous(s, rr-ms, fam) implies forsome([dseq], is-dense-seq(s, dseq) and converges-on(s, fam, dseq)) implies forsome([g in fun(pts(s), rr)], is-continuous(s, rr-ms, g) and converges-uniformly(s, fam, g)))
- `ascoli-pointwise-diagonal` — forall([s, fam], pointwise-bounded(s, fam) implies forall([dseq], is-dense-seq(s, dseq) implies forsome([del], strictly-mono-nn(del) and converges-on(s, subseq(fam, del), dseq))))
- `ascoli-sequential-from-diagonal` — forall([s, fam], is-compact(s) implies forsome([x], x in pts(s)) implies fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), rr)) implies forall([k in nn], is-continuous(s, rr-ms, fam(k))) implies is-equicontinuous(s, rr-ms, fam) implies pointwise-bounded(s, fam) implies forall([dseq], is-dense-seq(s, dseq) implies forsome([del], strictly-mono-nn(del) and converges-on(s, subseq(fam, del), dseq))) implies forsome([del], strictly-mono-nn(del) and forsome([g in fun(pts(s), rr)], is-continuous(s, rr-ms, g) and converges-uniformly(s, subseq(fam, del), g))))
- `baire-category` — forall([s], is-complete(s) implies forsome([x], x in pts(s)) implies is-nonmeager(s, pts(s)))
- `ball-2r-triangle` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([x in pts(s), r], r in rr and 0 <= r and not(0 = r) implies forall([y in ball(s, x, r), z in ball(s, x, r)], (dist(s))(y, z) <= r + r and not((dist(s))(y, z) = r + r))))
- `ball-center-in` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([x in pts(s), r], r in rr and 0 <= r and not(0 = r) implies x in ball(s, x, r)))
- `ball-cover-is-open-cover` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([r], r in rr and 0 <= r and not(0 = r) implies is-open-cover(s, ball-cover(s, r))))
- `ball-cover-mem-fwd` — forall([s, r, u in ball-cover(s, r)], forsome([c in pts(s)], ball(s, c, r) = u))
- `ball-cover-unfold` — forall([s, r], ball-cover(s, r) == image(vnb-lambda(c, pts(s), ball(s, c, r)), pts(s)))
- `ball-in-closed-ball` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([c, r], ball(s, c, r) subset closed-ball(s, c, r)))
- `ball-is-open` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([x in pts(s), r], r in rr and 0 <= r and not(0 = r) implies is-open(s, ball(s, x, r))))
- `ball-is-set` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([x, r], ball(s, x, r) in set))
- `ball-mem-from-le` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([x in pts(s), y, d, r], y in pts(s) and d in rr and r in rr and (dist(s))(x, y) <= d and d < r implies y in ball(s, x, r)))
- `ball-membership` — forall([s, x, r, y], y in ball(s, x, r) iff y in pts(s) and (dist(s))(x, y) <= r and not((dist(s))(x, y) = r))
- `ball-point-le` — forall([s, c, r, w, p in w], ball(s, c, r) = w implies (dist(s))(c, p) <= r)
- `ball-point-ne` — forall([s, c, r, w, p in w], ball(s, c, r) = w implies not((dist(s))(c, p) = r))
- `ball-sep-unfold` — forall([s, c, r], ball(s, c, r) == {y in pts(s): (dist(s))(c, y) <= r and not((dist(s))(c, y) = r)})
- `bary-in-conv3` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc, goux_ in cc], 0 <= real-part(goux_) implies 0 <= imag-part(goux_) implies real-part(goux_) + imag-part(goux_) <= 1 implies (real-part(goux_) * goua_ + imag-part(goux_) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(goux_) - imag-part(goux_)) * gouc_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_))
- `bary-lip` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc, goux_ in cc, gouy_ in cc], magnitude((real-part(goux_) * goua_ + imag-part(goux_) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(goux_) - imag-part(goux_)) * gouc_ - ((real-part(gouy_) * goua_ + imag-part(gouy_) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(gouy_) - imag-part(gouy_)) * gouc_)) <= (magnitude(goua_ - gouc_) + magnitude(goub_ - gouc_)) * magnitude(goux_ - gouy_))
- `bary-mid` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc, goux_ in cc, gouy_ in cc], (real-part(cc-mid(goux_, gouy_)) * goua_ + imag-part(cc-mid(goux_, gouy_)) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(cc-mid(goux_, gouy_)) - imag-part(cc-mid(goux_, gouy_))) * gouc_ = cc-mid((real-part(goux_) * goua_ + imag-part(goux_) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(goux_) - imag-part(goux_)) * gouc_, (real-part(gouy_) * goua_ + imag-part(gouy_) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(gouy_) - imag-part(gouy_)) * gouc_))
- `bary-side-near` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc, goup_ in cc, gouq_ in cc, goux_ in cc, gouw_ in cc, gour_ in rr, goum_ in rr], magnitude(goup_ - goux_) <= gour_ implies magnitude(gouq_ - goup_) <= gour_ implies gour_ <= 6 * goum_ implies magnitude(goux_ - gouw_) <= 12 * goum_ implies forall([gouz_ in trace(seg-path((real-part(goup_) * goua_ + imag-part(goup_) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(goup_) - imag-part(goup_)) * gouc_, (real-part(gouq_) * goua_ + imag-part(gouq_) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(gouq_) - imag-part(gouq_)) * gouc_), 0, 1)], magnitude(gouz_ - ((real-part(gouw_) * goua_ + imag-part(gouw_) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(gouw_) - imag-part(gouw_)) * gouc_)) <= (24 * (magnitude(goua_ - gouc_) + magnitude(goub_ - gouc_))) * goum_))
- `bary-vertices` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc], (real-part(1) * goua_ + imag-part(1) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(1) - imag-part(1)) * gouc_ = goua_ and (real-part(1i) * goua_ + imag-part(1i) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(1i) - imag-part(1i)) * gouc_ = goub_ and (real-part(0) * goua_ + imag-part(0) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(0) - imag-part(0)) * gouc_ = gouc_)
- `bdd-fn-le-arg` — forall([t in rr], 0 <= t implies (/)(t, 1 + t) <= t)
- `bdd-fn-lt-one` — forall([t in rr], 0 <= t implies (/)(t, 1 + t) < 1)
- `bdd-fn-mono` — forall([s in rr, t in rr], 0 <= s and s <= t implies (/)(s, 1 + s) <= (/)(t, 1 + t))
- `bdd-fn-nonneg` — forall([t in rr], 0 <= t implies 0 <= (/)(t, 1 + t))
- `bdd-fn-reflect` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], 0 <= a implies 0 <= b implies (/)(a, 1 + a) <= (/)(b, 1 + b) implies a <= b)
- `bdd-fn-subadd` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], 0 <= a and 0 <= b implies (/)(a + b, 1 + (a + b)) <= (/)(a, 1 + a) + (/)(b, 1 + b))
- `bdd-fn-zero` — forall([t in rr], 0 <= t implies t = 0 implies (/)(t, 1 + t) = 0)
- `bdd-fn-zero-eq` — forall([t in rr], 0 <= t implies (/)(t, 1 + t) = 0 implies t = 0)
- `bdd-linfun-abs-real` — forall([m, f, x], is-bounded-linear-functional(m, f) implies x in vec(m) implies abs(f(x)) in rr)
- `bdd-metric-bounded` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([x in pts(s), y in pts(s)], (dist(bdd-metric(s)))(x, y) < 1))
- `bdd-metric-carrier` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies pts(bdd-metric(s)) == pts(s))
- `bdd-metric-converges-bwd` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([f in fun(nn, pts(s)), lm_ in pts(s)], converges-to(bdd-metric(s), f, lm_) implies converges-to(s, f, lm_)))
- `bdd-metric-converges-fwd` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([f in fun(nn, pts(s)), lm_ in pts(s)], converges-to(s, f, lm_) implies converges-to(bdd-metric(s), f, lm_)))
- `bdd-metric-converges-iff` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([f in fun(nn, pts(s)), lm_ in pts(s)], converges-to(bdd-metric(s), f, lm_) iff converges-to(s, f, lm_)))
- `bdd-metric-dist-le` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([x_ in pts(s), y_ in pts(s)], (dist(bdd-metric(s)))(x_, y_) <= (dist(s))(x_, y_)))
- `bdd-metric-dist-reflect` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([x_ in pts(s), y_ in pts(s), e_ in rr], 0 <= e_ implies (dist(bdd-metric(s)))(x_, y_) <= (/)(e_, 1 + e_) implies (dist(s))(x_, y_) <= e_))
- `bdd-metric-distance` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([x in pts(s), y in pts(s)], (dist(bdd-metric(s)))(x, y) = (/)((dist(s))(x, y), 1 + (dist(s))(x, y))))
- `bdd-metric-id-bicontinuous` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies is-continuous(s, bdd-metric(s), vnb-lambda(x, pts(s), x)) and is-continuous(bdd-metric(s), s, vnb-lambda(x, pts(bdd-metric(s)), x)))
- `bdd-metric-is-bounded-metric-space` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies is-bounded-metric-space(bdd-metric(s)))
- `bdd-metric-is-metric-space` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies is-metric-space(bdd-metric(s)))
- `bdd-metric-open-bwd` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([uu], is-open(bdd-metric(s), uu) implies is-open(s, uu)))
- `bdd-metric-open-fwd` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([uu], is-open(s, uu) implies is-open(bdd-metric(s), uu)))
- `bdd-metric-preserves-metric-top` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies metric-top(bdd-metric(s)) == metric-top(s))
- `bdd-metric-weight-bound` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([u_ in pts(s), v_ in pts(s), wn in rr], 0 <= wn implies wn * (dist(bdd-metric(s)))(u_, v_) in rr and 0 <= wn * (dist(bdd-metric(s)))(u_, v_) and wn * (dist(bdd-metric(s)))(u_, v_) <= wn))
- `bdd-rr-equivalent` — is-continuous(rr-ms, bdd-metric(rr-ms), vnb-lambda(x, rr, x)) and is-continuous(bdd-metric(rr-ms), rr-ms, vnb-lambda(x, rr, x))
- `bdd-rr-ms-bounded` — forall([x in rr, y in rr], (dist(bdd-metric(rr-ms)))(x, y) < 1)
- `bdd-rr-ms-is-metric-space` — is-metric-space(bdd-metric(rr-ms))
- `bernoulli-rpow` — forall([x], x in rr and 0 < 1 + x implies forall([b], b in qq and 1 <= b implies 1 + b * x <= rpow(1 + x, b)))
- `bernoulli-rpow-star` — forall([x], x in rr and 0 < 1 + x implies forall([b], b in rr and 1 <= b implies 1 + b * x <= rpow-star(1 + x, b)))
- `bernstein-approx-bound` — forall([f_, n_, x_, hh_, delta_, mm_, cc_], f_ in fun(rr, rr) implies n_ in nn implies not(n_ = 0) implies x_ in ccint(0, 1) implies hh_ in rr implies 0 < hh_ implies delta_ in rr implies 0 < delta_ implies mm_ in rr implies 0 <= mm_ implies cc_ in rr implies 0 <= cc_ implies (n_ * n_) * ((delta_ * delta_) * cc_) = mm_ + mm_ implies cc_ * n_ <= hh_ implies forall([p_ in ccint(0, 1), q_ in ccint(0, 1)], abs(p_ - q_) <= delta_ implies abs(f_(p_) - f_(q_)) <= hh_) implies forall([z_ in ccint(0, 1)], abs(f_(z_)) <= mm_) implies abs(f_(x_) - bernstein-poly(f_, n_, x_)) <= hh_ + hh_)
- `bernstein-basis-above` — forall([n_, x_, k_], n_ in nn implies x_ in rr implies k_ in zz implies n_ < k_ implies (bernstein-basis(n_, x_))(k_) = 0)
- `bernstein-basis-antiderivable` — forall([n_, k_, a, b], n_ in nn implies k_ in nn implies a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, (bernstein-basis(n_, x))(k_)), a, b))
- `bernstein-basis-degree-zero-diag` — forall([x_, k_], x_ in rr implies k_ in nn implies k_ = 0 implies (bernstein-basis(0, x_))(k_) = 1)
- `bernstein-basis-degree-zero-off` — forall([x_, k_], x_ in rr implies k_ in nn implies not(k_ = 0) implies (bernstein-basis(0, x_))(k_) = 0)
- `bernstein-basis-in-fun` — forall([n_ in nn, x_ in rr], bernstein-basis(n_, x_) in fun(zz, rr))
- `bernstein-basis-nonneg` — forall([n_ in nn, x_, k_], x_ in rr implies 0 <= x_ implies x_ <= 1 implies k_ in nn implies 0 <= (bernstein-basis(n_, x_))(k_))
- `bernstein-basis-null` — forall([n_, x_, k_], n_ in nn implies x_ in rr implies k_ in zz implies k_ < 0 implies (bernstein-basis(n_, x_))(k_) = 0)
- `bernstein-basis-ptwise-in-rr` — forall([n_, x_, k_], n_ in nn implies x_ in rr implies k_ in zz implies (bernstein-basis(n_, x_))(k_) in rr)
- `bernstein-basis-scaled-antiderivable` — forall([c, n_, k_, a, b], c in rr implies n_ in nn implies k_ in nn implies a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, c * (bernstein-basis(n_, x))(k_)), a, b))
- `bernstein-basis-succ` — forall([n_, x_, k_], n_ in nn implies x_ in rr implies k_ in nn implies (bernstein-basis(succ(n_), x_))(k_) = x_ * (bernstein-basis(n_, x_))(k_ - 1) + (1 - x_) * (bernstein-basis(n_, x_))(k_))
- `bernstein-basis-unfold` — forall([n_, x_], bernstein-basis(n_, x_) == comb-kk(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field), x_, 1 - x_, n_))
- `bernstein-ccint-approximant-antiderivable` — forall([f, n_, a, b], f in fun(rr, rr) implies n_ in nn implies not(n_ = 0) implies a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, bernstein-poly(compose(f, vnb-lambda(x_, rr, a + (b - a) * x_)), n_, (x - a) * recip(b - a))), a, b))
- `bernstein-moment-1` — forall([n_ in nn, x_, h_], x_ in rr implies forall([k_ in nn], h_(k_) = k_ * (bernstein-basis(n_, x_))(k_)) implies series-partial-sum(h_, succ(n_)) = n_ * x_)

- `c-int-defined-for-continuous` — forall([f, a, b], f in fun(rr, rr) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a < b implies forall([x_ in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x_)) implies c-int(f, a, b) in rr)

- `c-int-or-value` — forall([f, phi, p, q, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, p, q) implies a in ccint(p, q) implies b in ccint(p, q) implies c-int-or(phi, a, b) = f(b) - f(a))

- `c-int-scale-continuous` — forall([c, phi, a, b], c in rr implies phi in fun(rr, rr) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a < b implies forall([x_ in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, phi, x_)) implies c-int(vnb-lambda(x, rr, c * phi(x)), a, b) = c * c-int(phi, a, b))

- `c-metric-summable` — forall([s], is-c-metric-space(s) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([u_, v_], u_ in pts(s) implies v_ in pts(s) implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(k, nn, w(k) * min(1, ((dists(s))(k))(u_, v_)))))))
- `c-metric-term-bound` — forall([s], is-c-metric-space(s) implies forall([k_, u_, v_, wk], k_ in nn implies u_ in pts(s) implies v_ in pts(s) implies wk in rr implies 0 <= wk implies wk * min(1, ((dists(s))(k_))(u_, v_)) in rr and 0 <= wk * min(1, ((dists(s))(k_))(u_, v_)) and wk * min(1, ((dists(s))(k_))(u_, v_)) <= wk))

- `caratheodory-remainder-small` — forall([gbs_, gbf_, gba_, gbl_], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, gbs_, gbf_, gba_, gbl_) implies forall([gbe_], pos-rr(gbe_) implies forsome([gbr_], pos-rr(gbr_) and forall([gbz_ in gbs_], magnitude(gbz_ - gba_) < gbr_ implies magnitude(gbf_(gbz_) - (gbf_(gba_) + gbl_ * (gbz_ - gba_))) <= gbe_ * magnitude(gbz_ - gba_)))))

- `caratheodory-witness-bound` — forall([h in fun(rr, rr), phi in fun(rr, rr), psi in fun(rr, rr), a in rr, b in rr, t_ in rr, m_ in rr], is-antiderivative(h, phi, a, b) implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs(phi(x_)) <= m_) implies t_ in ccint(a, b) implies psi(t_) = phi(t_) implies forall([x_ in rr], h(x_) - h(t_) = psi(x_) * (x_ - t_)) implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs(psi(x_)) <= m_))

- `cauchy-convex-segments` — forall([u, f], is-convex-cc(u) implies holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([goua_ in u, goub_ in u, gouc_ in u], seg-int(f, goua_, gouc_) = seg-int(f, goua_, goub_) + seg-int(f, goub_, gouc_)))
- `cauchy-convex-segments-except` — forall([u, f, goxx_], is-convex-cc(u) implies is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies goxx_ in u implies holomorphic-on(difference(u, singleton(goxx_)), restrict(f, difference(u, singleton(goxx_)))) implies forall([goxa_ in u, goxb_ in u, goxc_ in u], seg-int(f, goxa_, goxc_) = seg-int(f, goxa_, goxb_) + seg-int(f, goxb_, goxc_)))
- `cauchy-convex-segments-of-triangles` — forall([u, f], is-convex-cc(u) implies is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([mrta_ in u, mrtb_ in u, mrtc_ in u], conv3(mrta_, mrtb_, mrtc_) subset u implies tri-int(f, mrta_, mrtb_, mrtc_) = 0) implies forall([mrra_ in u, mrrb_ in u, mrrc_ in u], seg-int(f, mrra_, mrrc_) = seg-int(f, mrra_, mrrb_) + seg-int(f, mrrb_, mrrc_)))
- `cauchy-convex-sub` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([wnv_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), wnv_) implies is-convex-cc(wnv_) implies wnv_ subset u implies forall([pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset wnv_ implies pgam(b) = pgam(a) implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = 0)))
- `cauchy-convex-sub-except` — forall([u, f, cifx_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies cifx_ in u implies holomorphic-on(difference(u, singleton(cifx_)), restrict(f, difference(u, singleton(cifx_)))) implies forall([cifv_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), cifv_) implies is-convex-cc(cifv_) implies cifv_ subset u implies forall([pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset cifv_ implies pgam(b) = pgam(a) implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = 0)))
- `cauchy-criterion-left` — forall([f, x], f in fun(rr, rr) implies x in rr implies forall([eps_], pos-rr(eps_) implies forsome([delta_], pos-rr(delta_) and forall([s_, t_], s_ in rr and x - delta_ <= s_ and s_ < x implies t_ in rr and x - delta_ <= t_ and t_ < x implies abs(f(s_) - f(t_)) <= eps_))) implies forsome([l_], is-left-limit(f, x, l_)))
- `cauchy-criterion-right` — forall([f, x], f in fun(rr, rr) implies x in rr implies forall([eps_], pos-rr(eps_) implies forsome([delta_], pos-rr(delta_) and forall([s_, t_], s_ in rr and x < s_ and s_ <= x + delta_ implies t_ in rr and x < t_ and t_ <= x + delta_ implies abs(f(s_) - f(t_)) <= eps_))) implies forsome([l_], is-right-limit(f, x, l_)))
- `cauchy-derivative-formula` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([cierho_ in rr], 0 < cierho_ implies cierho_ < r implies forall([k in nn], (nth-deriv-on(cc-normed-field, ball(cc-ms, c, cierho_), restrict(f, ball(cc-ms, c, cierho_)), k))(c) = factorial(k) * (recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi), (restrict(f, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(k)), circle-path(c, r), circle-deriv(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))))))
- `cauchy-disc` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, r in rr], 0 < r implies ball(cc-ms, c, r) subset u implies forall([pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset ball(cc-ms, c, r) implies pgam(b) = pgam(a) implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = 0)))
- `cauchy-disc-except` — forall([u, f, cifx_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies cifx_ in u implies holomorphic-on(difference(u, singleton(cifx_)), restrict(f, difference(u, singleton(cifx_)))) implies forall([c in cc, r in rr], 0 < r implies ball(cc-ms, c, r) subset u implies forall([pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset ball(cc-ms, c, r) implies pgam(b) = pgam(a) implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = 0)))
- `cauchy-estimate-center` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([ciebd_ in rr], forall([ciey_ in trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)], magnitude(f(ciey_)) <= ciebd_) implies magnitude(f(c)) <= ciebd_))))
- `cauchy-estimate-circle` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([ciebd_ in rr], forall([ciey_ in trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)], magnitude(f(ciey_)) <= ciebd_) implies forall([k in nn], magnitude(recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi), (restrict(f, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(k)), circle-path(c, r), circle-deriv(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)) <= ciebd_ * recip(r) ^ k)))))
- `cauchy-estimate-derivative` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([cierho_ in rr], 0 < cierho_ implies cierho_ < r implies forall([ciebd_ in rr], forall([ciey_ in trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)], magnitude(f(ciey_)) <= ciebd_) implies forall([k in nn], magnitude((nth-deriv-on(cc-normed-field, ball(cc-ms, c, cierho_), restrict(f, ball(cc-ms, c, cierho_)), k))(c)) <= factorial(k) * (ciebd_ * recip(r) ^ k)))))))
- `cauchy-estimate-from-formula` — forall([u, c, r, phi, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies c in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies forall([aix_ in u], r <= magnitude(aix_ - c)) implies phi in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([aim_ in rr], forall([aiy_ in trace(pgam, a, b)], magnitude(phi(aiy_)) <= aim_) implies forall([kap in cc, k in nn], magnitude(kap * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(k)), pgam, dgam, a, b)) <= magnitude(kap) * (road-length(dgam, a, b) * (aim_ * recip(r) ^ succ(k))))))
- `cauchy-integral-formula-centre` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, r in rr], 0 < r implies forall([cmvbr_ in rr], r < cmvbr_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cmvbr_) subset u implies f(c) = recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(cmvw_, difference(u, singleton(c)), f(cmvw_) * recip(cmvw_ - c)), circle-path(c, r), circle-deriv(c, r), 0, 2 * pi))))
- `cauchy-integral-formula-disc` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies f(z) = recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(cifw_, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi), f(cifw_) * recip(cifw_ - z)), circle-path(c, r), circle-deriv(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))))
- `cauchy-integral-formula-disc-restrict` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies f(z) = recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi), (restrict(f, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - z)), circle-path(c, r), circle-deriv(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))))
- `cauchy-kernel-constant-magnitude` — magnitude(recip((2 * pi) * 1i)) = recip(2 * pi)
- `cauchy-kernel-integral-series` — forall([u, c, r, phi, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies c in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies forall([aix_ in u], r <= magnitude(aix_ - c)) implies phi in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies cc-series-converges-to(vnb-lambda(aitk_, nn, line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(aitk_)), pgam, dgam, a, b) * (z - c) ^ aitk_), line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - z)), pgam, dgam, a, b))))
- `cauchy-kernel-series-absolute` — forall([u, c, r, phi, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies c in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies forall([aix_ in u], r <= magnitude(aix_ - c)) implies phi in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(aitk_, nn, magnitude(line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(aitk_)), pgam, dgam, a, b) * (z - c) ^ aitk_)))))
- `cauchy-rapid-subsequence` — forall([s, f, rad], is-cauchy-seq(s, f) and rad in fun(nn, rr) and forall([k in nn], pos-rr(rad(k))) implies forsome([phi in fun(nn, nn)], forall([m in nn, n_ in nn], m < n_ implies phi(m) < phi(n_)) and forall([k in nn], (dist(s))(f(phi(k)), f(phi(succ(k)))) <= rad(k))))
- `cauchy-schwarz-finite` — forall([s], s in set and card(s) in nn implies forall([a in fun(s, rr), b in fun(s, rr)], finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, a(i) * b(i)), s) * finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, a(i) * b(i)), s) <= finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, a(i) * a(i)), s) * finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, b(i) * b(i)), s)))
- `cauchy-schwarz-sqrt` — forall([s], s in set and card(s) in nn implies forall([a in fun(s, rr), b in fun(s, rr)], abs(finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, a(i) * b(i)), s)) <= sqrt(finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, a(i) * a(i)), s)) * sqrt(finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, b(i) * b(i)), s))))
- `cauchy-seq-is-fun` — forall([s, f], is-cauchy-seq(s, f) implies f in fun(nn, pts(s)))
- `cauchy-setoid-is-setoid` — forall([m], is-metric-space(m) implies is-setoid(cauchy-setoid(m)))
- `cc-abs-im-le-magnitude` — forall([z_ in cc], abs(imag-part(z_)) <= magnitude(z_))
- `cc-abs-re-le-magnitude` — forall([z_ in cc], abs(real-part(z_)) <= magnitude(z_))
- `cc-additive-ag-iden` — iden(normed-field-additive-ag(cc-normed-field)) == 0
- `cc-additive-ag-opr` — opr(normed-field-additive-ag(cc-normed-field)) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(cc, cc), x_ + y_)
- `cc-affinely-independent` — forall([goxa_ in cc, goxb_ in cc, goxc_ in cc], not(imag-part((goxb_ - goxa_) * conjugate(goxc_ - goxa_)) = 0) implies forall([goxp_ in rr, goxq_ in rr], goxp_ * (goxb_ - goxa_) + goxq_ * (goxc_ - goxa_) = 0 implies goxp_ = 0 and goxq_ = 0))
- `cc-ball-is-convex` — forall([c in cc, r in rr], is-convex-cc(ball(cc-ms, c, r)))
- `cc-bolzano-weierstrass` — forall([h in fun(nn, cc), bd in rr], forall([i in nn], magnitude(h(i)) <= bd) implies forsome([phi], strictly-mono-nn(phi) and forsome([l in cc], converges-to(cc-ms, subseq(h, phi), l))))
- `cc-cauchy-of-dominated` — forall([f in fun(nn, cc), p in fun(nn, rr)], is-cauchy-seq(cc-ms, f) implies forall([m_ in nn, n_ in nn], abs(p(m_) - p(n_)) <= magnitude(f(m_) - f(n_))) implies is-cauchy-seq(rr-ms, p))
- `cc-circle-arg` — forall([cxsa_ in rr, cxsb_ in rr], cxsa_ ^ 2 + cxsb_ ^ 2 = 1 implies forsome([cxsth_ in rr], -pi <= cxsth_ and cxsth_ < pi and cc-cos(cxsth_) = cxsa_ and cc-sin(cxsth_) = cxsb_))
- `cc-closed-ball-compact` — forall([wcvc_ in cc, wcvr_ in rr], is-compact(subspace-ms(cc-ms, closed-ball(cc-ms, wcvc_, wcvr_))))
- `cc-closed-ball-mem` — forall([wcvc_ in cc, wcvr_, wcvz_ in closed-ball(cc-ms, wcvc_, wcvr_)], wcvz_ in cc and magnitude(wcvz_ - wcvc_) <= wcvr_)
- `cc-closed-ball-mem-intro` — forall([wcvc_ in cc, wcvr_, wcvz_ in cc], magnitude(wcvz_ - wcvc_) <= wcvr_ implies wcvz_ in closed-ball(cc-ms, wcvc_, wcvr_))
- `cc-closed-ball-origin` — forall([cpsrad_, cpsz_ in closed-ball(cc-ms, 0, cpsrad_)], cpsz_ in cc and magnitude(cpsz_) <= cpsrad_)
- `cc-complete` — is-complete(cc-ms)
- `cc-compose-continuous-at` — forall([s, u, g, phi, x], is-metric-space(s) implies u subset cc implies is-continuous-at(s, cc-ms, g, x) implies forall([msy_ in pts(s)], g(msy_) in u) implies is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, g(x)) implies is-continuous-at(s, cc-ms, vnb-lambda(msz_, pts(s), phi(g(msz_))), x))
- `cc-conjugate-neg` — forall([a in cc], conjugate(-a) = -conjugate(a))
- `cc-conjugate-power` — forall([cexk_ in nn, cexz_ in cc], conjugate(cexz_ ^ cexk_) = conjugate(cexz_) ^ cexk_)
- `cc-conjugate-sub` — forall([cexa_ in cc, cexb_ in cc], conjugate(cexa_ - cexb_) = conjugate(cexa_) - conjugate(cexb_))
- `cc-cont-fns-add` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([a in cc-cont-fns(u), b in cc-cont-fns(u)], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, a(cfz_) + b(cfz_)) in cc-cont-fns(u)))
- `cc-cont-fns-add-neg` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([a in cc-cont-fns(u), b in cc-cont-fns(u)], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, a(cfz_) + -b(cfz_)) in cc-cont-fns(u)))
- `cc-cont-fns-diff` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([a in cc-cont-fns(u), b in cc-cont-fns(u)], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, a(cfz_) - b(cfz_)) in cc-cont-fns(u)))
- `cc-cont-fns-frechet` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies is-frechet-structure(cc-normed-field, cc-fn-module(u, cc-cont-fns(u)), cc-exhaust-seminorms(u, cc-cont-fns(u))))
- `cc-cont-fns-fun` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([a in cc-cont-fns(u)], a in fun(u, cc)))
- `cc-cont-fns-is-set` — forall([u], u subset cc implies cc-cont-fns(u) in set)
- `cc-cont-fns-membership` — forall([u, h], h in cc-cont-fns(u) iff h in fun(u, cc) and forall([ccy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, ccy_)))
- `cc-cont-fns-neg` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([a in cc-cont-fns(u)], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, -a(cfz_)) in cc-cont-fns(u)))
- `cc-cont-fns-scale` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([c in cc, a in cc-cont-fns(u)], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, c * a(cfz_)) in cc-cont-fns(u)))
- `cc-cont-fns-unfold` — forall([u], cc-cont-fns(u) == {ccf_ in fun(u, cc): forall([ccy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), ccf_, ccy_))})
- `cc-cont-fns-zero` — forall([u], u subset cc implies vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, 0) in cc-cont-fns(u))
- `cc-continuous-at-add-const` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([f in fun(u, cc), goxg_ in fun(u, cc), goxk_ in cc], forall([goxz_ in u], goxg_(goxz_) == f(goxz_) + goxk_) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), goxg_, rgy_))))
- `cc-continuous-at-iff-coords` — forall([s, f, fr, fi, a], is-metric-space(s) implies f in fun(pts(s), cc) implies fr in fun(pts(s), rr) implies fi in fun(pts(s), rr) implies a in pts(s) implies forall([u_ in pts(s)], real-part(f(u_)) = fr(u_)) implies forall([u_ in pts(s)], imag-part(f(u_)) = fi(u_)) implies is-continuous-at(s, cc-ms, f, a) iff is-continuous-at(s, rr-ms, fr, a) and is-continuous-at(s, rr-ms, fi, a))
- `cc-continuous-at-local` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([h in fun(u, cc), cmvv_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), cmvv_) implies cmvv_ subset u implies forall([cmvw_ in cmvv_], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), cmvv_), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), restrict(h, cmvv_), cmvw_) implies is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, cmvw_))))
- `cc-continuous-bounded-on-exhaust` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([f in fun(u, cc)], forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([n in nn], forsome([bm in rr], 0 <= bm and forall([z in cc-exhaust(u, n)], magnitude(f(z)) <= bm)))))
- `cc-continuous-restrict-rr` — forall([cekff_, cekgg_, cekx_], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), cc), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), cekff_, cekx_) implies cekgg_ in fun(rr, rr) implies cekx_ in rr implies forall([cekv_ in rr], cekgg_(cekv_) = cekff_(cekv_)) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, cekgg_, cekx_))
- `cc-converges-iff-coords` — forall([f in fun(nn, cc), g in fun(nn, rr), q_ in fun(nn, rr), lv in cc], forall([n_ in nn], real-part(f(n_)) = g(n_)) implies forall([n_ in nn], imag-part(f(n_)) = q_(n_)) implies converges-to(cc-ms, f, lv) iff converges-to(rr-ms, g, real-part(lv)) and converges-to(rr-ms, q_, imag-part(lv)))
- `cc-converges-magnitude-null` — forall([s_ in fun(nn, cc), lv in cc, m in fun(nn, rr)], converges-to(cc-ms, s_, lv) implies forall([j_ in nn], m(j_) = magnitude(s_(j_) - lv)) implies converges-to(rr-ms, m, 0))
- `cc-converges-of-coords` — forall([f in fun(nn, cc), g in fun(nn, rr), q_ in fun(nn, rr), lv in cc], forall([n_ in nn], real-part(f(n_)) = g(n_)) implies forall([n_ in nn], imag-part(f(n_)) = q_(n_)) implies converges-to(rr-ms, g, real-part(lv)) implies converges-to(rr-ms, q_, imag-part(lv)) implies converges-to(cc-ms, f, lv))
- `cc-coords-add` — forall([z in cc, w in cc], cc-coords(z + w) = [real-part(z) + real-part(w), imag-part(z) + imag-part(w)])
- `cc-coords-apply` — forall([z in cc], cc-coords(z) == [real-part(z), imag-part(z)])
- `cc-coords-in-fun` — cc-coords in fun(cc, cartesian(rr, rr))
- `cc-coords-is-bijection` — cc-coords in bijection(cc, cartesian(rr, rr))
- `cc-coords-of-converges` — forall([f in fun(nn, cc), g in fun(nn, rr), q_ in fun(nn, rr), lv in cc], forall([n_ in nn], real-part(f(n_)) = g(n_)) implies forall([n_ in nn], imag-part(f(n_)) = q_(n_)) implies converges-to(cc-ms, f, lv) implies converges-to(rr-ms, g, real-part(lv)) and converges-to(rr-ms, q_, imag-part(lv)))
- `cc-coords-of-pair` — forall([pr_ in cartesian(rr, rr)], cc-coords(cc-of-pair(pr_)) = pr_)
- `cc-coords-real-mul` — forall([c_ in rr, z in cc], cc-coords(c_ * z) = [c_ * real-part(z), c_ * imag-part(z)])
- `cc-cos-add` — forall([cexz_ in cc, cexw_ in cc], cc-cos(cexz_ + cexw_) = cc-cos(cexz_) * cc-cos(cexw_) - cc-sin(cexz_) * cc-sin(cexw_))
- `cc-cos-as-power-series` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc)], forall([cek_ in nn], cf(cek_) = num(-1) ^ cek_ * recip(factorial(2 * cek_))) implies forall([cexz_ in cc], cc-series-converges(vnb-lambda(cek_, nn, (num(-1) ^ cek_ * recip(factorial(2 * cek_))) * cexz_ ^ (2 * cek_))) and cc-cos(cexz_) = cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, cf(cpsk_) * (cexz_ ^ 2) ^ cpsk_))))
- `cc-cos-converges` — forall([cexz_ in cc], cc-series-converges(vnb-lambda(cek_, nn, (num(-1) ^ cek_ * recip(factorial(2 * cek_))) * cexz_ ^ (2 * cek_))) and cc-cos(cexz_) in cc)
- `cc-cos-deriv` — forall([cexz_ in cc], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, cc, vnb-lambda(cexy_, cc, cc-cos(cexy_)), cexz_, -cc-sin(cexz_)))
- `cc-cos-even` — forall([cexz_ in cc], cc-cos(-cexz_) = cc-cos(cexz_))
- `cc-cos-exp` — forall([cexz_ in cc], cc-cos(cexz_) = (cc-exp(1i * cexz_) + cc-exp(-(1i * cexz_))) * recip(2))
- `cc-cos-half-pi` — cc-cos(num(1/2) * pi) = 0
- `cc-cos-has-zero` — forsome([cekt_ in rr], 0 < cekt_ and cekt_ < 2 and cc-cos(cekt_) = 0)
- `cc-cos-holomorphic` — holomorphic-on(cc, vnb-lambda(cexy_, cc, cc-cos(cexy_)))
- `cc-cos-least-zero` — forall([clht_ in rr], 0 < clht_ implies clht_ < num(1/2) * pi implies not(cc-cos(clht_) = 0))
- `cc-cos-nonpos-far` — forall([clht_ in rr], num(1/2) * pi <= clht_ implies clht_ <= pi implies cc-cos(clht_) <= 0)
- `cc-cos-one-bounds` — num(5/12) <= cc-cos(1) and cc-cos(1) <= num(7/12)
- `cc-cos-pi` — cc-cos(pi) = num(-1)
- `cc-cos-pos-half` — forall([clht_ in rr], -(num(1/2) * pi) < clht_ implies clht_ < num(1/2) * pi implies 0 < cc-cos(clht_))
- `cc-cos-pos-right` — forall([clhs_ in rr], 0 < clhs_ implies clhs_ < num(1/2) * pi implies 0 < cc-cos(clhs_))
- `cc-cos-pos-small` — forall([clht_ in rr], 0 < clht_ implies clht_ < 1 implies 0 < cc-cos(clht_))
- `cc-cos-radius` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc)], forall([cek_ in nn], cf(cek_) = num(-1) ^ cek_ * recip(factorial(2 * cek_))) implies cps-radius(cf) = pos-inf)
- `cc-cos-real-continuous` — vnb-lambda(cekv_, rr, cc-cos(cekv_)) in fun(rr, rr) and forall([cekx_ in rr], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, vnb-lambda(cekv_, rr, cc-cos(cekv_)), cekx_))
- `cc-cos-real-part` — forall([cekt_ in rr], cc-cos(cekt_) = real-part(cc-exp(1i * cekt_)))
- `cc-cos-sin-half-pi` — cc-cos(num(1/2) * pi) = 0 and cc-sin(num(1/2) * pi) ^ 2 = 1
- `cc-cos-sin-one` — forall([cexz_ in cc], cc-cos(cexz_) ^ 2 + cc-sin(cexz_) ^ 2 = 1)
- `cc-cos-sin-pi` — cc-cos(pi) = num(-1) and cc-sin(pi) = 0
- `cc-cos-sin-real` — forall([cekt_ in rr], cc-cos(cekt_) in rr and cc-sin(cekt_) in rr)
- `cc-cos-sin-two-pi` — cc-cos(2 * pi) = 1 and cc-sin(2 * pi) = 0
- `cc-cos-three-halves-pos` — 0 < cc-cos(num(3/2))
- `cc-cos-two-neg` — cc-cos(2) < 0
- `cc-cos-two-pi` — cc-cos(2 * pi) = 1
- `cc-cos-unfold` — forall([cexz_], cc-cos(cexz_) == cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cek_, nn, (num(-1) ^ cek_ * recip(factorial(2 * cek_))) * cexz_ ^ (2 * cek_))))
- `cc-cos-zero` — cc-cos(0) = 1
- `cc-cross-coords` — forall([goxp_ in cc, goxq_ in cc], imag-part(goxp_ * conjugate(goxq_)) = imag-part(goxp_) * real-part(goxq_) - real-part(goxp_) * imag-part(goxq_))
- `cc-deriv-continuous-on-hol` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([s in fun(nn, cc-hol-fns(u)), f in cc-hol-fns(u)], fr-conv(cc-fn-module(u, cc-cont-fns(u)), cc-exhaust-seminorms(u, cc-cont-fns(u)), s, f) implies fr-conv(cc-fn-module(u, cc-cont-fns(u)), cc-exhaust-seminorms(u, cc-cont-fns(u)), vnb-lambda(wcvk_, nn, vnb-lambda(wcvw_, u, deriv-on(cc-normed-field, u, s(wcvk_), wcvw_))), vnb-lambda(wcvw_, u, deriv-on(cc-normed-field, u, f, wcvw_)))))
- `cc-deriv-linear` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([f, g], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies holomorphic-on(u, g) implies forall([lca_ in cc, lcb_ in cc, z in u], deriv-on(cc-normed-field, u, vnb-lambda(cdw_, u, lca_ * f(cdw_) + lcb_ * g(cdw_)), z) = lca_ * deriv-on(cc-normed-field, u, f, z) + lcb_ * deriv-on(cc-normed-field, u, g, z))))
- `cc-deriv-on-of-is-diff-on` — forall([drou_, drof_, droa_, drol_], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, drou_, drof_, droa_, drol_) implies deriv-on(cc-normed-field, drou_, drof_, droa_) = drol_)
- `cc-deriv-seminorm-estimate` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([n in nn, bm in rr], forall([cmy_ in cc-exhaust(u, 4 * n + 3)], magnitude(f(cmy_)) <= bm) implies forall([y in cc-exhaust(u, n)], magnitude(deriv-on(cc-normed-field, u, f, y)) <= bm * (4 * (n + 1))))))
- `cc-derived-series-normally-convergent` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([g in fun(nn, cc-hol-fns(u))], forall([n in nn], is-normally-convergent(g, cc-exhaust(u, n))) implies forall([n in nn], is-normally-convergent(vnb-lambda(cdi_, nn, vnb-lambda(cdz_, u, deriv-on(cc-normed-field, u, g(cdi_), cdz_))), cc-exhaust(u, n)))))
- `cc-diff-at-cc-mul` — forall([cv in cc, g in fun(rr, cc), pd in fun(rr, cc), tv_ in rr, lv in cc], forall([x_ in rr], pd(x_) = cv * g(x_)) implies is-cc-diff-at(g, tv_, lv) implies is-cc-diff-at(pd, tv_, cv * lv))
- `cc-diff-at-chain-real` — forall([g in fun(rr, cc), h in fun(rr, rr), cm in fun(rr, cc), tv_ in rr, kv in rr, lv in cc], forall([x_ in rr], cm(x_) = g(h(x_))) implies is-diff-at(h, tv_, kv) implies is-cc-diff-at(g, h(tv_), lv) implies is-cc-diff-at(cm, tv_, kv * lv))
- `cc-diff-at-const` — forall([cv in cc, g in fun(rr, cc), tv_ in rr], forall([x_ in rr], g(x_) = cv) implies is-cc-diff-at(g, tv_, 0))
- `cc-diff-at-difference` — forall([g in fun(rr, cc), h in fun(rr, cc), sb_ in fun(rr, cc), tv_ in rr, lv in cc, mv in cc], forall([x_ in rr], sb_(x_) = g(x_) - h(x_)) implies is-cc-diff-at(g, tv_, lv) implies is-cc-diff-at(h, tv_, mv) implies is-cc-diff-at(sb_, tv_, lv - mv))
- `cc-diff-at-iff-coords` — forall([g in fun(rr, cc), gr in fun(rr, rr), gi in fun(rr, rr), tv_ in rr, lv in cc], forall([x_ in rr], real-part(g(x_)) = gr(x_)) implies forall([x_ in rr], imag-part(g(x_)) = gi(x_)) implies is-cc-diff-at(g, tv_, lv) iff is-diff-at(gr, tv_, real-part(lv)) and is-diff-at(gi, tv_, imag-part(lv)))
- `cc-diff-at-implies-continuous` — forall([g in fun(rr, cc), tv_ in rr, lv in cc], is-cc-diff-at(g, tv_, lv) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, cc-ms, g, tv_))
- `cc-diff-at-product` — forall([g in fun(rr, cc), h in fun(rr, cc), pr_ in fun(rr, cc), tv_ in rr, lv in cc, mv in cc], forall([x_ in rr], pr_(x_) = g(x_) * h(x_)) implies is-cc-diff-at(g, tv_, lv) implies is-cc-diff-at(h, tv_, mv) implies is-cc-diff-at(pr_, tv_, lv * h(tv_) + g(tv_) * mv))
- `cc-diff-at-real-mul` — forall([c_ in rr, g in fun(rr, cc), pd in fun(rr, cc), tv_ in rr, lv in cc], forall([x_ in rr], pd(x_) = c_ * g(x_)) implies is-cc-diff-at(g, tv_, lv) implies is-cc-diff-at(pd, tv_, c_ * lv))
- `cc-diff-at-sum` — forall([g in fun(rr, cc), h in fun(rr, cc), sm in fun(rr, cc), tv_ in rr, lv in cc, mv in cc], forall([x_ in rr], sm(x_) = g(x_) + h(x_)) implies is-cc-diff-at(g, tv_, lv) implies is-cc-diff-at(h, tv_, mv) implies is-cc-diff-at(sm, tv_, lv + mv))
- `cc-diff-at-unique` — forall([g in fun(rr, cc), tv_ in rr, lv in cc, mv in cc], is-cc-diff-at(g, tv_, lv) implies is-cc-diff-at(g, tv_, mv) implies lv = mv)
- `cc-diff-on-local` — forall([cexu_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), cexu_) implies forall([cexf_ in fun(cexu_, cc), cexv_], cexv_ subset cexu_ implies forall([cexg_, cexa_, cexl_], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, cexv_, cexg_, cexa_, cexl_) implies forall([cexx_ in cexv_], cexf_(cexx_) = cexg_(cexx_)) implies is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, cexu_, cexf_, cexa_, cexl_))))
- `cc-diff-on-local-quadratic` — forall([gdls_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), gdls_) implies forall([gdlf_ in fun(gdls_, cc), gdla_ in gdls_, gdll_ in cc, gdlm_ in rr], 0 <= gdlm_ implies forall([gdlr_], pos-rr(gdlr_) implies forall([gdlx_ in gdls_], magnitude(gdlx_ - gdla_) < gdlr_ implies magnitude(gdlf_(gdlx_) - gdlf_(gdla_) - (gdlx_ - gdla_) * gdll_) <= gdlm_ * (magnitude(gdlx_ - gdla_) * magnitude(gdlx_ - gdla_))) implies is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, gdls_, gdlf_, gdla_, gdll_))))
- `cc-diff-on-of-eps-bound` — forall([goxs_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), goxs_) implies forall([goxg_ in fun(goxs_, cc), goxa_ in goxs_, goxl_ in cc], forall([goxe_], pos-rr(goxe_) implies forsome([goxd_], pos-rr(goxd_) and forall([goxy_ in goxs_], magnitude(goxy_ - goxa_) < goxd_ implies magnitude(goxg_(goxy_) - goxg_(goxa_) - (goxy_ - goxa_) * goxl_) <= goxe_ * magnitude(goxy_ - goxa_)))) implies is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, goxs_, goxg_, goxa_, goxl_)))
- `cc-diff-on-quadratic` — forall([cpds_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), cpds_) implies forall([cpdf_ in fun(cpds_, cc), cpda_ in cpds_, cpdl_ in cc, cpdm_ in rr], 0 <= cpdm_ implies forall([cpdx_ in cpds_], magnitude(cpdf_(cpdx_) - cpdf_(cpda_) - (cpdx_ - cpda_) * cpdl_) <= cpdm_ * (magnitude(cpdx_ - cpda_) * magnitude(cpdx_ - cpda_))) implies is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, cpds_, cpdf_, cpda_, cpdl_)))
- `cc-diff-on-restrict-rr` — forall([cxsf_, cxsg_, cxsa_, cxsl_], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, cc, cxsf_, cxsa_, cxsl_) implies cxsg_ in fun(rr, rr) implies cxsa_ in rr implies cxsl_ in rr implies forall([cxsv_ in rr], cxsg_(cxsv_) = cxsf_(cxsv_)) implies is-diff-at(cxsg_, cxsa_, cxsl_))
- `cc-diff-on-scale` — forall([cexu_, cexf_, cexa_, cexl_], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, cexu_, cexf_, cexa_, cexl_) implies forall([cexc_ in cc], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, cexu_, vnb-lambda(cexy_, cexu_, cexc_ * cexf_(cexy_)), cexa_, cexc_ * cexl_)))
- `cc-dist-le-coords` — forall([z in cc, w in cc], magnitude(z - w) <= abs(real-part(z) - real-part(w)) + abs(imag-part(z) - imag-part(w)))
- `cc-exhaust-ball-inside` — forall([u, n in nn, y in cc-exhaust(u, n)], ball(cc-ms, y, num(1/2) * recip(n + 1)) subset cc-exhaust(u, 4 * n + 3))

- `cc-exhaust-dense-in-u` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([n0 in nn, dsq in fun(nn, fun(nn, cc))], forall([n in nn], is-dense-seq(subspace-ms(cc-ms, cc-exhaust(u, n + n0)), dsq(n))) implies is-dense-seq(subspace-ms(cc-ms, u), vnb-lambda(cdm_, nn, (dsq(nnfst(cdm_)))(nnsnd(cdm_))))))
- `cc-exhaust-dense-seqs` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([p in u], forsome([n0 in nn, dsq in fun(nn, fun(nn, cc))], forall([n in nn], is-dense-seq(subspace-ms(cc-ms, cc-exhaust(u, n + n0)), dsq(n))))))
- `cc-exhaust-exhaustive` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([cmp], cmp subset u implies is-compact(subspace-ms(cc-ms, cmp)) implies forsome([n in nn], cmp subset cc-exhaust(u, n))))
- `cc-exhaust-interior` — forall([u, n in nn], cc-exhaust(u, n) subset interior(cc-ms, cc-exhaust(u, n + 1)))
- `cc-exhaust-limit-in` — forall([u, n in nn, s in fun(nn, cc), l in cc], forall([i in nn], s(i) in cc-exhaust(u, n)) implies converges-to(cc-ms, s, l) implies l in cc-exhaust(u, n))
- `cc-exhaust-membership` — forall([u, n, z], z in cc-exhaust(u, n) iff z in cc and magnitude(z) <= n and ball(cc-ms, z, recip(n + 1)) subset u)

- `cc-exhaust-radius` — forall([n in nn], recip(n + 1) in rr and 0 < recip(n + 1))

- `cc-exhaust-seminorm-homogeneous` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([c in cc, a in cc-cont-fns(u), n in nn], cc-sup-norm(vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, c * a(cfz_)), cc-exhaust(u, n)) = magnitude(c) * cc-sup-norm(a, cc-exhaust(u, n))))
- `cc-exhaust-seminorm-real` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([f in fun(u, cc)], forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([n in nn], cc-sup-norm(f, cc-exhaust(u, n)) in rr and 0 <= cc-sup-norm(f, cc-exhaust(u, n)))))
- `cc-exhaust-seminorm-subadditive` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([a in cc-cont-fns(u), b in cc-cont-fns(u), n in nn], cc-sup-norm(vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, a(cfz_) + b(cfz_)), cc-exhaust(u, n)) <= cc-sup-norm(a, cc-exhaust(u, n)) + cc-sup-norm(b, cc-exhaust(u, n))))
- `cc-exhaust-seminorms-family` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies is-seminorm-family(cc-normed-field, cc-fn-module(u, cc-cont-fns(u)), cc-exhaust-seminorms(u, cc-cont-fns(u))))
- `cc-exhaust-seminorms-separate` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([a in cc-cont-fns(u)], not(a = vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, 0)) implies forsome([k in nn], not(cc-sup-norm(a, cc-exhaust(u, k)) = 0))))
- `cc-exhaust-seminorms-unfold` — forall([u, v], cc-exhaust-seminorms(u, v) == vnb-lambda(cfk_, nn, vnb-lambda(cfa_, v, cc-sup-norm(cfa_, cc-exhaust(u, cfk_)))))
- `cc-exhaust-subset` — forall([u, n in nn], cc-exhaust(u, n) subset u)
- `cc-exhaust-unfold` — forall([u, n], cc-exhaust(u, n) == {cxz_ in cc: magnitude(cxz_) <= n and ball(cc-ms, cxz_, recip(n + 1)) subset u})
- `cc-exhaust-uniform-iff-compacta` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([fam, f], forall([n in nn, eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap_ in nn], forall([k in nn], cap_ <= k implies forall([z in cc-exhaust(u, n)], magnitude((fam(k))(z) - f(z)) <= eps)))) iff unif-on-compacta(u, fam, f)))
- `cc-exp-add` — forall([cexz_ in cc, cexw_ in cc], cc-exp(cexz_ + cexw_) = cc-exp(cexz_) * cc-exp(cexw_))
- `cc-exp-as-power-series` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc)], forall([cek_ in nn], cf(cek_) = recip(factorial(cek_))) implies forall([cexz_ in cc], cc-series-converges(vnb-lambda(cek_, nn, recip(factorial(cek_)) * cexz_ ^ cek_)) and cc-exp(cexz_) = cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, cf(cpsk_) * cexz_ ^ cpsk_))))
- `cc-exp-bijection-open-strip` — vnb-lambda(cxsz_, {cxsq_ in cc: -pi < imag-part(cxsq_) and imag-part(cxsq_) < pi}, cc-exp(cxsz_)) in bijection({cxsq_ in cc: -pi < imag-part(cxsq_) and imag-part(cxsq_) < pi}, {cxsu_ in cc: not(imag-part(cxsu_) = 0 and real-part(cxsu_) <= 0)})
- `cc-exp-bijection-strip` — vnb-lambda(cxsz_, {cxsq_ in cc: -pi <= imag-part(cxsq_) and imag-part(cxsq_) < pi}, cc-exp(cxsz_)) in bijection({cxsq_ in cc: -pi <= imag-part(cxsq_) and imag-part(cxsq_) < pi}, difference(cc, singleton(0)))

- `cc-exp-continuous` — forall([cexz_ in cc], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), cc), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), vnb-lambda(cexy_, cc, cc-exp(cexy_)), cexz_))
- `cc-exp-converges` — forall([cexz_ in cc], cc-series-converges(vnb-lambda(cek_, nn, recip(factorial(cek_)) * cexz_ ^ cek_)) and cc-exp(cexz_) in cc)

- `cc-exp-imaginary-period-exists` — forsome([cekt_ in rr], 0 < cekt_ and cekt_ < 8 and cc-exp(1i * cekt_) = 1)
- `cc-exp-injective-strip` — forall([cekz_ in cc, cekw_ in cc], -pi <= imag-part(cekz_) implies imag-part(cekz_) < pi implies -pi <= imag-part(cekw_) implies imag-part(cekw_) < pi implies cc-exp(cekz_) = cc-exp(cekw_) implies cekz_ = cekw_)
- `cc-exp-kernel-add` — forall([cekz_ in cc, cekw_ in cc], cc-exp(cekz_) = 1 implies cc-exp(cekw_) = 1 implies cc-exp(cekz_ + cekw_) = 1)
- `cc-exp-kernel-discrete` — forall([cekz_ in cc], cc-exp(cekz_) = 1 implies magnitude(cekz_) < num(1/2) implies cekz_ = 0)
- `cc-exp-kernel-generator` — forsome([cekg_ in cc], 0 < imag-part(cekg_) and forall([cekz_ in cc], cc-exp(cekz_) = 1 iff forsome([cekk_ in zz], cekz_ = cekk_ * cekg_)))
- `cc-exp-kernel-generator-unique` — forall([cekg_ in cc], 0 < imag-part(cekg_) implies forall([cekz_ in cc], cc-exp(cekz_) = 1 iff forsome([cekk_ in zz], cekz_ = cekk_ * cekg_)) implies cekg_ = (2 * pi) * 1i)

- `cc-fr-conv-iff-unif-on-compacta` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([s in fun(nn, cc-cont-fns(u)), f in cc-cont-fns(u)], fr-conv(cc-fn-module(u, cc-cont-fns(u)), cc-exhaust-seminorms(u, cc-cont-fns(u)), s, f) iff unif-on-compacta(u, s, f)))

- `cc-int-complex-mul` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([pphi_, pchi_, pcw_ in cc], pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies pchi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pchi_(pay_) == pcw_ * pphi_(pay_)) implies forall([pwf_, paw_], is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies cc-int(pchi_, a, b) = pcw_ * cc-int(pphi_, a, b))))

- `cc-int-real-mul` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([pphi_, pchi_, pcc_ in rr], pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies pchi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pchi_(pay_) == pcc_ * pphi_(pay_)) implies forall([pwf_, paw_], is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies cc-int(pchi_, a, b) = pcc_ * cc-int(pphi_, a, b))))

- `cc-log-mul` — forall([clhu_ in cc], not(imag-part(clhu_) = 0 and real-part(clhu_) <= 0) implies forall([clhv_ in cc], not(imag-part(clhv_) = 0 and real-part(clhv_) <= 0) implies -pi < imag-part(cc-log(clhu_)) + imag-part(cc-log(clhv_)) implies imag-part(cc-log(clhu_)) + imag-part(cc-log(clhv_)) < pi implies cc-log(clhu_ * clhv_) = cc-log(clhu_) + cc-log(clhv_)))

- `cc-nf-zero` — zero(cc-normed-field) == 0
- `cc-nonzero-is-set` — difference(cc, singleton(0)) in set

- `cc-nonzero-open` — is-open(cc-ms, difference(cc, singleton(0)))
- `cc-nonzero-open-nf` — is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), difference(cc, singleton(0)))
- `cc-nonzero-subset` — difference(cc, singleton(0)) subset cc
- `cc-normal-convergence-pointwise` — forall([g, xs], forall([cmi_ in nn, cmy_ in xs], (g(cmi_))(cmy_) in cc) implies is-normally-convergent(g, xs) implies forall([z in xs], cc-series-converges(vnb-lambda(cmi_, nn, (g(cmi_))(z)))))
- `cc-normal-convergence-uniform` — forall([g, xs], forall([cmi_ in nn, cmy_ in xs], (g(cmi_))(cmy_) in cc) implies is-normally-convergent(g, xs) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap in nn], forall([nn_ in nn], cap <= nn_ implies forall([z in xs], magnitude(cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cmi_, nn, (g(cmi_))(z))) - cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(cmi_, nn, (g(cmi_))(z)), nn_)) <= eps)))))
- `cc-of-pair-add` — forall([a1_ in rr, b1_ in rr, a2_ in rr, b2_ in rr], cc-of-pair([a1_ + a2_, b1_ + b2_]) = cc-of-pair([a1_, b1_]) + cc-of-pair([a2_, b2_]))

- `cc-of-pair-in-fun` — cc-of-pair in fun(cartesian(rr, rr), cc)
- `cc-of-pair-is-bijection` — cc-of-pair in bijection(cartesian(rr, rr), cc)

- `cc-open-subset-cc` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies u subset cc)
- `cc-partial-error-limit` — forall([cpdff_ in fun(nn, cc), cpdgg_ in fun(nn, cc), cpdhh_ in fun(nn, cc), cpdw_ in cc], cc-series-converges(cpdff_) implies cc-series-converges(cpdgg_) implies cc-series-converges(cpdhh_) implies converges-to(cc-ms, vnb-lambda(cpdj_, nn, cc-series-partial-sum(cpdff_, succ(cpdj_)) - cc-series-partial-sum(cpdgg_, succ(cpdj_)) - cpdw_ * cc-series-partial-sum(cpdhh_, cpdj_)), cc-series-limit(cpdff_) - cc-series-limit(cpdgg_) - cpdw_ * cc-series-limit(cpdhh_)))
- `cc-partial-sums-diff` — forall([n in nn, u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([g in fun(nn, cc-hol-fns(u)), z in u], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, u, vnb-lambda(cpw_, u, cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(cmi_, nn, (g(cmi_))(cpw_)), n)), z, cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(cdi_, nn, deriv-on(cc-normed-field, u, g(cdi_), z)), n))))
- `cc-parts-bound-of-dist` — forall([wcvc_ in cc, wcvr_ in rr, wcvz_ in cc], magnitude(wcvz_ - wcvc_) <= wcvr_ implies abs(real-part(wcvz_)) <= abs(real-part(wcvc_)) + wcvr_ and abs(imag-part(wcvz_)) <= abs(imag-part(wcvc_)) + wcvr_)
- `cc-pi-exists` — forsome([cekp_ in rr], 0 < cekp_ and forall([cekz_ in cc], cc-exp(cekz_) = 1 iff forsome([cekk_ in zz], cekz_ = cekk_ * ((2 * cekp_) * 1i))))
- `cc-pi-gt-three` — 3 < pi
- `cc-pi-gt-two` — 2 < pi
- `cc-pi-lt-four` — pi < 4

- `cc-plus-conj-is-2re` — forall([z in cc], z + conjugate(z) = 2 * real-part(z))
- `cc-pointwise-diagonal` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([s], forall([k in nn, z in u], (s(k))(z) in cc) implies forall([z in u], forsome([bd in rr], forall([k in nn], magnitude((s(k))(z)) <= bd))) implies forall([dd], is-dense-seq(subspace-ms(cc-ms, u), dd) implies forsome([phi], strictly-mono-nn(phi) and forall([j in nn], forsome([lm in cc], converges-to(cc-ms, vnb-lambda(cmk_, nn, (s(phi(cmk_)))(dd(j))), lm)))))))
- `cc-polar-form` — forall([cxsw_ in cc], not(cxsw_ = 0) implies forsome([cxsr_ in rr, cxsth_ in rr], 0 < cxsr_ and -pi <= cxsth_ and cxsth_ < pi and cxsw_ = cxsr_ * cc-exp(1i * cxsth_)))
- `cc-power-add` — forall([cexn_ in nn, cexm_ in nn, cexz_ in cc], cexz_ ^ (cexm_ + cexn_) = cexz_ ^ cexm_ * cexz_ ^ cexn_)
- `cc-power-diff-bound` — forall([cpdk_ in nn, cpdz_ in cc, cpdu_ in cc, cpdr_ in rr], magnitude(cpdz_) <= cpdr_ implies magnitude(cpdu_) <= cpdr_ implies magnitude(cpdz_ ^ succ(cpdk_) - cpdu_ ^ succ(cpdk_)) <= (succ(cpdk_) * cpdr_ ^ cpdk_) * magnitude(cpdz_ - cpdu_))
- `cc-power-mul` — forall([cexk_ in nn, cexm_ in nn, cexz_ in cc], cexz_ ^ (cexm_ * cexk_) = (cexz_ ^ cexm_) ^ cexk_)
- `cc-power-mul-base` — forall([cexk_ in nn, cexa_ in cc, cexb_ in cc], (cexa_ * cexb_) ^ cexk_ = cexa_ ^ cexk_ * cexb_ ^ cexk_)
- `cc-power-nonzero` — forall([acnn_ in nn, acnt_ in cc], not(acnt_ = 0) implies not(acnt_ ^ acnn_ = 0))
- `cc-product-continuous-at` — forall([s, p, q, x], is-continuous-at(s, cc-ms, p, x) implies is-continuous-at(s, cc-ms, q, x) implies is-continuous-at(s, cc-ms, vnb-lambda(msz_, pts(s), p(msz_) * q(msz_)), x))
- `cc-punctured-membership` — forall([wnz_ in cc, wny_], wny_ in difference(cc, singleton(wnz_)) iff wny_ in cc and not(wny_ = wnz_))
- `cc-punctured-open` — forall([wnz_ in cc], is-open(cc-ms, difference(cc, singleton(wnz_))))
- `cc-re-add` — forall([z in cc, w in cc], real-part(z + w) = real-part(z) + real-part(w))
- `cc-re-dist-le` — forall([z in cc, w in cc], abs(real-part(z) - real-part(w)) <= magnitude(z - w))

- `cc-re-inner-bound` — forall([cqw_ in cc, cqz_ in cc], real-part(cqw_) * real-part(cqz_) + imag-part(cqw_) * imag-part(cqz_) <= magnitude(cqw_) * magnitude(cqz_))
- `cc-re-mul` — forall([z in cc, w in cc], real-part(z * w) = real-part(z) * real-part(w) - imag-part(z) * imag-part(w))

- `cc-re-unif-cauchy-on-compact` — forall([kk], kk subset cc implies is-compact(subspace-ms(cc-ms, kk)) implies forall([dq], is-dense-seq(subspace-ms(cc-ms, kk), dq) implies forall([t], forall([k in nn, z in kk], (t(k))(z) in cc) implies forall([x in kk, eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([del], pos-rr(del) and forall([k in nn, y in kk], magnitude(y - x) < del implies magnitude((t(k))(y) - (t(k))(x)) < eps))) implies forall([j in nn], forsome([lm in rr], converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(cmk_, nn, real-part((t(cmk_))(dq(j)))), lm))) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap in nn], forall([i in nn], cap <= i implies forall([j in nn], cap <= j implies forall([z in kk], abs(real-part((t(i))(z)) - real-part((t(j))(z))) < eps))))))))
- `cc-recip-continuous-at` — forall([cra_ in difference(cc, singleton(0))], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), difference(cc, singleton(0))), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), vnb-lambda(crz_, difference(cc, singleton(0)), recip(crz_)), cra_))
- `cc-recip-diff-on` — forall([cra_ in difference(cc, singleton(0))], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, difference(cc, singleton(0)), vnb-lambda(crz_, difference(cc, singleton(0)), recip(crz_)), cra_, -recip(cra_ * cra_)))
- `cc-recip-lam-in-fun` — vnb-lambda(crz_, difference(cc, singleton(0)), recip(crz_)) in fun(difference(cc, singleton(0)), cc)
- `cc-recip-mul` — forall([ccu_ in cc, ccv_ in cc], not(ccu_ = 0) implies not(ccv_ = 0) implies recip(ccu_ * ccv_) = recip(ccu_) * recip(ccv_))

- `cc-scalar-ring-carr` — carr(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)) == cc

- `cc-scalar-ring-neg` — neg(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)) == vnb-lambda(x_, cc, -x_)

- `cc-scalar-ring-zero` — zero(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)) == 0
- `cc-series-abs-converges` — forall([f in fun(nn, cc), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpsj_ in nn], g(cpsj_) = magnitude(f(cpsj_))) implies series-converges(g) implies cc-series-converges(f))

- `cc-series-even-odd` — forall([f in fun(nn, cc), cexfe_ in fun(nn, cc), cexfo_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([cexj_ in nn], cexfe_(cexj_) = f(2 * cexj_)) implies forall([cexj_ in nn], cexfo_(cexj_) = f(succ(2 * cexj_))) implies cc-series-converges(f) implies cc-series-converges(cexfe_) implies cc-series-converges(cexfo_) implies cc-series-limit(f) = cc-series-limit(cexfe_) + cc-series-limit(cexfo_))

- `cc-series-of-zeros` — forall([acnt_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([acnk_ in nn], acnt_(acnk_) = 0) implies forall([acnl_], cc-series-converges-to(acnt_, acnl_) implies acnl_ = 0))

- `cc-series-partial-sum-magnitude-le` — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, cc), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([j in nn], g(j) = magnitude(f(j))) implies magnitude(cc-series-partial-sum(f, k)) <= series-partial-sum(g, k))

- `cc-series-terms-small` — forall([clhf_ in fun(nn, cc)], cc-series-converges(clhf_) implies forall([clhe_], pos-rr(clhe_) implies forsome([clhn_ in nn], forall([clhm_ in nn], clhn_ <= clhm_ implies magnitude(clhf_(clhm_)) <= clhe_))))
- `cc-sin-add` — forall([cexz_ in cc, cexw_ in cc], cc-sin(cexz_ + cexw_) = cc-cos(cexw_) * cc-sin(cexz_) + cc-cos(cexz_) * cc-sin(cexw_))

- `cc-sup-norm-bound` — forall([u, cpsxs_, cpsm_ in rr], 0 <= cpsm_ implies forall([cpsx_ in cpsxs_], u(cpsx_) in cc) implies forall([cpsx_ in cpsxs_], magnitude(u(cpsx_)) <= cpsm_) implies cc-sup-norm(u, cpsxs_) in rr and 0 <= cc-sup-norm(u, cpsxs_) and cc-sup-norm(u, cpsxs_) <= cpsm_)

- `cc-telescoping-limit-bound` — forall([gbs_ in fun(nn, cc), gbc_ in rr], 0 <= gbc_ implies forall([gbk_ in nn], magnitude(gbs_(succ(gbk_)) - gbs_(gbk_)) <= gbc_ * recip(2 ^ gbk_)) implies forsome([gbv_ in cc], converges-to(cc-ms, gbs_, gbv_) and forall([gbn_ in nn], magnitude(gbs_(gbn_) - gbv_) <= (2 * gbc_) * recip(2 ^ gbn_))))
- `cc-unif-cauchy-on-compact` — forall([kk], kk subset cc implies is-compact(subspace-ms(cc-ms, kk)) implies forall([dq], is-dense-seq(subspace-ms(cc-ms, kk), dq) implies forall([t], forall([k in nn, z in kk], (t(k))(z) in cc) implies forall([x in kk, eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([del], pos-rr(del) and forall([k in nn, y in kk], magnitude(y - x) < del implies magnitude((t(k))(y) - (t(k))(x)) < eps))) implies forall([j in nn], forsome([lm in cc], converges-to(cc-ms, vnb-lambda(cmk_, nn, (t(cmk_))(dq(j))), lm))) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap in nn], forall([i in nn], cap <= i implies forall([j in nn], cap <= j implies forall([z in kk], magnitude((t(i))(z) - (t(j))(z)) < eps))))))))
- `cc-uniform-limit-continuous-at` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([s in fun(nn, cc-cont-fns(u)), g in fun(u, cc), z0 in u, rho in rr], 0 < rho implies ball(cc-ms, z0, rho) subset u implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap in nn], forall([i in nn], cap <= i implies forall([z in ball(cc-ms, z0, rho)], magnitude((s(i))(z) - g(z)) <= eps)))) implies is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), g, z0)))

- `ccint-cover-sum-ge` — forall([a_, b_, fs], a_ in rr implies b_ in rr implies a_ <= b_ implies fs in fun(nn, power(rr)) implies ccint(a_, b_) subset big-union(lcn_, nn, fs(lcn_)) implies b_ - a_ <= esum(vnb-lambda(lkn_, nn, interval-length(fs(lkn_)))))
- `ccint-cover-widened-sum` — forall([a_, b_, fs, he], a_ in rr implies b_ in rr implies a_ <= b_ implies fs in fun(nn, power(rr)) implies ccint(a_, b_) subset big-union(lcn_, nn, fs(lcn_)) implies pos-rr(he) implies b_ - a_ <= esum(vnb-lambda(lnn_, nn, interval-length({nbz_ in rr: forsome([nbu_ in fs(lnn_)], nbz_ - nbu_ < he * recip(2 ^ succ(lnn_)) and nbu_ - nbz_ < he * recip(2 ^ succ(lnn_)))}))))

- `ccint-elt-in-rr` — forall([a, b, x in ccint(a, b)], x in rr)

- `ccint-inter-right-ray-all` — forall([a, b, c], a in rr implies b in rr implies c in rr implies c <= a implies intersection(ccint(a, b), {mhx_ in rr: c <= mhx_}) = ccint(a, b))
- `ccint-left-approach` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, rqx_ in rr], a < rqx_ implies rqx_ <= b implies forall([rqr_], pos-rr(rqr_) implies forsome([rqt_ in ccint(a, b)], rqx_ - rqr_ < rqt_ and rqt_ < rqx_)))

- `ccint-subset-rr` — forall([a, b], ccint(a, b) subset rr)
- `cd-body-unique` — forall([a_, al, be], al in ord and forsome([phi], phi in bijection(a_, ord-segment(al))) and forall([beta], ord-lt(beta, al) implies not(forsome([psi], psi in bijection(a_, ord-segment(beta))))) implies be in ord and forsome([phi], phi in bijection(a_, ord-segment(be))) and forall([beta], ord-lt(beta, be) implies not(forsome([psi], psi in bijection(a_, ord-segment(beta))))) implies al = be)
- `cd-seg-body` — forall([n_ in nn], n_ in ord and forsome([phi], phi in bijection(ord-segment(n_), ord-segment(n_))) and forall([beta], ord-lt(beta, n_) implies not(forsome([psi], psi in bijection(ord-segment(n_), ord-segment(beta))))))
- `cek-exp-gt-one-n` — forall([cekn_ in nn, cekt_ in rr], 0 < cekt_ implies cekt_ <= cekn_ * num(1/2) implies 1 < cc-exp(cekt_))

- `cek-kernel-nn-multiple` — forall([cekn_ in nn, cekw_ in cc], cc-exp(cekw_) = 1 implies cc-exp(cekn_ * cekw_) = 1)

- `cek-period-ge-half` — forall([cekt_ in rr], 0 < cekt_ implies cc-exp(1i * cekt_) = 1 implies num(1/2) <= cekt_)
- `cek-period-multiple-nn` — forall([cekn_ in nn, ceka_ in rr], 0 < ceka_ implies cc-exp(1i * ceka_) = 1 implies forall([cekt_ in rr], 0 < cekt_ implies cc-exp(1i * cekt_) = 1 implies ceka_ <= cekt_) implies forall([cekr_ in rr], 0 <= cekr_ implies cekr_ < cekn_ * ceka_ implies cc-exp(1i * cekr_) = 1 implies forsome([cekk_ in nn], cekr_ = cekk_ * ceka_)))
- `cek-period-multiple-zz` — forall([ceka_ in rr], 0 < ceka_ implies cc-exp(1i * ceka_) = 1 implies forall([cekt_ in rr], 0 < cekt_ implies cc-exp(1i * cekt_) = 1 implies ceka_ <= cekt_) implies forall([cekr_ in rr], cc-exp(1i * cekr_) = 1 implies forsome([cekk_ in zz], cekr_ = cekk_ * ceka_)))
- `cek-pi-le` — forall([cekp_, cekq_], cekp_ in rr and 0 < cekp_ and forall([cekz_ in cc], cc-exp(cekz_) = 1 iff forsome([cekk_ in zz], cekz_ = cekk_ * ((2 * cekp_) * 1i))) implies cekq_ in rr and 0 < cekq_ and forall([cekz_ in cc], cc-exp(cekz_) = 1 iff forsome([cekk_ in zz], cekz_ = cekk_ * ((2 * cekq_) * 1i))) implies cekq_ <= cekp_)
- `centre-set-contains-choice` — forall([s, r, f, u], u in f and forsome([c], c in centres(s, u, r)) implies choice(centres(s, u, r)) in centre-set(s, r, f))

- `centres-ball-eq` — forall([s, b, r, c in centres(s, b, r)], ball(s, c, r) = b)

- `centres-mem-build` — forall([s, b, r, c in pts(s)], ball(s, c, r) = b implies c in centres(s, b, r))
