- `cex-exp-comb-deriv` — forall([cexa_ in cc, cexb_ in cc, cexc_ in cc, cexd_ in cc, cexz_ in cc], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, cc, vnb-lambda(cexy_, cc, cexa_ * cc-exp(cexc_ * cexy_) + cexb_ * cc-exp(cexd_ * cexy_)), cexz_, cexa_ * (cexc_ * cc-exp(cexc_ * cexz_)) + cexb_ * (cexd_ * cc-exp(cexd_ * cexz_))))
- `cex-exp-series-real-converges` — forall([cext_ in rr], 0 < cext_ implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, recip(factorial(cpsk_)) * cext_ ^ cpsk_)))
- `cex-lin-deriv` — forall([cexc_ in cc, cexz_ in cc], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, cc, vnb-lambda(cexy_, cc, cexc_ * cexy_), cexz_, cexc_))
- `cex-shift-deriv-zero` — forall([cexw_ in cc, cexz_ in cc], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, cc, vnb-lambda(cexy_, cc, cc-exp(cexy_) * cc-exp(cexw_ - cexy_)), cexz_, 0))

- `change-of-variable-antiderivable` — forall([phi, amap, ader, p_, q_], amap in fun(rr, rr) implies ader in fun(rr, rr) implies p_ in rr implies q_ in rr implies p_ < q_ implies is-antiderivable(phi, amap(p_), amap(q_)) implies forall([u_ in ccint(p_, q_)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, amap, u_)) implies forall([w_], w_ in rr and p_ < w_ and w_ < q_ implies is-diff-at(amap, w_, ader(w_))) implies forall([u_ in ccint(p_, q_)], amap(u_) in ccint(amap(p_), amap(q_))) implies forall([w_], w_ in rr and p_ < w_ and w_ < q_ implies amap(p_) < amap(w_) and amap(w_) < amap(q_)) implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, phi(amap(x)) * ader(x)), p_, q_))
- `change-of-variable-antiderivative` — forall([fw, phi, amap, ader, p_, q_], amap in fun(rr, rr) implies ader in fun(rr, rr) implies p_ in rr implies q_ in rr implies p_ < q_ implies is-antiderivative(fw, phi, amap(p_), amap(q_)) implies forall([u_ in ccint(p_, q_)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, amap, u_)) implies forall([w_], w_ in rr and p_ < w_ and w_ < q_ implies is-diff-at(amap, w_, ader(w_))) implies forall([u_ in ccint(p_, q_)], amap(u_) in ccint(amap(p_), amap(q_))) implies forall([w_], w_ in rr and p_ < w_ and w_ < q_ implies amap(p_) < amap(w_) and amap(w_) < amap(q_)) implies is-antiderivative(compose(fw, amap), vnb-lambda(x, rr, phi(amap(x)) * ader(x)), p_, q_))

- `choose-set-split` — forall([n_ in nn, k_ in nn], choose-set(succ(n_), succ(k_)) = union(choose-set(n_, succ(k_)), image(vnb-lambda(s_, choose-set(n_, k_), union(s_, pair(n_, n_))), choose-set(n_, k_))))
- `choose-set-split-disjoint` — forall([n_ in nn, k_ in nn], intersection(choose-set(n_, succ(k_)), image(vnb-lambda(s_, choose-set(n_, k_), union(s_, pair(n_, n_))), choose-set(n_, k_))) = empty-set)

- `choose-set-widen` — forall([n_ in nn, m_, a_ in choose-set(n_, m_)], a_ in choose-set(succ(n_), m_))

- `cie-squeeze` — forall([ciex_ in rr, ciek_ in rr, ciea_ in rr], 0 <= ciea_ implies 0 <= ciek_ implies forall([cieq_ in rr], ciea_ < cieq_ implies ciex_ <= ciek_ * recip(cieq_)) implies ciex_ <= 0)
- `cif-open-minus-point` — forall([cifv_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), cifv_) implies forall([cifx_ in cc], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), difference(cifv_, singleton(cifx_)))))
- `cif-recip-power-closed-zero` — forall([cifj_ in nn, cifc_ in cc, pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset difference(cc, singleton(cifc_)) implies pgam(b) = pgam(a) implies line-int(vnb-lambda(cifv_, difference(cc, singleton(cifc_)), recip(cifv_ - cifc_) ^ succ(succ(cifj_))), pgam, dgam, a, b) = 0)
- `cif-recip-power-diff` — forall([cifj_ in nn, cifc_ in cc, cifw_ in difference(cc, singleton(cifc_))], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, difference(cc, singleton(cifc_)), vnb-lambda(cifv_, difference(cc, singleton(cifc_)), recip(cifv_ - cifc_) ^ succ(cifj_)), cifw_, -succ(cifj_) * recip(cifw_ - cifc_) ^ succ(succ(cifj_))))
- `cif-recip-shift-diff` — forall([cifc_ in cc, cifw_ in difference(cc, singleton(cifc_))], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, difference(cc, singleton(cifc_)), vnb-lambda(cifv_, difference(cc, singleton(cifc_)), recip(cifv_ - cifc_)), cifw_, -(recip(cifw_ - cifc_) * recip(cifw_ - cifc_))))
- `cips-dist-sq-inf` — forall([v, kk, xi], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-submodule(v, kk) implies xi in vec(v) implies forsome([aa in rr], 0 <= aa and forall([hdp_ in kk], aa <= (ip(v))((vadd(v))(hdp_, (vneg(v))(xi)), (vadd(v))(hdp_, (vneg(v))(xi)))) and forall([hdn_ in nn], forsome([hdq_ in kk], (ip(v))((vadd(v))(hdq_, (vneg(v))(xi)), (vadd(v))(hdq_, (vneg(v))(xi))) <= aa + recip(hdn_ + 1)))))
- `cips-eq-of-dist-sq-zero` — forall([v, x_, y_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies x_ in vec(v) implies y_ in vec(v) implies (ip(v))((vadd(v))(x_, (vneg(v))(y_)), (vadd(v))(x_, (vneg(v))(y_))) = 0 implies x_ = y_)
- `cips-expand-sum` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))((vadd(v))(x_, y_), (vadd(v))(x_, y_)) = ((ip(v))(x_, x_) + (ip(v))(x_, y_)) + (conjugate((ip(v))(x_, y_)) + (ip(v))(y_, y_))))
- `cips-expand-two` — forall([v, a_, b_, x_, y_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies a_ in cc implies b_ in cc implies x_ in vec(v) implies y_ in vec(v) implies (ip(v))((vadd(v))((act(v))(a_, x_), (act(v))(b_, y_)), (vadd(v))((act(v))(a_, x_), (act(v))(b_, y_))) = ((a_ * conjugate(a_)) * (ip(v))(x_, x_) + (a_ * conjugate(b_)) * (ip(v))(x_, y_)) + ((b_ * conjugate(a_)) * conjugate((ip(v))(x_, y_)) + (b_ * conjugate(b_)) * (ip(v))(y_, y_)))
- `cips-ip-add-right` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v), z_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(x_, (vadd(v))(y_, z_)) = (ip(v))(x_, y_) + (ip(v))(x_, z_)))
- `cips-ip-bound-least` — forall([v, e_, c_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies e_ in vec(v) implies c_ in rr implies 0 <= c_ implies forall([hrx_ in vec(v)], magnitude((ip(v))(hrx_, e_)) <= c_ * ip-norm(v, hrx_)) implies ip-norm(v, e_) <= c_)
- `cips-ip-conj-homog-right` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([a_ in cc, x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(x_, (act(v))(a_, y_)) = conjugate(a_) * (ip(v))(x_, y_)))
- `cips-ip-magnitude-le` — forall([v, x_, e_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies x_ in vec(v) implies e_ in vec(v) implies magnitude((ip(v))(x_, e_)) <= ip-norm(v, x_) * ip-norm(v, e_))
- `cips-ip-neg-left` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), z_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))((vneg(v))(x_), z_) = -(ip(v))(x_, z_)))
- `cips-ip-neg-right` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(x_, (vneg(v))(y_)) = -(ip(v))(x_, y_)))
- `cips-ip-neg-self` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))((vneg(v))(x_), (vneg(v))(x_)) = (ip(v))(x_, x_)))
- `cips-ip-separates` — forall([v, e1_, e2_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies e1_ in vec(v) implies e2_ in vec(v) implies forall([hrx_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(hrx_, e1_) = (ip(v))(hrx_, e2_)) implies e1_ = e2_)

- `cips-ip-zero-right` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(x_, vzero(v)) = 0))
- `cips-midpoint-estimate` — forall([v, kk, xi, aa], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-submodule(v, kk) implies xi in vec(v) implies aa in rr implies forall([hdp_ in kk], aa <= (ip(v))((vadd(v))(hdp_, (vneg(v))(xi)), (vadd(v))(hdp_, (vneg(v))(xi)))) implies forall([p1_, p2_], p1_ in kk implies p2_ in kk implies (ip(v))((vadd(v))(p1_, (vneg(v))(p2_)), (vadd(v))(p1_, (vneg(v))(p2_))) <= 2 * (ip(v))((vadd(v))(p1_, (vneg(v))(xi)), (vadd(v))(p1_, (vneg(v))(xi))) + 2 * (ip(v))((vadd(v))(p2_, (vneg(v))(xi)), (vadd(v))(p2_, (vneg(v))(xi))) - 4 * aa))
- `cips-minkowski` — forall([v, x_, y_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies x_ in vec(v) implies y_ in vec(v) implies ip-norm(v, (vadd(v))(x_, y_)) <= ip-norm(v, x_) + ip-norm(v, y_))
- `cips-parallelogram` — forall([v, x_, y_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies x_ in vec(v) implies y_ in vec(v) implies ip-norm(v, (vadd(v))(x_, y_)) * ip-norm(v, (vadd(v))(x_, y_)) + ip-norm(v, (vadd(v))(x_, (vneg(v))(y_))) * ip-norm(v, (vadd(v))(x_, (vneg(v))(y_))) = 2 * (ip-norm(v, x_) * ip-norm(v, x_)) + 2 * (ip-norm(v, y_) * ip-norm(v, y_)))

- `cmim-term-sym` — forall([s], is-c-metric-space(s) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([x in pts(s), y in pts(s), n_ in nn], (vnb-lambda(k, nn, w(k) * min(1, ((dists(s))(k))(x, y))))(n_) <= (vnb-lambda(k, nn, w(k) * min(1, ((dists(s))(k))(y, x))))(n_))))
- `cmim-term-triangle` — forall([s], is-c-metric-space(s) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([x in pts(s), y in pts(s), z in pts(s), n_ in nn], (vnb-lambda(k, nn, w(k) * min(1, ((dists(s))(k))(x, z))))(n_) <= (vnb-lambda(k, nn, w(k) * min(1, ((dists(s))(k))(x, y)) + w(k) * min(1, ((dists(s))(k))(y, z))))(n_))))

- `collapse-at-hi` — forall([k_ in nn, j_ in nn], k_ < j_ implies (collapse-at(k_))(j_) = pred(j_))
- `collapse-at-in-nn` — forall([k_ in nn, j_ in nn], (collapse-at(k_))(j_) in nn)

- `collinear-cases` — forall([goxa_ in cc, goxb_ in cc, goxc_ in cc], imag-part((goxb_ - goxa_) * conjugate(goxc_ - goxa_)) = 0 implies goxc_ in trace(seg-path(goxa_, goxb_), 0, 1) or goxa_ in trace(seg-path(goxb_, goxc_), 0, 1) or goxb_ in trace(seg-path(goxc_, goxa_), 0, 1))
- `comb-kk-0-0` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in carr(r), y in carr(r)], (comb-kk(r, x, y, 0))(0) = one(r)))
- `comb-kk-above` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in carr(r), y in carr(r), m in nn, k in zz], m < k implies (comb-kk(r, x, y, m))(k) = zero(r)))

- `comb-kk-in-fun` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in carr(r), y in carr(r), m in nn], comb-kk(r, x, y, m) in fun(zz, carr(r))))
- `comb-kk-in-fun-ind` — forall([m_ in nn, r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in carr(r), y in carr(r)], comb-kk(r, x, y, m_) in fun(zz, carr(r))))

- `comb-kk-null-ind` — forall([m_ in nn, r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in carr(r), y in carr(r), k_ in zz], k_ < 0 implies (comb-kk(r, x, y, m_))(k_) = zero(r)))
- `comm-monoid-assoc` — forall([s], is-comm-monoid(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a, b), c) = (opr(s))(a, (opr(s))(b, c))))

- `comm-monoid-left-id` — forall([s], is-comm-monoid(s) implies forall([a in carr(s)], (opr(s))(iden(s), a) = a))

- `comm-monoid-opr-interchange` — forall([s], is-comm-monoid(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s), d in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a, b), (opr(s))(c, d)) = (opr(s))((opr(s))(a, c), (opr(s))(b, d))))
- `commutative-ring-additive-ag-functorial` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-commutative-ring(a, b, f) implies is-hom-abelian-group(commutative-ring-additive-ag(a), commutative-ring-additive-ag(b), f))

- `commutative-ring-mul-comm` — forall([s], is-commutative-ring(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s)], (mul(s))(a, b) = (mul(s))(b, a)))
- `commutative-ring-multiplicative-cm-functorial` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-commutative-ring(a, b, f) implies is-hom-comm-monoid(commutative-ring-multiplicative-cm(a), commutative-ring-multiplicative-cm(b), f))
- `comp-of-body-clt` — forall([q, p], enc-all(enc-imp(q, p)) in clf implies enc-comp(p) in clt)

- `compact-iff-cluster-point` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies is-compact(s) iff forall([f in fun(nn, pts(s))], forsome([x], cluster-point(s, f, x))))

- `compact-implies-fip` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies is-compact(s) implies forall([c], has-fip(s, c) implies forsome([p], p in intersection-of(c))))
- `compact-implies-seq-compact` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies is-compact(s) implies seq-compact(s))

- `conjugate-exponent` — forall([p in rr], 1 < p implies p * recip(p - 1) in rr and 1 < p * recip(p - 1) and (/)(1, p) + (/)(1, p * recip(p - 1)) = 1 and (p - 1) * (p * recip(p - 1)) = p)
- `connected-locally-constant` — forall([s, mca_], is-connected(s, mca_) implies forall([f], forall([mcx_ in mca_], forsome([mcr_], pos-rr(mcr_) and forall([mcy_ in mca_], mcy_ in ball(s, mcx_, mcr_) implies f(mcy_) = f(mcx_)))) implies forall([mcp_ in mca_, mcq_ in mca_], f(mcp_) = f(mcq_))))

- `cont-on-transfer-ptwise-eq` — forall([itdm_], itdm_ subset rr implies forall([f, itg_], f in fun(itdm_, rr) implies is-continuous-on(itg_, itdm_) implies forall([itz_ in itdm_], f(itz_) = itg_(itz_)) implies is-continuous-on(f, itdm_)))
- `cont-transfer-ptwise-eq` — forall([f, g, a], f in fun(rr, rr) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, g, a) implies forall([x in rr], f(x) = g(x)) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, a))
- `continuous-abs-bounded-on-ccint` — forall([f, a, b], f in fun(rr, rr) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a <= b implies forall([x in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x)) implies forsome([m_ in rr], 0 <= m_ and forall([z_ in ccint(a, b)], abs(f(z_)) <= m_)))
- `continuous-at-iff-sequential` — forall([s, t, f, a], is-metric-space(s) implies is-metric-space(t) implies f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) implies a in pts(s) implies is-continuous-at(s, t, f, a) iff forall([sq in sqn(pts(s))], converges-to(s, sq, a) implies converges-to(t, compose(f, sq), f(a))))

- `continuous-at-left-limit` — forall([f, x], f in fun(rr, rr) implies x in rr implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x) implies is-left-limit(f, x, f(x)))
- `continuous-at-local` — forall([f in fun(rr, rr), g in fun(rr, rr), t_ in rr, rho in rr], 0 < rho implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, g, t_) implies forall([x_ in rr], abs(x_ - t_) <= rho implies f(x_) = g(x_)) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, t_))
- `continuous-at-right-limit` — forall([f, x], f in fun(rr, rr) implies x in rr implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x) implies is-right-limit(f, x, f(x)))
- `continuous-bounded-above-on-ccint` — forall([f, a, b], f in fun(rr, rr) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a <= b implies forall([x in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x)) implies forsome([k_ in rr], forall([z_ in ccint(a, b)], f(z_) <= k_)))
- `continuous-image-of-compact` — forall([s, t, fqf_], is-continuous(s, t, fqf_) implies forall([aqa_], aqa_ subset pts(s) implies is-compact(subspace-ms(s, aqa_)) implies is-compact(subspace-ms(t, image(fqf_, aqa_)))))

- `continuous-nonneg-left` — forall([g, aa, th], g in fun(rr, rr) implies aa in rr implies th in rr implies aa < th implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, g, th) implies forall([x], x in rr and aa < x and x < th implies 0 <= g(x)) implies 0 <= g(th))
- `continuous-nonpos-right` — forall([g, th, bb], g in fun(rr, rr) implies th in rr implies bb in rr implies th < bb implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, g, th) implies forall([x], x in rr and th < x and x < bb implies g(x) <= 0) implies g(th) <= 0)
- `continuous-on-compose-path` — forall([u, f, pgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-path(pgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies is-continuous-on(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(f(pgam(pat_)))), ccint(a, b)) and is-continuous-on(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(f(pgam(pat_)))), ccint(a, b)))
- `continuous-on-compose-regulated` — forall([u, f, pgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-path(pgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies is-regulated-on(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(f(pgam(pat_)))), a, b) and is-regulated-on(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(f(pgam(pat_)))), a, b))
- `continuous-on-implies-regulated-on` — forall([f, a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies a < b implies is-continuous-on(f, ccint(a, b)) implies is-regulated-on(f, a, b))
- `continuous-on-left-limit-within` — forall([f, rqw_], rqw_ subset rr implies is-continuous-on(f, rqw_) implies forall([rqx_ in rqw_], is-left-limit-within(f, rqw_, rqx_, f(rqx_))))
- `continuous-on-right-limit-within` — forall([f, rqw_], rqw_ subset rr implies is-continuous-on(f, rqw_) implies forall([rqx_ in rqw_], is-right-limit-within(f, rqw_, rqx_, f(rqx_))))
- `continuous-uniformly-continuous-on-ccint` — forall([f, a, b, eps], f in fun(rr, rr) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a <= b implies pos-rr(eps) implies forall([x in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x)) implies forsome([d_ in rr], 0 < d_ and forall([p_ in ccint(a, b), q_ in ccint(a, b)], abs(p_ - q_) <= d_ implies abs(f(p_) - f(q_)) <= eps)))
- `conv3-avoids-vertex` — forall([goxa_ in cc, goxb_ in cc, goxc_ in cc], not(imag-part((goxb_ - goxa_) * conjugate(goxc_ - goxa_)) = 0) implies forall([goxt_ in rr], 0 < goxt_ implies goxt_ <= 1 implies not(goxa_ in conv3(goxa_ + goxt_ * (goxb_ - goxa_), goxb_, goxc_)) and not(goxa_ in conv3(goxa_ + goxt_ * (goxb_ - goxa_), goxc_, goxa_ + goxt_ * (goxc_ - goxa_)))))
- `conv3-in-convex` — forall([u], is-convex-cc(u) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc], goua_ in u implies goub_ in u implies gouc_ in u implies conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) subset u))
- `conv3-intro` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc, goul_ in ccint(0, 1), goum_ in ccint(0, 1), goun_ in ccint(0, 1), gouz_], (goul_ + goum_) + goun_ = 1 implies gouz_ = (goul_ * goua_ + goum_ * goub_) + goun_ * gouc_ implies gouz_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_))
- `conv3-is-convex` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc], is-convex-cc(conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_)))
- `conv3-member-iff` — forall([goua_, goub_, gouc_, gouz_], gouz_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) iff gouz_ in cc and forsome([goul_ in ccint(0, 1), goum_ in ccint(0, 1), goun_ in ccint(0, 1)], (goul_ + goum_) + goun_ = 1 and gouz_ = (goul_ * goua_ + goum_ * goub_) + goun_ * gouc_))
- `conv3-mid-in` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc, goux_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_), gouy_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_)], cc-mid(goux_, gouy_) in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_))
- `conv3-near-vertex` — forall([goxa_ in cc, goxb_ in cc, goxc_ in cc, goxz_ in conv3(goxa_, goxb_, goxc_)], magnitude(goxz_ - goxa_) <= magnitude(goxb_ - goxa_) + magnitude(goxc_ - goxa_))
- `conv3-seg-trace` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc, goux_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_), gouy_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_)], trace(seg-path(goux_, gouy_), 0, 1) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_))
- `conv3-sub-hull` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc, goux_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_), gouy_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_), gouz_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_)], conv3(goux_, gouy_, gouz_) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_))
- `conv3-sub-triangle` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc], conv3(goua_, cc-mid(goua_, goub_), cc-mid(goua_, gouc_)) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) and conv3(cc-mid(goua_, goub_), goub_, cc-mid(goub_, gouc_)) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) and conv3(cc-mid(goua_, gouc_), cc-mid(goub_, gouc_), gouc_) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) and conv3(cc-mid(goua_, goub_), cc-mid(goub_, gouc_), cc-mid(goua_, gouc_)) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_))
- `conv3-vertex-shrink` — forall([goxa_ in cc, goxb_ in cc, goxc_ in cc, goxt_ in ccint(0, 1)], conv3(goxa_, goxa_ + goxt_ * (goxb_ - goxa_), goxa_ + goxt_ * (goxc_ - goxa_)) subset conv3(goxa_, goxb_, goxc_) and conv3(goxa_ + goxt_ * (goxb_ - goxa_), goxb_, goxc_) subset conv3(goxa_, goxb_, goxc_) and conv3(goxa_ + goxt_ * (goxb_ - goxa_), goxc_, goxa_ + goxt_ * (goxc_ - goxa_)) subset conv3(goxa_, goxb_, goxc_))
- `conv3-vertices-in` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc], goua_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) and goub_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) and gouc_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_))
- `convergence-block-tower` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([n in nn], seq-compact(ms(n))) implies forall([seq in fun(nn, product-carrier(ms))], forsome([s in fun(nn, inf-subsets(nn))], forall([k in nn], s(succ(k)) subset s(k)) and forsome([l in product-carrier(ms)], forall([n in nn], converges-along(ms(n), vnb-lambda(i, nn, (seq(i))(n)), s(n), l(n)))))))
- `converges-dist-null-bwd` — forall([t], is-metric-space(t) implies forall([f in fun(nn, pts(t)), lv in pts(t)], converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(j_, nn, (dist(t))(f(j_), lv)), 0) implies converges-to(t, f, lv)))
- `converges-dist-null-fwd` — forall([t], is-metric-space(t) implies forall([f in fun(nn, pts(t)), lv in pts(t)], converges-to(t, f, lv) implies converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(j_, nn, (dist(t))(f(j_), lv)), 0)))
- `converges-iff-dist-null` — forall([t], is-metric-space(t) implies forall([f in fun(nn, pts(t)), lv in pts(t)], converges-to(t, f, lv) iff converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(j_, nn, (dist(t))(f(j_), lv)), 0)))
- `converges-to-transfer` — forall([t], is-metric-space(t) implies forall([f in fun(nn, pts(t)), h in fun(nn, pts(t)), lv in pts(t)], converges-to(t, f, lv) implies forall([j_ in nn], h(j_) = f(j_)) implies converges-to(t, h, lv)))
- `coord-block-estimate` — forall([s, g, b, p, delta, m0], converges-along(s, g, b, p) implies strictly-mono-nn(delta) implies m0 in nn implies forall([j in nn], m0 <= j implies delta(j) in b) implies converges-to(s, subseq(g, delta), p))
- `coordinatewise-diagonal-subseq` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([n in nn], seq-compact(ms(n))) implies forall([seq in fun(nn, product-carrier(ms))], forsome([delta], strictly-mono-nn(delta) and forsome([l in product-carrier(ms)], forall([n in nn], converges-to(ms(n), vnb-lambda(k, nn, ((subseq(seq, delta))(k))(n)), l(n)))))))
- `core-closed-apply` — forall([tt, mczs_, hs, c], core-closed(tt, mczs_) implies core-rule(tt, hs, c) implies hyps-in(hs, mczs_) implies c in seq-set implies c in mczs_)
- `countable-cases` — forall([rqd_], is-countable(rqd_) implies rqd_ in set and (rqd_ = empty-set or forsome([rqe_ in fun(nn, rqd_)], forall([rqy_ in rqd_], forsome([rqn_ in nn], rqy_ = rqe_(rqn_))))))
- `countable-empty` — is-countable(empty-set)
- `countable-image` — forall([rqd_, rqh_, rqa_, rqb_], is-countable(rqd_) implies rqh_ in fun(rqa_, rqb_) implies rqd_ subset rqa_ implies is-countable(image(rqh_, rqd_)))
- `countable-image-avoids-interval` — forall([zc_, zdm_, zph_], is-countable(zc_) implies zc_ subset zdm_ implies zph_ in fun(zdm_, rr) implies forall([zp_ in rr, zq_ in rr], zp_ < zq_ implies forsome([zy_ in rr], zp_ < zy_ and zy_ < zq_ and forall([zx_ in zc_], not(zph_(zx_) = zy_)))))
- `countable-of-enum` — forall([rqd_, rqe_], rqd_ in set implies rqe_ in fun(nn, rqd_) implies forall([rqy_ in rqd_], forsome([rqn_ in nn], rqy_ = rqe_(rqn_))) implies is-countable(rqd_))
- `countable-of-two-enum` — forall([rqu_, rqf_, rqg_], rqu_ in set implies rqf_ in fun(nn, rqu_) implies rqg_ in fun(nn, rqu_) implies forall([rqy_ in rqu_], forsome([rqj_ in nn], rqy_ = rqf_(rqj_)) or forsome([rqj_ in nn], rqy_ = rqg_(rqj_))) implies is-countable(rqu_))
- `countable-singleton` — forall([rqx_ in set], is-countable(pair(rqx_, rqx_)))
- `countable-subset` — forall([rqa_, rqd_], is-countable(rqd_) implies rqa_ subset rqd_ implies is-countable(rqa_))
- `countable-union-2` — forall([rqa_, rqb_], is-countable(rqa_) implies is-countable(rqb_) implies is-countable(union(rqa_, rqb_)))
- `countable-union-nn` — forall([pud_, puu_ in set], forall([puk_ in nn], is-countable(pud_(puk_))) implies forall([puy_ in puu_], forsome([puk_ in nn], puy_ in pud_(puk_))) implies is-countable(puu_))
- `cover-block-step` — forall([v in set, f in fun(nn, v), c], is-finite-cover(c, v) implies forall([j in inf-subsets(nn)], forsome([j_ in inf-subsets(nn)], j_ subset j and forsome([u in c], forall([i in j_], f(i) in u)))))
- `cover-sum-dominates` — forall([omega, ca, rho, es, y_], is-measure(omega, ca, rho) implies y_ in cover-sums(omega, ca, rho, es) implies forsome([oda_ in ca], es subset oda_ and rho(oda_) <= y_))
- `cover-sums-elim` — forall([omega, cls, pm, es, v_ in cover-sums(omega, cls, pm, es)], forsome([cvs_ in fun(nn, cls)], es subset big-union(cvn_, nn, cvs_(cvn_)) and v_ = esum(vnb-lambda(cvk_, nn, pm(cvs_(cvk_))))))
- `cover-sums-intro` — forall([omega, cls, pm, es, sq_], pm in fun(cls, rr-pos-star) implies sq_ in fun(nn, cls) implies es subset big-union(cvn_, nn, sq_(cvn_)) implies esum(vnb-lambda(cvk_, nn, pm(sq_(cvk_)))) in cover-sums(omega, cls, pm, es))
- `cover-sums-subset` — forall([omega, cls, pm, es], cover-sums(omega, cls, pm, es) subset rr-pos-star)
- `cover-sums-unfold` — forall([omega, cls, pm, es], cover-sums(omega, cls, pm, es) == {cvv_ in rr-pos-star: forsome([cvs_ in fun(nn, cls)], es subset big-union(cvn_, nn, cvs_(cvn_)) and cvv_ = esum(vnb-lambda(cvk_, nn, pm(cvs_(cvk_)))))})
- `cpd-cc-squeeze` — forall([s_ in fun(nn, cc), lv in cc, m in fun(nn, rr)], converges-to(rr-ms, m, 0) implies forall([cpdj_ in nn], magnitude(s_(cpdj_) - lv) <= m(cpdj_)) implies converges-to(cc-ms, s_, lv))
- `cpd-power-second-order` — forall([cpdk_ in nn, cpdz_ in cc, cpdu_ in cc, cpdr_ in rr], magnitude(cpdz_) <= cpdr_ implies magnitude(cpdu_) <= cpdr_ implies cpdr_ * magnitude(cpdz_ ^ succ(cpdk_) - cpdu_ ^ succ(cpdk_) - (succ(cpdk_) * cpdu_ ^ cpdk_) * (cpdz_ - cpdu_)) <= ((succ(cpdk_) * succ(cpdk_)) * cpdr_ ^ cpdk_) * (magnitude(cpdz_ - cpdu_) * magnitude(cpdz_ - cpdu_)))
- `cps-abs-conv-closed-ball` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), cpsrad_ in rr], 0 <= cpsrad_ implies cpsrad_ < cps-radius(cf) implies forall([cpsz_ in closed-ball(cc-ms, 0, cpsrad_)], series-converges(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, magnitude(cf(cpsk_) * cpsz_ ^ cpsk_)))))
- `cps-coefficient-formula` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), ctck_ in nn, ctcg_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([ctcn_ in nn], ctcg_(ctcn_) = (factorial(ctcn_ + ctck_) * recip(factorial(ctcn_))) * cf(ctcn_ + ctck_)) implies forall([cpdr_ in rr], 0 < cpdr_ implies cf(ctck_) = (vnb-lambda(cpdz_, ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_), cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, ctcg_(cpsk_) * cpdz_ ^ cpsk_))))(0) * recip(factorial(ctck_))))
- `cps-converges-closed-ball` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), cpsrad_ in rr], 0 <= cpsrad_ implies cpsrad_ < cps-radius(cf) implies forall([cpsz_ in closed-ball(cc-ms, 0, cpsrad_)], cc-series-converges(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, cf(cpsk_) * cpsz_ ^ cpsk_))))
- `cps-diff-on-ball` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), dcf in fun(nn, cc)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], dcf(cpdj_) = succ(cpdj_) * cf(succ(cpdj_))) implies forall([cpdr_ in rr], 0 < cpdr_ implies cpdr_ < cps-radius(cf) implies forall([cpda_ in ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_)], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_), vnb-lambda(cpdz_, ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_), cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, cf(cpsk_) * cpdz_ ^ cpsk_))), cpda_, cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, dcf(cpsk_) * cpda_ ^ cpsk_))))))
- `cps-entire-converges` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc)], cps-radius(cf) = pos-inf implies forall([cexz_ in cc], cc-series-converges(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, cf(cpsk_) * cexz_ ^ cpsk_))))
- `cps-entire-diff` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), dcf in fun(nn, cc)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], dcf(cpdj_) = succ(cpdj_) * cf(succ(cpdj_))) implies cps-radius(cf) = pos-inf implies forall([cpda_ in cc], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, cc, vnb-lambda(cpdz_, cc, cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, cf(cpsk_) * cpdz_ ^ cpsk_))), cpda_, cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, dcf(cpsk_) * cpda_ ^ cpsk_)))))
- `cps-factor-conv` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), cg in fun(nn, cc), cfg in fun(nn, cc)], forall([cpsk_ in nn], cfg(cpsk_) = cf(cpsk_) * cg(cpsk_)) implies forall([cpsc_ in rr, cpsm_ in nn], forall([cpsk_ in nn], magnitude(cg(cpsk_)) <= cpsc_ * cpsk_ ^ cpsm_) implies forall([cpst_ in rr, cpsrad_ in rr], 0 <= cpsrad_ implies cpsrad_ < cpst_ implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, magnitude(cf(cpsk_)) * cpst_ ^ cpsk_)) implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, magnitude(cfg(cpsk_)) * cpsrad_ ^ cpsk_)))))
- `cps-holomorphic-ball` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), cpdr_ in rr], 0 < cpdr_ implies cpdr_ < cps-radius(cf) implies holomorphic-on(ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_), vnb-lambda(cpdz_, ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_), cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, cf(cpsk_) * cpdz_ ^ cpsk_)))) and cps-radius(vnb-lambda(cpdn_, nn, succ(cpdn_) * cf(succ(cpdn_)))) = cps-radius(cf) and forall([cpda_ in ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_)], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_), vnb-lambda(cpdz_, ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_), cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, cf(cpsk_) * cpdz_ ^ cpsk_))), cpda_, cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, (succ(cpsk_) * cf(succ(cpsk_))) * cpda_ ^ cpsk_)))))
- `cps-kth-derived-radius` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), ctck_ in nn, ctcg_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([ctcn_ in nn], ctcg_(ctcn_) = (factorial(ctcn_ + ctck_) * recip(factorial(ctcn_))) * cf(ctcn_ + ctck_)) implies cps-radius(ctcg_) = cps-radius(cf))
- `cps-kth-derived-step` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), ctck_ in nn, ctcg_ in fun(nn, cc), ctch_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([ctcn_ in nn], ctcg_(ctcn_) = (factorial(ctcn_ + ctck_) * recip(factorial(ctcn_))) * cf(ctcn_ + ctck_)) implies forall([ctcn_ in nn], ctch_(ctcn_) = (factorial(ctcn_ + succ(ctck_)) * recip(factorial(ctcn_))) * cf(ctcn_ + succ(ctck_))) implies forall([cpdj_ in nn], ctch_(cpdj_) = succ(cpdj_) * ctcg_(succ(cpdj_))))
- `cps-log-deriv-at-one` — forall([algc_ in fun(nn, cc)], algc_(0) = 0 implies forall([algj_ in nn], algc_(succ(algj_)) = num(-1) ^ algj_ * recip(succ(algj_))) implies forall([algr_ in rr], 0 < algr_ implies algr_ < 1 implies forall([algw_ in ball(cc-ms, 1, algr_)], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, ball(cc-ms, 1, algr_), vnb-lambda(algz_, ball(cc-ms, 1, algr_), cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, algc_(cpsk_) * (algz_ - 1) ^ cpsk_))), algw_, recip(algw_)))))
- `cps-log-radius` — forall([algc_ in fun(nn, cc)], algc_(0) = 0 implies forall([algj_ in nn], algc_(succ(algj_)) = num(-1) ^ algj_ * recip(succ(algj_))) implies forall([algr_ in rr], 0 <= algr_ implies algr_ < 1 implies algr_ < cps-radius(algc_)))
- `cps-log-radius-le-one` — forall([clhc_ in fun(nn, cc)], clhc_(0) = 0 implies forall([clhj_ in nn], clhc_(succ(clhj_)) = num(-1) ^ clhj_ * recip(succ(clhj_))) implies forall([clhr_ in rr], 1 < clhr_ implies not(clhr_ < cps-radius(clhc_))))
- `cps-log-radius-one` — forall([clhc_ in fun(nn, cc)], clhc_(0) = 0 implies forall([clhj_ in nn], clhc_(succ(clhj_)) = num(-1) ^ clhj_ * recip(succ(clhj_))) implies cps-radius(clhc_) = 1)
- `cps-log-series` — forall([algc_ in fun(nn, cc)], algc_(0) = 0 implies forall([algj_ in nn], algc_(succ(algj_)) = num(-1) ^ algj_ * recip(succ(algj_))) implies forall([algr_ in rr], 0 < algr_ implies algr_ < 1 implies forall([algz_ in ball(cc-ms, 0, algr_)], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, ball(cc-ms, 0, algr_), vnb-lambda(cpdz_, ball(cc-ms, 0, algr_), cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, algc_(cpsk_) * cpdz_ ^ cpsk_))), algz_, recip(1 + algz_)))))
- `cps-normally-convergent` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), cpsrad_ in rr], 0 <= cpsrad_ implies cpsrad_ < cps-radius(cf) implies is-normally-convergent(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, vnb-lambda(cpsz_, closed-ball(cc-ms, 0, cpsrad_), cf(cpsk_) * cpsz_ ^ cpsk_)), closed-ball(cc-ms, 0, cpsrad_)))
- `cps-nth-deriv` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), cpdr_ in rr], 0 < cpdr_ implies cpdr_ < cps-radius(cf) implies forall([ndlk_ in nn, ndlg_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([ctcn_ in nn], ndlg_(ctcn_) = (factorial(ctcn_ + ndlk_) * recip(factorial(ctcn_))) * cf(ctcn_ + ndlk_)) implies nth-deriv-on(cc-normed-field, ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_), vnb-lambda(cpdz_, ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_), cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, cf(cpsk_) * cpdz_ ^ cpsk_))), ndlk_) = vnb-lambda(cpdz_, ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_), cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, ndlg_(cpsk_) * cpdz_ ^ cpsk_)))))
- `cps-partial-error-bound` — forall([cpdk_ in nn, cf in fun(nn, cc), dcf in fun(nn, cc)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], dcf(cpdj_) = succ(cpdj_) * cf(succ(cpdj_))) implies forall([cpdz_ in cc, cpdu_ in cc, cpdr_ in rr], magnitude(cpdz_) <= cpdr_ implies magnitude(cpdu_) <= cpdr_ implies forall([cpdtz_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], cpdtz_(cpdj_) = cf(cpdj_) * cpdz_ ^ cpdj_) implies forall([cpdtu_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], cpdtu_(cpdj_) = cf(cpdj_) * cpdu_ ^ cpdj_) implies forall([cpdtd_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], cpdtd_(cpdj_) = dcf(cpdj_) * cpdu_ ^ cpdj_) implies forall([cpdvv_ in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], cpdvv_(cpdj_) = magnitude(cf(succ(cpdj_)) * (succ(cpdj_) * succ(cpdj_))) * cpdr_ ^ succ(cpdj_)) implies (cpdr_ * cpdr_) * magnitude(cc-series-partial-sum(cpdtz_, succ(cpdk_)) - cc-series-partial-sum(cpdtu_, succ(cpdk_)) - (cpdz_ - cpdu_) * cc-series-partial-sum(cpdtd_, cpdk_)) <= (magnitude(cpdz_ - cpdu_) * magnitude(cpdz_ - cpdu_)) * series-partial-sum(cpdvv_, cpdk_)))))))
- `cps-poly-geom-bound` — forall([cpsm_ in nn, cpsq_ in rr], 0 <= cpsq_ implies cpsq_ < 1 implies forsome([cpsb_ in rr], 0 <= cpsb_ and forall([cpsk_ in nn], cpsk_ ^ cpsm_ * cpsq_ ^ cpsk_ <= cpsb_)))
- `cps-radius-approx` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), cpsrad_ in rr], 0 <= cpsrad_ implies cpsrad_ < cps-radius(cf) implies forsome([cpst_ in rr], cpsrad_ < cpst_ and series-converges(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, magnitude(cf(cpsk_)) * cpst_ ^ cpsk_))))
- `cps-radius-derived` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), dcf in fun(nn, cc)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], dcf(cpdj_) = succ(cpdj_) * cf(succ(cpdj_))) implies cps-radius(dcf) = cps-radius(cf))
- `cps-radius-factor` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), cg in fun(nn, cc), cfg in fun(nn, cc)], forall([cpsk_ in nn], cfg(cpsk_) = cf(cpsk_) * cg(cpsk_)) implies forall([cpsc_ in rr, cpsm_ in nn], forall([cpsk_ in nn], magnitude(cg(cpsk_)) <= cpsc_ * cpsk_ ^ cpsm_) implies cps-radius(cf) <= cps-radius(cfg)))

- `esum-nn-le-of-prefixes` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star), b in rr-pos-star], forall([n in nn], finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, ord-segment(n)) <= b) implies esum(f) <= b)

- `esum-scale` — forall([c in rr], 0 <= c implies forall([dd, f in fun(dd, rr-pos-star)], esum(vnb-lambda(esz_, dd, etimes(c, f(esz_)))) = etimes(c, esum(f))))

- `esup-exists` — forall([s_], s_ subset rr-pos-star implies forsome([bb_ in rr-pos-star], forall([x in s_], x <= bb_) and forall([b], b in rr-pos-star and forall([x in s_], x <= b) implies bb_ <= b)))
- `esup-grid-max` — forall([dd in rr], 0 < dd implies forall([y in rr, m in nn, kk], kk subset nn implies m in kk implies y < m * dd + dd implies forall([k in kk], k * dd <= y) implies esup(image(vnb-lambda(sk_, nn, sk_ * dd), kk)) = m * dd))

- `field-id-zero` — forall([f_], is-field(f_) implies zero(field-as-integral-domain(f_)) == zero(f_))
- `field-is-field-ring` — forall([s_], is-field(s_) implies is-field-ring(field-as-integral-domain(s_)))
- `fin-enum-is-bijection` — forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies fin-enum(s) in bijection(ord-segment(card(s)), s))
- `fin-subset-monoid-is-comm-monoid` — forall([a_ in set], is-comm-monoid(fin-subset-monoid(a_)))
- `fin-subsets-has-empty` — forall([a_], empty-set in fin-subsets(a_))
- `fin-subsets-is-set` — forall([a_ in set], fin-subsets(a_) in set)
- `fin-subsets-membership` — forall([a_, s_], s_ in fin-subsets(a_) iff s_ in set and forall([z in s_], z in a_) and card(s_) in nn)

- `finite-implies-countable` — forall([rqd_ in set], card(rqd_) in nn implies is-countable(rqd_))
- `finite-set-induction` — forall([c_], empty-set in c_ and forall([s_], s_ in set and card(s_) in nn and s_ in c_ implies forall([x_], x_ in set and not(x_ in s_) implies union(s_, pair(x_, x_)) in c_)) implies forall([s_], s_ in set and card(s_) in nn implies s_ in c_))
- `finite-strict-minimal` — forall([r], forall([x, y, z], [x, y] in r implies [y, z] in r implies [x, z] in r) implies forall([x], not([x, x] in r)) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forsome([w], w in s) implies forsome([m in s], forall([z in s], not([z, m] in r)))))
- `finsum-abs-triangle` — forall([s], s in set and card(s) in nn implies forall([a in fun(s, rr)], abs(finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), a, s)) <= finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, abs(a(i))), s)))
- `finsum-act-collect-gen` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([x in vec(md), s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([c in fun(s, carr(scal(md)))], (act(md))(finsum(ring-additive-ag(scal(md)), c, s), x) = finsum(module-vector-ag(md), vnb-lambda(z, s, (act(md))(c(z), x)), s))))
- `finsum-act-distrib-gen` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([r in carr(scal(md)), s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(module-vector-ag(md)))], (act(md))(r, finsum(module-vector-ag(md), f, s)) = finsum(module-vector-ag(md), vnb-lambda(z, s, (act(md))(r, f(z))), s))))
- `finsum-add` — forall([m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(m)), h in fun(s, carr(m))], finsum(m, vnb-lambda(z, s, (opr(m))(f(z), h(z))), s) = (opr(m))(finsum(m, f, s), finsum(m, h, s)))))
- `finsum-add-ag` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(ag)), h in fun(s, carr(ag))], finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(z, s, (opr(ag))(f(z), h(z))), s) = (opr(ag))(finsum(ag, f, s), finsum(ag, h, s)))))
- `finsum-all-id` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(ag))], forall([z in s], f(z) = iden(ag)) implies finsum(ag, f, s) = iden(ag))))
- `finsum-all-id-ptwise` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s_ in set], card(s_) in nn implies forall([f_], forall([z_ in s_], f_(z_) = iden(ag)) implies finsum(ag, f_, s_) = iden(ag))))
- `finsum-cm-add-ptwise` — forall([m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f, g, h], forall([z_ in s], f(z_) in carr(m)) implies forall([z_ in s], g(z_) in carr(m)) implies forall([z_ in s], h(z_) = (opr(m))(f(z_), g(z_))) implies finsum(m, h, s) = (opr(m))(finsum(m, f, s), finsum(m, g, s)))))
- `finsum-cm-all-iden-ptwise` — forall([m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f], forall([z_ in s], f(z_) = iden(m)) implies finsum(m, f, s) = iden(m))))
- `finsum-cm-congruence-q` — forall([m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f, g], forall([z in s], f(z) = g(z)) implies finsum(m, f, s) == finsum(m, g, s))))
- `finsum-cm-fiber-ptwise` — forall([m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([t in set], card(t) in nn implies forall([phi, f], forall([z_ in s], phi(z_) in t) implies forall([z_ in s], f(z_) in carr(m)) implies forall([gq], forall([z_ in t], gq(z_) == finsum(m, f, {fw_ in s: phi(fw_) = z_})) implies finsum(m, f, s) = finsum(m, gq, t))))))
- `finsum-cm-insert-ptwise` — forall([m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([s_ in set], card(s_) in nn implies forall([k_ in set], not(k_ in s_) implies forall([f_], forall([z_ in union(s_, pair(k_, k_))], f_(z_) in carr(m)) implies finsum(m, f_, union(s_, pair(k_, k_))) = (opr(m))(finsum(m, f_, s_), f_(k_))))))
- `finsum-cm-pad-ptwise` — forall([m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([t in set], card(t) in nn implies forall([r], forall([z_ in r], z_ in t) implies forall([g], forall([z_ in t], g(z_) in carr(m)) implies forall([z_ in t], not(z_ in r) implies g(z_) = iden(m)) implies finsum(m, g, t) = finsum(m, g, r)))))
- `finsum-cm-remove-ptwise` — forall([m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([t in set], card(t) in nn implies forall([k in t, g], forall([z_ in t], g(z_) in carr(m)) implies finsum(m, g, t) = (opr(m))(finsum(m, g, difference(t, pair(k, k))), g(k)))))
- `finsum-cm-singleton-ptwise` — forall([m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([x_ in set, f_], f_(x_) in carr(m) implies finsum(m, f_, pair(x_, x_)) = f_(x_)))
- `finsum-cm-union-disjoint` — forall([m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([s_ in set], card(s_) in nn implies forall([t_ in set], card(t_) in nn implies forall([z_ in t_], not(z_ in s_)) implies forall([f_], forall([z_ in union(s_, t_)], f_(z_) in carr(m)) implies finsum(m, f_, union(s_, t_)) = (opr(m))(finsum(m, f_, s_), finsum(m, f_, t_))))))
- `finsum-comm-monoid-permutation-invariance` — forall([n in nn, m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([g in fun(nn, carr(m)), h in fun(nn, carr(m)), phi in bijection(ord-segment(n), ord-segment(n))], forall([i in ord-segment(n)], h(i) = g(phi(i))) implies sum-ag(m, g, n) = sum-ag(m, h, n)))
- `finsum-comm-monoid-type` — forall([m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(m))], finsum(m, f, s) in carr(m))))
- `finsum-comm-monoid-type-ptwise` — forall([m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f], forall([z in s], f(z) in carr(m)) implies finsum(m, f, s) in carr(m))))
- `finsum-comm-monoid-well-defined` — forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(m)), enm in bijection(ord-segment(card(s)), s)], finsum(m, f, s) = sum-ag(m, enum-fam(m, f, enm, card(s)), card(s)))))
- `finsum-congruence` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f, g], forall([z in s], f(z) = g(z)) implies forall([z in s], f(z) in carr(ag)) implies finsum(ag, f, s) = finsum(ag, g, s))))
- `finsum-congruence-guarded` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(ag)), g], forall([z in s], f(z) = g(z)) implies finsum(ag, f, s) = finsum(ag, g, s))))
- `finsum-congruence-q` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f, g], forall([z in s], f(z) = g(z)) implies finsum(ag, f, s) == finsum(ag, g, s))))
- `finsum-embed` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([s2 in set], card(s2) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s2, carr(ag))], s subset s2 implies forall([z], z in s2 and not(z in s) implies f(z) = iden(ag)) implies finsum(ag, f, s2) = finsum(ag, f, s)))))
- `finsum-empty` — forall([ag, f], finsum(ag, f, empty-set) == iden(ag))
- `finsum-fiber` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([t in set], card(t) in nn implies forall([phi in fun(s, t), f in fun(s, carr(ag))], finsum(ag, f, s) = finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(t_, t, finsum(ag, f, {s_ in s: phi(s_) = t_})), t)))))
- `finsum-fiber-slice` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([k in set], card(k) in nn implies forall([ph, tp, ff, al, be], al in fun(k, s) implies forall([k_ in k], ph(al(k_)) = tp) implies forall([w_ in s], ph(w_) = tp implies be(w_) in k) implies forall([k_ in k], be(al(k_)) = k_) implies forall([w_ in s], ph(w_) = tp implies al(be(w_)) = w_) implies forall([z_ in s], ff(z_) in carr(ag)) implies finsum(ag, ff, {s_ in s: ph(s_) = tp}) = finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(z, k, ff(al(z))), k)))))
- `finsum-fiber-value` — forall([ag, ff, ph, s, t, pt in t], (vnb-lambda(t_, t, finsum(ag, ff, {s_ in s: ph(s_) = t_})))(pt) == finsum(ag, ff, {s_ in s: ph(s_) = pt}))
- `finsum-fubini` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([x], x in set and card(x) in nn implies forall([y], y in set and card(y) in nn implies forall([f in fun(cartesian(x, y), carr(ag))], finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(i, x, finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(j, y, f([i, j])), y)), x) = finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(j, y, finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(i, x, f([i, j])), x)), y)))))
- `finsum-fubini-c` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([x in set], card(x) in nn implies forall([y in set], card(y) in nn implies forall([f in fun(cartesian(x, y), carr(ag))], finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(i, x, finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(j, y, f([i, j])), y)), x) = finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(j, y, finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(i, x, f([i, j])), x)), y)))))
- `finsum-in-subset` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([sm], iden(ag) in sm implies forall([x_ in sm, y_ in sm], (opr(ag))(x_, y_) in sm) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(ag))], forall([z in s], f(z) in sm) implies finsum(ag, f, s) in sm))))
- `finsum-insert` — forall([m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([x], x in set and card(x) in nn implies forall([k], k in set and not(k in x) implies forall([f in fun(union(x, pair(k, k)), carr(m))], finsum(m, f, union(x, pair(k, k))) = (opr(m))(finsum(m, f, x), f(k))))))
- `finsum-insert-ag` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([x in set], card(x) in nn implies forall([k in set], not(k in x) implies forall([f in fun(union(x, pair(k, k)), carr(ag))], finsum(ag, f, union(x, pair(k, k))) = (opr(ag))(finsum(ag, f, x), f(k))))))
- `finsum-insert-from-enum` — forall([m, f, x, k, enm], card(x) in nn implies card(union(x, pair(k, k))) = succ(card(x)) implies enm(card(x)) == k implies forall([i in ord-segment(card(x))], enm(i) == (fin-enum(x))(i)) implies finsum(m, f, union(x, pair(k, k))) = sum-ag(m, enum-fam(m, f, enm, card(union(x, pair(k, k)))), card(union(x, pair(k, k)))) implies finsum(m, f, union(x, pair(k, k))) = (opr(m))(finsum(m, f, x), f(k)))
- `finsum-insert-ptwise` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s_ in set], card(s_) in nn implies forall([k_ in set], not(k_ in s_) implies forall([f_], forall([z_ in union(s_, pair(k_, k_))], f_(z_) in carr(ag)) implies finsum(ag, f_, union(s_, pair(k_, k_))) = (opr(ag))(finsum(ag, f_, s_), f_(k_))))))
- `finsum-interval-peel` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([n in nn, f in fun(interval(1, succ(n)), carr(ag))], finsum(ag, f, interval(1, succ(n))) = (opr(ag))(finsum(ag, f, interval(1, n)), f(succ(n)))))
- `finsum-interval-shift` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([n in nn, f in fun(interval(1, succ(n)), carr(ag))], finsum(ag, f, interval(1, succ(n))) = (opr(ag))(f(1), finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(z, interval(1, n), f(succ(z))), interval(1, n)))))
- `finsum-le-termwise` — forall([s], s in set and card(s) in nn implies forall([a in fun(s, rr), b in fun(s, rr)], forall([i in s], a(i) <= b(i)) implies finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), a, s) <= finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), b, s)))
- `finsum-ord-peel` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([n in nn, f in fun(ord-segment(succ(n)), carr(ag))], finsum(ag, f, ord-segment(succ(n))) = (opr(ag))(finsum(ag, f, ord-segment(n)), f(n))))
- `finsum-reindex` — forall([m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([t], t in set and card(t) in nn implies forall([phi in bijection(t, s), f in fun(s, carr(m))], finsum(m, f, s) = finsum(m, vnb-lambda(z, t, f(phi(z))), t)))))
- `finsum-reindex-ag` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([t], t in set and card(t) in nn implies forall([phi in bijection(t, s), f in fun(s, carr(ag))], finsum(ag, f, s) = finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(z, t, f(phi(z))), t)))))
- `finsum-reindex-inverse` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([t], t in set and card(t) in nn implies forall([phi in fun(t, s), psi in fun(s, t)], forall([u_ in t], psi(phi(u_)) = u_) implies forall([v_ in s], phi(psi(v_)) = v_) implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(ag))], finsum(ag, f, s) = finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(z, t, f(phi(z))), t))))))
- `finsum-reindex-inverse-ptwise` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([t], t in set and card(t) in nn implies forall([phi in fun(t, s), psi in fun(s, t)], forall([u_ in t], psi(phi(u_)) = u_) implies forall([v_ in s], phi(psi(v_)) = v_) implies forall([ff], forall([z_ in s], ff(z_) in carr(ag)) implies finsum(ag, ff, s) = finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(z, t, ff(phi(z))), t))))))
- `finsum-ring-distrib-left` — forall([rng], is-commutative-ring(rng) implies forall([r in carr(rng), s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(rng))], (mul(rng))(r, finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rng), f, s)) = finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rng), vnb-lambda(z, s, (mul(rng))(r, f(z))), s))))
- `finsum-ring-distrib-left-gen` — forall([rng], is-ring(rng) implies forall([r in carr(rng), s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(rng))], (mul(rng))(r, finsum(ring-additive-ag(rng), f, s)) = finsum(ring-additive-ag(rng), vnb-lambda(z, s, (mul(rng))(r, f(z))), s))))
- `finsum-ring-distrib-right` — forall([rng], is-commutative-ring(rng) implies forall([r in carr(rng), s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(rng))], (mul(rng))(finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rng), f, s), r) = finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rng), vnb-lambda(z, s, (mul(rng))(f(z), r)), s))))
- `finsum-ring-distrib-right-gen` — forall([rng], is-ring(rng) implies forall([r in carr(rng), s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(rng))], (mul(rng))(finsum(ring-additive-ag(rng), f, s), r) = finsum(ring-additive-ag(rng), vnb-lambda(z, s, (mul(rng))(f(z), r)), s))))
- `finsum-ring-scalar-zz` — forall([rng], is-commutative-ring(rng) implies forall([r in carr(rng), c in zz, a in carr(rng)], (mul(rng))(r, zz-act(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rng), c, a)) = zz-act(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rng), c, (mul(rng))(r, a))))
- `finsum-rr-in-rr` — forall([s_ in set], card(s_) in nn implies forall([f_ in fun(s_, rr)], finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), f_, s_) in rr))
- `finsum-rr-nonneg` — forall([s_ in set], card(s_) in nn implies forall([f_ in fun(s_, rr)], forall([z_ in s_], 0 <= f_(z_)) implies 0 <= finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), f_, s_)))
- `finsum-single-support` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(ag)), i0 in s], forall([j in s], not(j = i0) implies f(j) = iden(ag)) implies finsum(ag, f, s) = f(i0))))
- `finsum-singleton` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([x in set, f in fun(pair(x, x), carr(ag))], finsum(ag, f, pair(x, x)) = f(x)))  _[warrant: well-known]_
- `finsum-singleton-ptwise` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([x_ in set, f_], f_(x_) in carr(ag) implies finsum(ag, f_, pair(x_, x_)) = f_(x_)))
- `finsum-sq-nonneg` — forall([s], s in set and card(s) in nn implies forall([a in fun(s, rr)], 0 <= finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, a(i) * a(i)), s)))
- `finsum-two-support` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(ag)), i0 in s, i1 in s], not(i0 = i1) implies forall([j in s], not(j = i0) implies not(j = i1) implies f(j) = iden(ag)) implies finsum(ag, f, s) = (opr(ag))(f(i0), f(i1)))))
- `finsum-type` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(ag))], finsum(ag, f, s) in carr(ag))))
- `finsum-type-ptwise` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f], forall([z in s], f(z) in carr(ag)) implies finsum(ag, f, s) in carr(ag))))
- `finsum-union-disjoint` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s_ in set], card(s_) in nn implies forall([t_ in set], card(t_) in nn implies forall([z_ in t_], not(z_ in s_)) implies forall([f_], forall([z_ in union(s_, t_)], f_(z_) in carr(ag)) implies finsum(ag, f_, union(s_, t_)) = (opr(ag))(finsum(ag, f_, s_), finsum(ag, f_, t_))))))
- `finsum-union-disjoint-fun` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s_ in set], card(s_) in nn implies forall([t_ in set], card(t_) in nn implies intersection(s_, t_) = empty-set implies forall([f_ in fun(union(s_, t_), carr(ag))], finsum(ag, f_, union(s_, t_)) = (opr(ag))(finsum(ag, f_, s_), finsum(ag, f_, t_))))))
- `finsum-well-defined` — forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(ag)), enm in bijection(ord-segment(card(s)), s)], finsum(ag, f, s) = sum-ag(ag, enum-fam(ag, f, enm, card(s)), card(s)))))  _[warrant: informal]_
- `finsupp-in-set` — forall([a_, m_], is-ring(a_) implies is-monoid(m_) implies finsupp(a_, m_) in set)
- `finsupp-membership` — forall([a_, m_, f_], f_ in finsupp(a_, m_) iff f_ in fun(carr(m_), carr(a_)) and card(supp(a_, m_, f_)) in nn)

- `gamma-tail-small` — forall([z, s0, r1, r2], z in cc implies s0 in rr implies r1 in rr implies r2 in rr implies 0 < s0 implies s0 <= real-part(z) implies 0 < r1 implies r1 < r2 implies r2 <= 1 implies magnitude(cc-int(gamma-integrand(z), r1, r2)) <= cc-exp(s0 * log(r2)) * recip(s0))
- `gamma-truncation-error` — forall([z, s0, s1, a, rl, rh], z in cc implies s0 in rr implies s1 in rr implies a in rr implies rl in rr implies rh in rr implies 0 < s0 implies s0 <= real-part(z) implies real-part(z) <= s1 implies 1 <= a implies s1 - 1 <= a implies 0 < rl implies rl <= 1 implies 1 <= rh implies rl < rh implies magnitude(gamma-function(z) - cc-int(gamma-integrand(z), rl, rh)) <= cc-exp(s0 * log(rl)) * recip(s0) + 2 * cc-exp(a * (log(2 * a) - 1) - num(1/2) * rh))
- `gamma-truncation-holomorphic` — forall([p, q], p in rr implies q in rr implies 0 < p implies p < q implies holomorphic-on({gmu_ in cc: 0 < real-part(gmu_)}, vnb-lambda(gmx_, {gmu_ in cc: 0 < real-part(gmu_)}, cc-int(gamma-integrand(gmx_), p, q))))
- `gamma-truncation-quadratic` — forall([a, x, p, q], a in cc implies x in cc implies p in rr implies q in rr implies 0 < p implies p < q implies magnitude(x - a) * (abs(log(p)) + abs(log(q))) <= 1 implies magnitude(cc-int(gamma-integrand(x), p, q) - cc-int(gamma-integrand(a), p, q) - (x - a) * cc-int(vnb-lambda(gmw_, {gmu_ in cc: 0 < real-part(gmu_)}, (cc-exp((a - 1) * cc-log(gmw_)) * cc-exp(-gmw_)) * cc-log(gmw_)), p, q)) <= (q - p) * ((cc-exp(abs(real-part(a) - 1) * (abs(log(p)) + abs(log(q)))) * ((abs(log(p)) + abs(log(q))) * (abs(log(p)) + abs(log(q))))) * (magnitude(x - a) * magnitude(x - a))))
- `gauge-countable-not-metrizable-witness` — forsome([s], is-gauge-countable(s) and not(is-metrizable-top-space(s)))

- `generalized-mvt` — forall([f, g, a, b], f in fun(rr, rr) and g in fun(rr, rr) and a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies forall([x in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x) and is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, g, x)) implies forall([x], x in rr and a < x and x < b implies forsome([l], is-diff-at(f, x, l)) and forsome([m], is-diff-at(g, x, m))) implies forsome([theta in rr], a < theta and theta < b and forsome([l, m], is-diff-at(f, theta, l) and is-diff-at(g, theta, m) and l * (g(b) - g(a)) = m * (f(b) - f(a)))))
- `generalized-mvt-on-interval` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([f, g], f in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies g in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies is-continuous-on(f, ccint(a, b)) implies is-continuous-on(g, ccint(a, b)) implies forall([x in ooint(a, b)], forsome([l], has-deriv-at(f, x, l))) implies forall([x in ooint(a, b)], forsome([m], has-deriv-at(g, x, m))) implies forsome([theta in ooint(a, b), l, m], has-deriv-at(f, theta, l) and has-deriv-at(g, theta, m) and l * (g(b) - g(a)) = m * (f(b) - f(a)))))
- `generates-coeff-matrix` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([n, m, u, v], u in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies v in mat(m, 1, vec(md)) implies (n = 0 implies m = 0) implies generates(md, n, u) implies forsome([cm in mat(m, n, carr(scal(md)))], v = matact(md, cm, u))))
- `generates-implies-spans-vec` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([n in nn, u in mat(n, 1, vec(md))], generates(md, n, u) implies spans(md, n, u, vec(md))))
- `generates-transport` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([n, u, pm], u in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies is-invertible-mat(scal(md), n, pm) implies generates(md, n, u) implies generates(md, n, matact(md, pm, u))))
- `geometric-expansion-uniform` — forall([u, c, r], u subset cc implies c in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies forall([aix_ in u], r <= magnitude(aix_ - c)) implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies forall([phi], forall([aix_ in u], phi(aix_) in cc) implies forall([aim_ in rr], 0 <= aim_ implies forall([aix_ in u], magnitude(phi(aix_)) <= aim_) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([aicap_ in nn], forall([k in nn], aicap_ <= k implies forall([aiy_ in u], magnitude(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(aij_, nn, (phi(aiy_) * recip(aiy_ - c) ^ succ(aij_)) * (z - c) ^ aij_), k) - phi(aiy_) * recip(aiy_ - z)) <= eps))))))))
- `geometric-partial-sum` — forall([r], r in rr and not(r = 1) implies forall([k in nn], series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(n, nn, r ^ n), k) = (1 - r ^ k) * recip(1 - r)))
- `geometric-partial-sum-mul` — forall([k in nn, r in rr], (1 - r) * series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(n, nn, r ^ n), k) = 1 - r ^ k)
- `geometric-series-converges` — forall([r in rr], 0 <= r implies r < 1 implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(n, nn, r ^ n)))
- `geometric-series-converges-to` — forall([r], r in rr and abs(r) < 1 implies series-converges-to(vnb-lambda(n, nn, r ^ n), recip(1 - r)))
- `gmvt-aux-cont` — forall([f, g, a, b, x], a in rr implies b in rr implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, g, x) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, vnb-lambda(z, rr, f(z) * (g(b) - g(a)) - g(z) * (f(b) - f(a))), x))
- `gmvt-aux-diff` — forall([f, g, a, b, x, l, m], a in rr implies b in rr implies is-diff-at(f, x, l) implies is-diff-at(g, x, m) implies is-diff-at(vnb-lambda(z, rr, f(z) * (g(b) - g(a)) - g(z) * (f(b) - f(a))), x, l * (g(b) - g(a)) - m * (f(b) - f(a))))
- `gmvt-with-known-derivative` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([f, g, itv_ in fun(ooint(a, b), rr)], f in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies is-continuous-on(f, ccint(a, b)) implies forall([x in ooint(a, b)], has-deriv-at(f, x, itv_(x))) implies g in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies is-continuous-on(g, ccint(a, b)) implies forall([x in ooint(a, b)], forsome([m], has-deriv-at(g, x, m))) implies forsome([xi in ooint(a, b), m], has-deriv-at(g, xi, m) and itv_(xi) * (g(b) - g(a)) = m * (f(b) - f(a)))))
- `gof-in-fun` — forall([m, f, g], is-bounded-linear-functional(m, g) implies f in fun(rr, vec(m)) implies compose(g, f) in fun(rr, rr))
- `gof-nth-deriv-dfun` — forall([m, f, g, n, t], is-bounded-linear-functional(m, g) implies f in fun(rr, vec(m)) implies n in nn implies t in rr implies forall([j_], j_ in nn and j_ <= n implies nth-deriv-v(m, f, j_) in fun(rr, vec(m))) implies is-diff-at-v(m, nth-deriv-v(m, f, n), t, (nth-deriv-v(m, f, succ(n)))(t)) implies (nth-deriv(compose(g, f), succ(n)))(t) = g((nth-deriv-v(m, f, succ(n)))(t)))
- `gof-taylor-diff-dfun` — forall([m, f, g, a, x, n], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies is-bounded-linear-functional(m, g) implies f in fun(rr, vec(m)) implies n in nn implies taylor-differentiable-v(m, f, a, x, n) implies forall([j_], j_ in nn and j_ <= n implies nth-deriv-v(m, f, j_) in fun(rr, vec(m))) implies taylor-differentiable(compose(g, f), a, x, n))
- `good-step` — forall([m, s, f, t, x], is-normed-vector-space(m) and is-bounded-linear-functional-on(m, s, f) and good-sub(m, s, f, t) and x in vec(m) and not(x in t) implies good-sub(m, s, f, span-add-one(m, t, x)))
- `good-sub-in-power` — forall([m], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies forall([s, f, t], good-sub(m, s, f, t) implies t in power(vec(m))))

- `goursat-nest` — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc], conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) subset u implies forsome([gouw_ in cc], (0 <= real-part(gouw_) and 0 <= imag-part(gouw_) and real-part(gouw_) + imag-part(gouw_) <= 1) and forall([goun_ in nn], forsome([goux_, gouy_, gouz_], goux_ in cc and gouy_ in cc and gouz_ in cc and (0 <= real-part(goux_) and 0 <= imag-part(goux_) and real-part(goux_) + imag-part(goux_) <= 1) and (0 <= real-part(gouy_) and 0 <= imag-part(gouy_) and real-part(gouy_) + imag-part(gouy_) <= 1) and (0 <= real-part(gouz_) and 0 <= imag-part(gouz_) and real-part(gouz_) + imag-part(gouz_) <= 1) and (magnitude(gouy_ - goux_) + magnitude(gouz_ - gouy_)) + magnitude(goux_ - gouz_) <= 6 * recip(2 ^ goun_) and magnitude(goux_ - gouw_) <= 12 * recip(2 ^ goun_) and magnitude(tri-int(f, goua_, goub_, gouc_)) <= 4 ^ goun_ * magnitude(tri-int(f, (real-part(goux_) * goua_ + imag-part(goux_) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(goux_) - imag-part(goux_)) * gouc_, (real-part(gouy_) * goua_ + imag-part(gouy_) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(gouy_) - imag-part(gouy_)) * gouc_, (real-part(gouz_) * goua_ + imag-part(gouz_) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(gouz_) - imag-part(gouz_)) * gouc_)))))))
- `goursat-triangle` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([goua_ in u, goub_ in u, gouc_ in u], conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) subset u implies tri-int(f, goua_, goub_, gouc_) = 0))
- `goursat-triangle-except` — forall([u, f, goxx_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies goxx_ in u implies holomorphic-on(difference(u, singleton(goxx_)), restrict(f, difference(u, singleton(goxx_)))) implies forall([goxa_ in u, goxb_ in u, goxc_ in u], conv3(goxa_, goxb_, goxc_) subset u implies tri-int(f, goxa_, goxb_, goxc_) = 0))
- `goursat-vertex` — forall([u, f, goxx_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies goxx_ in u implies holomorphic-on(difference(u, singleton(goxx_)), restrict(f, difference(u, singleton(goxx_)))) implies forall([goxb_ in u, goxc_ in u], conv3(goxx_, goxb_, goxc_) subset u implies tri-int(f, goxx_, goxb_, goxc_) = 0))
- `greedy-chain-is-chain` — forall([phi, grd, porel], is-partial-order(grd, porel) implies is-chain(grd, porel, greedy-chain(phi, grd, porel)))
- `grid-cell-close-nonneg` — forall([r, n, x, y], pos-rr(r) implies n in nn implies x in complement-in({mhx_ in rr: n * r <= mhx_}, {mhx_ in rr: n * r + r <= mhx_}) implies y in complement-in({mhx_ in rr: n * r <= mhx_}, {mhx_ in rr: n * r + r <= mhx_}) implies abs(x - y) < r)

- `grid-cell-cover-nonneg` — forall([r], pos-rr(r) implies forall([x in rr], 0 <= x implies forsome([n in nn], x in complement-in({mhx_ in rr: n * r <= mhx_}, {mhx_ in rr: n * r + r <= mhx_}))))
- `grid-cell-cover-nonpos` — forall([r], pos-rr(r) implies forall([x in rr], x <= 0 implies forsome([n in nn], x in complement-in({mhx_ in rr: mhx_ <= -(n * r)}, {mhx_ in rr: mhx_ <= -(n * r + r)}))))
- `grid-staircase-simple` — forall([omega, ca, f], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) implies forall([n in nn], is-simple-fn(omega, ca, vnb-lambda(sx_, omega, esup(image(vnb-lambda(sk_, nn, sk_ * num(1/2) ^ n), {sq_ in nn: sq_ * num(1/2) ^ n <= f(sx_) and sq_ * num(1/2) ^ n <= n}))))))
- `grid-staircase-value` — forall([n in nn, fx in rr-pos-star], forsome([m in nn], m in {sq_ in nn: sq_ * num(1/2) ^ n <= fx and sq_ * num(1/2) ^ n <= n} and esup(image(vnb-lambda(sk_, nn, sk_ * num(1/2) ^ n), {sq_ in nn: sq_ * num(1/2) ^ n <= fx and sq_ * num(1/2) ^ n <= n})) = m * num(1/2) ^ n and forall([z in rr], z <= fx implies z <= n implies z < m * num(1/2) ^ n + num(1/2) ^ n)))
- `group-assoc` — forall([s], is-group(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a, b), c) = (opr(s))(a, (opr(s))(b, c))))
- `group-cancel-left` — forall([s], is-group(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (opr(s))(c, a) = (opr(s))(c, b) implies a = b))

- `group-inv-in` — forall([s], is-group(s) implies forall([a in carr(s)], (inv(s))(a) in carr(s)))

- `hahn-banach` — forall([m, s, f], is-normed-vector-space(m) and is-finite-dimensional(normed-vector-space-as-module(m)) and is-submodule(m, s) and is-bounded-linear-functional-on(m, s, f) implies forsome([g_], is-linear-functional-on(m, vec(m), g_) and extends-on(s, g_, f) and forall([w_ in vec(m)], abs(g_(w_)) <= dual-norm-on(m, s, f) * (vnrm(m))(w_))))
- `hahn-banach-extend-one` — forall([m, s, f, v], is-normed-vector-space(m) and is-submodule(m, s) and is-bounded-linear-functional-on(m, s, f) and v in vec(m) and not(v in s) implies forsome([g_], is-linear-functional-on(m, span-add-one(m, s, v), g_) and extends-on(s, g_, f) and forall([w_ in span-add-one(m, s, v)], abs(g_(w_)) <= dual-norm-on(m, s, f) * (vnrm(m))(w_))))
- `hahn-banach-seminorm` — forall([m, p, s, f, fld], is-module(m) implies is-normed-field(fld) implies fld = rr-normed-field or fld = cc-normed-field implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(fld) implies is-seminorm(fld, m, p) implies is-submodule(m, s) implies is-k-linear-on(m, s, f) implies forall([x in s], (fnrm(fld))(f(x)) <= p(x)) implies forsome([ff], is-k-linear(m, ff) and extends-on(s, ff, f) and forall([x in vec(m)], (fnrm(fld))(ff(x)) <= p(x))))
- `hahn-banach-seminorm-rr` — forall([m, p, s, f], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-seminorm(rr-normed-field, m, p) implies is-submodule(m, s) implies is-k-linear-on(m, s, f) implies forall([x in s], (fnrm(rr-normed-field))(f(x)) <= p(x)) implies forsome([ff], is-k-linear(m, ff) and extends-on(s, ff, f) and forall([x in vec(m)], (fnrm(rr-normed-field))(ff(x)) <= p(x))))
- `half-magnitude` — forall([goux_ in cc], magnitude(num(1/2) * goux_) = num(1/2) * magnitude(goux_))
- `has-deriv-at-affine` — forall([hdr_], pos-rr(hdr_) implies forall([f, hdc_ in rr, hdm_ in rr, hdx_ in rr], restrict(f, ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)) in fun(ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_), rr) implies forall([hbx_ in ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)], f(hbx_) == hdc_ + hdm_ * hbx_) implies has-deriv-at(f, hdx_, hdm_)))
- `has-deriv-at-affine-chain` — forall([crr_], pos-rr(crr_) implies forall([g, h, crp_ in rr, crq_ in rr, crx_ in rr, crm_], restrict(h, ooint(crx_ - crr_, crx_ + crr_)) in fun(ooint(crx_ - crr_, crx_ + crr_), rr) implies forall([cry_ in ooint(crx_ - crr_, crx_ + crr_)], h(cry_) == g(crp_ + crq_ * cry_)) implies has-deriv-at(g, crp_ + crq_ * crx_, crm_) implies has-deriv-at(h, crx_, crm_ * crq_)))
- `has-deriv-at-chain` — forall([crr_], pos-rr(crr_) implies forall([f, g, h, crx_, crl_, crm_], restrict(h, ooint(crx_ - crr_, crx_ + crr_)) in fun(ooint(crx_ - crr_, crx_ + crr_), rr) implies forall([cry_ in ooint(crx_ - crr_, crx_ + crr_)], h(cry_) == g(f(cry_))) implies has-deriv-at(f, crx_, crl_) implies has-deriv-at(g, f(crx_), crm_) implies has-deriv-at(h, crx_, crm_ * crl_)))
- `has-deriv-at-const` — forall([hdr_], pos-rr(hdr_) implies forall([f, hdc_ in rr, hdx_ in rr], restrict(f, ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)) in fun(ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_), rr) implies forall([hbx_ in ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)], f(hbx_) == hdc_) implies has-deriv-at(f, hdx_, 0)))
- `has-deriv-at-difference` — forall([hdr_], pos-rr(hdr_) implies forall([f, g, h, hdx_, hdl_, hdm_], restrict(h, ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)) in fun(ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_), rr) implies restrict(g, ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)) in fun(ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_), rr) implies forall([hbx_ in ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)], h(hbx_) == f(hbx_) - g(hbx_)) implies has-deriv-at(f, hdx_, hdl_) implies has-deriv-at(g, hdx_, hdm_) implies has-deriv-at(h, hdx_, hdl_ - hdm_)))
- `has-deriv-at-identity` — forall([hdr_], pos-rr(hdr_) implies forall([f, hdx_ in rr], restrict(f, ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)) in fun(ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_), rr) implies forall([hbx_ in ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)], f(hbx_) == hbx_) implies has-deriv-at(f, hdx_, 1)))
- `has-deriv-at-iff-diff-at` — forall([f in fun(rr, rr), a, icl_], has-deriv-at(f, a, icl_) iff is-diff-at(f, a, icl_))
- `has-deriv-at-iff-one-sided` — forall([f, osx_, osl_], has-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) iff has-right-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) and has-left-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_))
- `has-deriv-at-iff-within-ooint` — forall([f, osx_, osl_], has-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) iff forsome([osv_], pos-rr(osv_) and has-deriv-at-within(f, ooint(osx_ - osv_, osx_ + osv_), osx_, osl_)))
- `has-deriv-at-implies-left` — forall([f, osx_, osl_], has-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) implies has-left-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_))

- `line-int-exists` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forsome([pwf_, paw_], is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part((vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), f(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)))(pat_))), a, b) and is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part((vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), f(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)))(pat_))), a, b)))
- `line-int-in-cc` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) in cc)
- `line-int-integrand-in-fun` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([pgam, dgam, pf, pad_], pgam in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies dgam in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies pf in fun(pad_, cc) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset pad_ implies vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), pf(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)) in fun(ccint(a, b), cc)))
- `line-int-interior-congruence` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([qgam in fun(ccint(a, b), cc), qdg in fun(ccint(a, b), cc)], forall([t in ccint(a, b)], qgam(t) == pgam(t)) implies forall([t in ooint(a, b)], qdg(t) == dgam(t)) implies line-int(f, qgam, qdg, a, b) = line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b)))
- `line-int-juxta` — forall([u, f, pgam1, dgam1, pgam2, dgam2, a, b, c], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam1, dgam1, a, b) implies is-road(pgam2, dgam2, b, c) implies pgam1(b) = pgam2(b) implies trace(pgam1, a, b) subset u implies trace(pgam2, b, c) subset u implies line-int(f, juxta(pgam1, pgam2, a, b, c), juxta(dgam1, dgam2, a, b, c), a, c) = line-int(f, pgam1, dgam1, a, b) + line-int(f, pgam2, dgam2, b, c))
- `line-int-length-bound` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([bnd in rr], forall([bny_ in trace(pgam, a, b)], magnitude(f(bny_)) <= bnd) implies magnitude(line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b)) <= road-length(dgam, a, b) * bnd))
- `line-int-of-derivative` — forall([u, f, df, pgam, dgam, a, b], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies df in fun(u, cc) implies forall([hbz_ in u], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, u, f, hbz_, df(hbz_))) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies line-int(df, pgam, dgam, a, b) = f(pgam(b)) - f(pgam(a)))
- `line-int-of-one` — forall([pgam, dgam, a, b, pf, pad_], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies pf in fun(pad_, cc) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset pad_ implies forall([pay_ in pad_], pf(pay_) = 1) implies line-int(pf, pgam, dgam, a, b) = pgam(b) - pgam(a))
- `line-int-of-uniform-limit` — forall([u, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([g in fun(u, cc)], forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), g, rgy_)) implies forall([fam], forall([k in nn], fam(k) in fun(u, cc)) implies forall([k in nn, rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), fam(k), rgy_)) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([aicap_ in nn], forall([k in nn], aicap_ <= k implies forall([aiy_ in trace(pgam, a, b)], magnitude((fam(k))(aiy_) - g(aiy_)) <= eps)))) implies converges-to(cc-ms, vnb-lambda(k, nn, line-int(fam(k), pgam, dgam, a, b)), line-int(g, pgam, dgam, a, b)))))
- `line-int-opposite` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([pgam, dgam, pf, pad_], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies pf in fun(pad_, cc) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset pad_ implies forall([prgb_, prdb_], prgb_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies prdb_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prgb_(pay_) == pgam(a + b - pay_)) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prdb_(pay_) == -1 * dgam(a + b - pay_)) implies forall([pwf_, paw_], is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part((vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), pf(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)))(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part((vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), pf(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)))(pat_))), a, b) implies line-int(pf, prgb_, prdb_, a, b) = -1 * line-int(pf, pgam, dgam, a, b)))))
- `line-int-opposite-road` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([lirg_, lird_], lirg_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies lird_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], lirg_(pay_) == pgam(a + b - pay_)) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], lird_(pay_) == -1 * dgam(a + b - pay_)) implies line-int(f, lirg_, lird_, a, b) = -1 * line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b)))
- `line-int-primitive-road` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forsome([wzh_], is-road(wzh_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), f(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)), a, b) and line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = wzh_(b) - wzh_(a)))
- `line-int-scalar` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([lic_ in cc, lih_ in fun(u, cc)], forall([liz_ in u], lih_(liz_) == lic_ * f(liz_)) implies line-int(lih_, pgam, dgam, a, b) = lic_ * line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b)))
- `line-int-sum` — forall([u, f, g, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies g in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), g, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([lih_ in fun(u, cc)], forall([liz_ in u], lih_(liz_) == f(liz_) + g(liz_)) implies line-int(lih_, pgam, dgam, a, b) = line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) + line-int(g, pgam, dgam, a, b)))
- `line-int-unfold` — forall([pf, pgam, dgam, a, b], line-int(pf, pgam, dgam, a, b) == cc-int(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), pf(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)), a, b))
- `line-int-value` — forall([f, pgam, dgam, a, b, lig1_, lig2_], is-primitive(lig1_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(f(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(lig2_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(f(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_))), a, b) implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = lig1_(b) - lig1_(a) + (lig2_(b) - lig2_(a)) * 1i)
- `line-is-submodule` — forall([m, v], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies v in vec(m) implies is-submodule(m, line(m, v)))
- `line-unfold` — forall([m, v], line(m, v) == {y_ in vec(m): forsome([r_ in rr], y_ = (act(m))(r_, v))})
- `linfun-app-abs-real` — forall([m, t, g, w_], is-linear-functional-on(m, t, g) implies w_ in t implies abs(g(w_)) in rr)

- `lipschitz-arrow-is-uniformly-continuous-arrow` — forall([a, b, f], is-lipschitz-arrow(a, b, f) implies is-uniformly-continuous-arrow(a, b, f))
- `list-in-msgs` — forall([t, k, l in tuples(msg-set(t, k))], lst(l) in msg-set(t, k))
