- `orl-clf` — forall([n in nn, x, l], x in clt implies l in tuples(expr-set) implies forall([mczu_ in make-set(l)], mczu_ in clt) implies n <= length(l) implies enc-orl(x, l, n) in clf)
- `orl-der` — forall([n in nn, tt, g, x, l, k], [g, enc-in(x, nth(k, l))] in derivable(tt) implies g in ctx-set implies x in clt implies l in tuples(expr-set) implies forall([mczu_ in make-set(l)], mczu_ in clt) implies k in nn implies 1 <= k implies k <= n implies n <= length(l) implies [g, enc-orl(x, l, n)] in derivable(tt))
- `orl-elim-der` — forall([n in nn, tt, g, f, x, l], g in ctx-set implies f in clf implies x in clt implies l in tuples(expr-set) implies forall([mczu_ in make-set(l)], mczu_ in clt) implies forall([mczk_ in nn], 1 <= mczk_ implies mczk_ <= n implies [ctx-add(g, enc-in(x, nth(mczk_, l))), f] in derivable(tt)) implies n <= length(l) implies [ctx-add(g, enc-orl(x, l, n)), f] in derivable(tt))
- `orthogonal-projection-additive` — forall([v, kk, pk, x_, y_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-submodule(v, kk) implies is-orthogonal-projection(v, kk, pk) implies x_ in vec(v) implies y_ in vec(v) implies pk((vadd(v))(x_, y_)) = (vadd(v))(pk(x_), pk(y_)))
- `orthogonal-projection-apply` — forall([v, kk, pk, x_], is-orthogonal-projection(v, kk, pk) implies x_ in vec(v) implies pk(x_) in kk and (vadd(v))(x_, (vneg(v))(pk(x_))) in perp(v, kk))
- `orthogonal-projection-exists` — forall([v, kk], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-submodule(v, kk) implies is-closed(ip-metric-space(v), kk) implies forsome([hpk_], is-orthogonal-projection(v, kk, hpk_)))
- `orthogonal-projection-fixes` — forall([v, kk, pk, y_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-submodule(v, kk) implies is-orthogonal-projection(v, kk, pk) implies y_ in kk implies pk(y_) = y_)
- `orthogonal-projection-homogeneous` — forall([v, kk, pk, c_, x_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-submodule(v, kk) implies is-orthogonal-projection(v, kk, pk) implies c_ in cc implies x_ in vec(v) implies pk((act(v))(c_, x_)) = (act(v))(c_, pk(x_)))
- `orthogonal-projection-idempotent` — forall([v, kk, pk, x_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-submodule(v, kk) implies is-orthogonal-projection(v, kk, pk) implies x_ in vec(v) implies pk(pk(x_)) = pk(x_))
- `orthogonal-projection-norm-le` — forall([v, kk, pk, x_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-submodule(v, kk) implies is-orthogonal-projection(v, kk, pk) implies x_ in vec(v) implies ip-norm(v, pk(x_)) <= ip-norm(v, x_))
- `orthogonal-projection-type` — forall([v, kk, pk], is-orthogonal-projection(v, kk, pk) implies pk in fun(vec(v), vec(v)))
- `orthogonal-projection-unique` — forall([v, kk, pk, qk], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-submodule(v, kk) implies is-orthogonal-projection(v, kk, pk) implies is-orthogonal-projection(v, kk, qk) implies pk = qk)
- `outer-measure-binary-subadditive` — forall([omega, mu, a_, b_], is-outer-measure(omega, mu) implies a_ in power(omega) implies b_ in power(omega) implies mu(union(a_, b_)) <= eplus(mu(a_), mu(b_)))
- `outer-measure-split-le` — forall([omega, mu, a_, es], is-outer-measure(omega, mu) implies a_ in power(omega) implies es in power(omega) implies mu(a_) <= eplus(mu(intersection(a_, es)), mu(complement-in(a_, es))))

- `pfw-open-borel` — forall([s, u], is-open(s, u) implies u in borel-sets(s))
- `pfw-pos-part-comp` — forall([omega, omega2, f, h in fun(omega, omega2)], f in fun(omega2, rr) implies forall([pwv_ in omega], (pos-part(omega, vnb-lambda(pwz_, omega, f(h(pwz_)))))(pwv_) = (vnb-lambda(pwz_, omega, (pos-part(omega2, f))(h(pwz_))))(pwv_)))

- `pivot-clears-col` — forall([a], is-euclidean-ring(a) implies forall([m, n, p, j], p in mat(m, n, carr(a)) implies 1 in interval(1, m) implies 1 in interval(1, n) implies j in interval(1, n) implies not(1 = j) implies not(entry(p, 1, 1) = zero(a)) implies forall([c], mat-equiv(a, m, n, p, c) implies forall([ii, jj], ii in interval(1, m) implies jj in interval(1, n) implies not(entry(c, ii, jj) = zero(a)) implies (gauge(a))(entry(p, 1, 1)) <= (gauge(a))(entry(c, ii, jj)))) implies forsome([q], mat-equiv(a, m, n, p, q) and entry(q, 1, 1) = entry(p, 1, 1) and entry(q, 1, j) = zero(a) and forall([ii, c], ii in interval(1, m) implies c in interval(1, n) implies not(c = j) implies entry(q, ii, c) = entry(p, ii, c)))))
- `pivot-clears-row` — forall([a], is-euclidean-ring(a) implies forall([m, n, p, i], p in mat(m, n, carr(a)) implies 1 in interval(1, m) implies 1 in interval(1, n) implies i in interval(1, m) implies not(i = 1) implies not(entry(p, 1, 1) = zero(a)) implies forall([c], mat-equiv(a, m, n, p, c) implies forall([ii, jj], ii in interval(1, m) implies jj in interval(1, n) implies not(entry(c, ii, jj) = zero(a)) implies (gauge(a))(entry(p, 1, 1)) <= (gauge(a))(entry(c, ii, jj)))) implies forsome([q], mat-equiv(a, m, n, p, q) and entry(q, 1, 1) = entry(p, 1, 1) and entry(q, i, 1) = zero(a) and forall([rw, c], rw in interval(1, m) implies c in interval(1, n) implies not(rw = i) implies entry(q, rw, c) = entry(p, rw, c)))))
- `pivot-col-reduce` — forall([a], is-euclidean-ring(a) implies forall([m, n, p, j], p in mat(m, n, carr(a)) implies 1 in interval(1, m) implies 1 in interval(1, n) implies j in interval(1, n) implies not(1 = j) implies not(entry(p, 1, 1) = zero(a)) implies forsome([q in carr(a), r in carr(a)], entry(matmul(a, p, elem-g(a, n, (neg(a))(q), 1, j)), 1, j) = r and (r = zero(a) or succ((gauge(a))(r)) <= (gauge(a))(entry(p, 1, 1))))))
- `pivot-row-reduce` — forall([a], is-euclidean-ring(a) implies forall([m, n, p, i], p in mat(m, n, carr(a)) implies 1 in interval(1, m) implies 1 in interval(1, n) implies i in interval(1, m) implies not(i = 1) implies not(entry(p, 1, 1) = zero(a)) implies forsome([q in carr(a), r in carr(a)], entry(matmul(a, elem-g(a, m, (neg(a))(q), i, 1), p), i, 1) = r and (r = zero(a) or succ((gauge(a))(r)) <= (gauge(a))(entry(p, 1, 1))))))
- `pk-space-parts` — forall([nsp], is-pk-space(nsp) implies is-infiltrated-space(pk-inf(nsp)) and is-strand-space(ispace(pk-inf(nsp))) and names(nsp) in set and pubkey(nsp) in fun(names(nsp), keys(ispace(pk-inf(nsp)))) and forall([x in names(nsp)], x in tokens(ispace(pk-inf(nsp)))) and forall([x in names(nsp)], not(x in keys(ispace(pk-inf(nsp))))) and forall([x, y], x in names(nsp) implies y in names(nsp) implies (pubkey(nsp))(x) = (pubkey(nsp))(y) implies x = y))
- `place-min-pivot` — forall([a], is-euclidean-ring(a) implies forall([m, n, p in mat(m, n, carr(a))], 1 in interval(1, m) implies 1 in interval(1, n) implies forsome([i0, j0], i0 in interval(1, m) and j0 in interval(1, n) and not(entry(p, i0, j0) = zero(a))) implies forsome([b], mat-equiv(a, m, n, p, b) and not(entry(b, 1, 1) = zero(a)) and forall([i, j], i in interval(1, m) implies j in interval(1, n) implies not(entry(p, i, j) = zero(a)) implies (gauge(a))(entry(b, 1, 1)) <= (gauge(a))(entry(p, i, j))))))

- `poly-tail-zero-fwd` — forall([a_, f_], is-ring(a_) implies f_ in carr(poly(a_)) implies forsome([n_ in nn], forall([k_ in nn], n_ <= k_ implies f_(k_) = zero(a_))))

- `pre-compose` — forall([a, b, c, u, s, s2, f, h, k], a in set implies b in set implies k in fun(a, b) implies h in fun(b, c) implies f in fun(c, u) implies f in s implies compose(f, h) in s2 implies (vnb-lambda(hmpf_, s, compose(hmpf_, compose(h, k))))(f) = (vnb-lambda(hmpf_, s2, compose(hmpf_, k)))((vnb-lambda(hmpf_, s, compose(hmpf_, h)))(f)))

- `preimage-complement` — forall([s, t, f, u], is-metric-space(s) and is-metric-space(t) and f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) implies preimage(s, f, complement-in(pts(t), u)) = complement-in(pts(s), preimage(s, f, u)))
- `preimage-in-power` — forall([s], pts(s) in set implies forall([fqf_, vqu_], preimage(s, fqf_, vqu_) in power(pts(s))))
- `preimage-subspace-open` — forall([s, t, fqf_], is-continuous(s, t, fqf_) implies forall([bqb_], bqb_ subset pts(t) implies forall([zqp_ in pts(s)], fqf_(zqp_) in bqb_) implies forall([wqu_], is-open(subspace-ms(t, bqb_), wqu_) implies is-open(s, preimage(s, fqf_, wqu_)))))
- `primitive-continuous` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies is-continuous-on(pwf_, ccint(a, b)))
- `primitive-endpoints` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies a in rr and b in rr and a < b)
- `primitive-exceptional-set` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies forsome([rqs_], is-countable(rqs_) and rqs_ subset ccint(a, b) and forall([rqt_ in ooint(a, b)], not(rqt_ in rqs_) implies has-deriv-at(pwf_, rqt_, pphi_(rqt_)))))
- `primitive-family-deriv-at` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([gfam in fun(nn, fun(ccint(a, b), rr)), ffam in fun(nn, fun(ccint(a, b), rr)), pufc_ in fun(rr, rr), put_ in ooint(a, b), pulv_ in rr], forall([puk_ in nn], is-primitive(gfam(puk_), ffam(puk_), a, b)) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([pun_ in nn], forall([puk_ in nn, pul_ in nn], pun_ <= puk_ implies pun_ <= pul_ implies forall([pux_ in ccint(a, b)], abs((ffam(puk_))(pux_) - (ffam(pul_))(pux_)) <= eps)))) implies forall([pux_ in ccint(a, b)], converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(puk_, nn, (gfam(puk_))(pux_)), pufc_(pux_))) implies forall([puk_ in nn], has-deriv-at(gfam(puk_), put_, (ffam(puk_))(put_))) implies converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(puk_, nn, (ffam(puk_))(put_)), pulv_) implies is-diff-at(pufc_, put_, pulv_)))
- `primitive-family-limit` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([gfam in fun(nn, fun(ccint(a, b), rr)), ffam in fun(nn, fun(ccint(a, b), rr))], forall([puk_ in nn], is-primitive(gfam(puk_), ffam(puk_), a, b)) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([pun_ in nn], forall([puk_ in nn, pul_ in nn], pun_ <= puk_ implies pun_ <= pul_ implies forall([pux_ in ccint(a, b)], abs((ffam(puk_))(pux_) - (ffam(pul_))(pux_)) <= eps)))) implies forall([puk_ in nn], (gfam(puk_))(a) = 0) implies forsome([pufc_ in fun(rr, rr)], forall([pux_ in ccint(a, b)], converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(puk_, nn, (gfam(puk_))(pux_)), pufc_(pux_))) and forall([put_ in rr], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, pufc_, put_)))))
- `primitive-family-normalised-choice` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, rhpff_], forall([rhpk_ in nn], forsome([rhpg_], is-primitive(rhpg_, rhpff_(rhpk_), a, b))) implies forsome([rhpgf_ in fun(nn, fun(ccint(a, b), rr))], forall([rhpk_ in nn], is-primitive(rhpgf_(rhpk_), rhpff_(rhpk_), a, b) and (rhpgf_(rhpk_))(a) = 0)))
- `primitive-glue` — forall([a in rr, c in rr, b in rr], a < c implies c < b implies forall([g1, f1, g2, f2], is-primitive(g1, f1, a, c) implies is-primitive(g2, f2, c, b) implies g1(c) = g2(c) implies forall([g in fun(ccint(a, b), rr), f in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], forall([t in ccint(a, c)], g(t) == g1(t)) implies forall([t in ccint(c, b)], g(t) == g2(t)) implies forall([t in ooint(a, c)], f(t) == f1(t)) implies forall([t in ooint(c, b)], f(t) == f2(t)) implies is-primitive(g, f, a, b))))
- `primitive-in-fun` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies pwf_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr))
- `primitive-integrand-in-fun` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr))
- `primitive-integrand-interior-congruence` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, ppsi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies ppsi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([pay_ in ooint(a, b)], pphi_(pay_) == ppsi_(pay_)) implies is-primitive(pwf_, ppsi_, a, b))
- `primitive-of-constant-piece` — forall([u in rr, v in rr], u < v implies forall([f in fun(rr, rr), cv in rr, k in rr], forall([t_], t_ in rr and u < t_ and t_ < v implies f(t_) = cv) implies is-primitive(vnb-lambda(pgs_, ccint(u, v), k + cv * (pgs_ - u)), restrict(f, ccint(u, v)), u, v)))
- `primitive-pair-lipschitz` — forall([a, b, pug1_, puf1_, pug2_, puf2_, pum_ in rr], is-primitive(pug1_, puf1_, a, b) implies is-primitive(pug2_, puf2_, a, b) implies forall([pux_ in ccint(a, b)], abs(puf1_(pux_) - puf2_(pux_)) <= pum_) implies forall([pux_ in ccint(a, b), puy_ in ccint(a, b)], pux_ < puy_ implies abs(pug1_(puy_) - pug2_(puy_) - (pug1_(pux_) - pug2_(pux_))) <= pum_ * (puy_ - pux_)))
- `primitive-pair-lipschitz-abs` — forall([a, b, pug1_, puf1_, pug2_, puf2_, pum_ in rr], is-primitive(pug1_, puf1_, a, b) implies is-primitive(pug2_, puf2_, a, b) implies forall([pux_ in ccint(a, b)], abs(puf1_(pux_) - puf2_(pux_)) <= pum_) implies forall([pux_ in ccint(a, b), puy_ in ccint(a, b)], abs(pug1_(puy_) - pug2_(puy_) - (pug1_(pux_) - pug2_(pux_))) <= pum_ * abs(puy_ - pux_)))
- `primitive-shift-const` — forall([rhpg_, rhpf_, a, b, rhpc_ in rr], is-primitive(rhpg_, rhpf_, a, b) implies is-primitive(vnb-lambda(rhpy_, ccint(a, b), rhpg_(rhpy_) - rhpc_), rhpf_, a, b))
- `primitive-uniform-limit` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([gfam in fun(nn, fun(ccint(a, b), rr)), ffam in fun(nn, fun(ccint(a, b), rr)), f in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], forall([puk_ in nn], is-primitive(gfam(puk_), ffam(puk_), a, b)) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([pun_ in nn], forall([puk_ in nn], pun_ <= puk_ implies forall([pux_ in ccint(a, b)], abs((ffam(puk_))(pux_) - f(pux_)) <= eps)))) implies forall([puk_ in nn], (gfam(puk_))(a) = 0) implies forsome([pug_], is-primitive(pug_, f, a, b) and forall([pux_ in ccint(a, b)], converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(puk_, nn, (gfam(puk_))(pux_)), pug_(pux_))))))
- `principal-ideal-in-ideal` — forall([s, i, b], is-ideal(s, i) implies b in i implies forall([x in principal-ideal(s, b)], x in i))
- `prod-lam-in-fun` — forall([g, h], g in fun(rr, rr) implies h in fun(rr, rr) implies vnb-lambda(x, rr, g(x) * h(x)) in fun(rr, rr))
- `prod-of-sums-expansion` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x], x in set and card(x) in nn implies forall([a in fun(x, carr(r)), b in fun(x, carr(r))], prod-ring(r, vnb-lambda(k, x, (add(r))(a(k), b(k))), x) = finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(r), vnb-lambda(s, power(x), (mul(r))(prod-ring(r, a, s), prod-ring(r, b, difference(x, s)))), power(x)))))
- `prod-of-sums-ptwise` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([w in set], card(w) in nn implies forall([a_], forall([z_ in w], a_(z_) in carr(r)) implies forall([b_], forall([z_ in w], b_(z_) in carr(r)) implies prod-ring(r, vnb-lambda(kv_, w, (add(r))(a_(kv_), b_(kv_))), w) = finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(r), vnb-lambda(sv_, power(w), (mul(r))(prod-ring(r, a_, sv_), prod-ring(r, b_, difference(w, sv_)))), power(w))))))
- `prod-of-sums-summand-type` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([w in set], card(w) in nn implies forall([a_], forall([z_ in w], a_(z_) in carr(r)) implies forall([b_], forall([z_ in w], b_(z_) in carr(r)) implies forall([s_ in power(w)], (mul(r))(prod-ring(r, a_, s_), prod-ring(r, b_, difference(w, s_))) in carr(r))))))
- `prod-ord-singleton` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(m))], prod-ord(m, f, 1) = f(0)))
- `prod-ord-type` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(m)), n in nn], prod-ord(m, f, n) in carr(m)))
- `prod-ord-type-ind` — forall([n in nn, m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(m))], prod-ord(m, f, n) in carr(m)))
- `prod-ring-congruence-q` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in set], card(x) in nn implies forall([f, g], forall([z_ in x], f(z_) = g(z_)) implies prod-ring(r, f, x) == prod-ring(r, g, x))))
- `prod-ring-empty` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([f], prod-ring(r, f, empty-set) = one(r)))
- `prod-ring-insert` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x], x in set and card(x) in nn implies forall([k], k in set and not(k in x) implies forall([f in fun(union(x, pair(k, k)), carr(r))], prod-ring(r, f, union(x, pair(k, k))) = (mul(r))(prod-ring(r, f, x), f(k))))))
- `prod-ring-insert-ptwise` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in set], card(x) in nn implies forall([k_ in set], not(k_ in x) implies forall([f], forall([z_ in union(x, pair(k_, k_))], f(z_) in carr(r)) implies prod-ring(r, f, union(x, pair(k_, k_))) = (mul(r))(prod-ring(r, f, x), f(k_))))))
- `prod-ring-singleton` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in set, f in fun(pair(x, x), carr(r))], prod-ring(r, f, pair(x, x)) = f(x)))
- `prod-ring-type` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x], x in set and card(x) in nn implies forall([f in fun(x, carr(r))], prod-ring(r, f, x) in carr(r))))
- `prod-ring-type-ptwise` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in set], card(x) in nn implies forall([f], forall([z_ in x], f(z_) in carr(r)) implies prod-ring(r, f, x) in carr(r))))
- `prod-ring-type-subset` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([w in set], card(w) in nn implies forall([f], forall([z_ in w], f(z_) in carr(r)) implies forall([s_ in power(w)], prod-ring(r, f, s_) in carr(r)))))
- `prod-set-disjoint-union-defined` — forall([cm], is-comm-monoid(cm) implies forall([s1, s2, f], s1 in set and s2 in set and intersection(s1, s2) = empty-set and f in fun(union(s1, s2), carr(cm)) and card(s1) in nn and card(s2) in nn implies prod-set(cm, union(s1, s2), f) = (opr(cm))(prod-set(cm, s1, f), prod-set(cm, s2, f))))
- `prod-set-empty` — forall([cm, f], prod-set(cm, empty-set, f) == iden(cm))
- `prod-set-singleton-defined` — forall([cm], is-comm-monoid(cm) implies forall([x in set, f], f(x) in carr(cm) implies prod-set(cm, pair(x, x), f) = f(x)))
- `prod-set-type-defined` — forall([cm, x, s, f], is-comm-monoid(cm) and x in set and s subset x and f in fun(x, carr(cm)) and card(s) in nn implies prod-set(cm, s, f) in carr(cm))
- `product-carrier-coord` — forall([ms, x_ in product-carrier(ms), n_ in nn], x_(n_) in pts(ms(n_)))
- `product-carrier-unfold` — forall([ms], product-carrier(ms) == {x in fun(nn, big-union(n, nn, pts(ms(n)))): forall([n in nn], x(n) in pts(ms(n)))})
- `product-continuous-at` — forall([g, h, a], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, g, a) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, h, a) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, vnb-lambda(x, rr, g(x) * h(x)), a))
- `product-convergence-coordinatewise` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([seq in fun(nn, product-carrier(ms)), lv in product-carrier(ms)], converges-to(product-metric-w(ms, w), seq, lv) iff forall([n_ in nn], converges-to(ms(n_), vnb-lambda(k, nn, (seq(k))(n_)), lv(n_))))))
- `product-convergence-coordinatewise-bwd` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([seq in fun(nn, product-carrier(ms)), lv in product-carrier(ms)], forall([n_ in nn], converges-to(ms(n_), vnb-lambda(k, nn, (seq(k))(n_)), lv(n_))) implies converges-to(product-metric-w(ms, w), seq, lv))))
- `product-convergence-coordinatewise-fwd` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([seq in fun(nn, product-carrier(ms)), lv in product-carrier(ms)], converges-to(product-metric-w(ms, w), seq, lv) implies forall([n_ in nn], converges-to(ms(n_), vnb-lambda(k, nn, (seq(k))(n_)), lv(n_))))))
- `product-coord-from-weighted-null` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([seq in fun(nn, product-carrier(ms)), lv in product-carrier(ms), n_ in nn], converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(j_, nn, w(n_) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n_))))((seq(j_))(n_), lv(n_))), 0) implies converges-to(ms(n_), vnb-lambda(k, nn, (seq(k))(n_)), lv(n_)))))
- `product-coord-weighted-null` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([seq in fun(nn, product-carrier(ms)), lv in product-carrier(ms), n_ in nn], converges-to(ms(n_), vnb-lambda(k, nn, (seq(k))(n_)), lv(n_)) implies converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(j_, nn, w(n_) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n_))))((seq(j_))(n_), lv(n_))), 0))))
- `product-dist-in-rr` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([x in product-carrier(ms), y in product-carrier(ms)], (dist(product-metric-w(ms, w)))(x, y) in rr)))
- `product-identity-continuous` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([w2], summable-weight(w2) implies is-continuous(product-metric-w(ms, w), product-metric-w(ms, w2), vnb-lambda(x, pts(product-metric-w(ms, w)), x)))))
- `product-is-metric-space` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies is-metric-space(product-metric-w(ms, w))))
- `product-measure-apply` — forall([xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu, cs in product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb)], (product-measure(xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu))(cs) == integral(xs, ca, mu, x-section-measure(xs, ys, nu, cs)))
- `product-measure-is-measure` — forall([xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu], is-measure(xs, ca, mu) implies is-measure(ys, cb, nu) implies is-sigma-finite(xs, ca, mu) implies is-sigma-finite(ys, cb, nu) implies is-measure(cartesian(xs, ys), product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb), product-measure(xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu)))
- `product-measure-rectangle` — forall([xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu, aa, bb], is-measure(xs, ca, mu) implies is-measure(ys, cb, nu) implies aa in ca implies bb in cb implies mu(aa) in rr implies nu(bb) in rr implies (product-measure(xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu))(cartesian(aa, bb)) = etimes(mu(aa), nu(bb)))
- `product-measure-symmetric` — forall([xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu, cs], is-measure(xs, ca, mu) implies is-measure(ys, cb, nu) implies is-sigma-finite(xs, ca, mu) implies is-sigma-finite(ys, cb, nu) implies cs in product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb) implies (product-measure(xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu))(cs) = integral(ys, cb, nu, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, cs)))
- `product-metric-carrier` — forall([ms, w], pts(product-metric-w(ms, w)) == product-carrier(ms))
- `product-metric-default-summable` — summable-weight(vnb-lambda(n, nn, (/)(1, 2 ^ (n + 1))))
- `product-metric-dist-converges` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([x in product-carrier(ms), y in product-carrier(ms)], series-converges-to(vnb-lambda(n, nn, w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(x(n), y(n))), (dist(product-metric-w(ms, w)))(x, y)))))
- `product-metric-distance` — forall([ms, w, x in product-carrier(ms), y in product-carrier(ms)], (dist(product-metric-w(ms, w)))(x, y) == series-limit(vnb-lambda(n, nn, w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(x(n), y(n)))))
- `product-of-invertibles-is-invertible` — forall([a], is-ring(a) implies forall([n, u1, u2], is-invertible-mat(a, n, u1) implies is-invertible-mat(a, n, u2) implies is-invertible-mat(a, n, matmul(a, u1, u2))))
- `product-projection-continuous` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([n in nn], is-continuous(product-metric-w(ms, w), ms(n), product-proj(ms, n)))))
- `product-sigma-is-sigma-algebra` — forall([xs, ca, ys, cb], is-sigma-algebra(xs, ca) implies is-sigma-algebra(ys, cb) implies is-sigma-algebra(cartesian(xs, ys), product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb)))
- `product-sigma-unfold` — forall([xs, ca, ys, cb], product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb) == sigma-generated(cartesian(xs, ys), rectangles(xs, ca, ys, cb)))
- `product-sum-seq-in-fun` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([x in product-carrier(ms), y in product-carrier(ms), z in product-carrier(ms)], vnb-lambda(n, nn, w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(x(n), y(n)) + w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(y(n), z(n))) in fun(nn, rr))))
- `product-sum-seq-split` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([x in product-carrier(ms), y in product-carrier(ms), z in product-carrier(ms), i_ in nn], (vnb-lambda(n, nn, w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(x(n), y(n)) + w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(y(n), z(n))))(i_) = (vnb-lambda(n, nn, w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(x(n), y(n))))(i_) + (vnb-lambda(n, nn, w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(y(n), z(n))))(i_))))
- `product-term-nonneg` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([x in product-carrier(ms), y in product-carrier(ms), n_ in nn], 0 <= (vnb-lambda(n, nn, w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(x(n), y(n))))(n_))))
- `product-term-self-zero` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([x in product-carrier(ms), n_ in nn], (vnb-lambda(n, nn, w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(x(n), x(n))))(n_) = 0)))
- `product-term-seq-in-fun` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([x in product-carrier(ms), y in product-carrier(ms)], vnb-lambda(n, nn, w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(x(n), y(n))) in fun(nn, rr))))
- `product-term-sym` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([x in product-carrier(ms), y in product-carrier(ms), n_ in nn], (vnb-lambda(n, nn, w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(x(n), y(n))))(n_) <= (vnb-lambda(n, nn, w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(y(n), x(n))))(n_))))
- `product-term-triangle` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([x in product-carrier(ms), y in product-carrier(ms), z in product-carrier(ms), n_ in nn], (vnb-lambda(n, nn, w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(x(n), z(n))))(n_) <= (vnb-lambda(n, nn, w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(x(n), y(n)) + w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(y(n), z(n))))(n_))))
- `product-weighted-summable` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([x in product-carrier(ms), y in product-carrier(ms)], series-converges(vnb-lambda(n, nn, w(n) * (dist(bdd-metric(ms(n))))(x(n), y(n)))))))
- `product-weights-equivalent` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([w], summable-weight(w) implies forall([w2], summable-weight(w2) implies is-continuous(product-metric-w(ms, w), product-metric-w(ms, w2), vnb-lambda(x, pts(product-metric-w(ms, w)), x)) and is-continuous(product-metric-w(ms, w2), product-metric-w(ms, w), vnb-lambda(x, pts(product-metric-w(ms, w2)), x)))))
- `proj-in-fun` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies proj(s) in fun(pts(s), quotient(s)))
- `proj-unfold` — forall([s], proj(s) == vnb-lambda(a_, pts(s), class(s, a_)))
- `proper-subset-witness` — forall([a, b], a subset b implies not(a = b) implies forsome([x_ in b], not(x_ in a)))
- `ps-abs-term` — forall([coef in fun(nn, rr), x in rr, n in nn], abs(coef(n) * x ^ n) = abs(coef(n)) * abs(x) ^ n)
- `ps-absolute-implies-convergent` — forall([coef in fun(nn, rr), x], x in rr and ps-absolutely-converges-at(coef, x) implies ps-converges-at(coef, x))
- `ps-converges-as-series` — forall([coef in fun(nn, rr), x in rr], ps-converges-at(coef, x) iff series-converges(vnb-lambda(n, nn, coef(n) * x ^ n)))
- `ps-in-box` — forall([spa, nd, ed, x, y], [x, y] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed) implies x in nd and y in nd)
- `ps-last-step` — forall([spa, nd, ed], nd in set implies ed in power(cartesian(nd, nd)) implies forall([x, y], [x, y] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed) implies forsome([z], ([z, y] in ed or z in nd and same-strand-before(spa, z, y)) and (z = x or [x, z] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed)))))
- `ps-least` — forall([spa, nd, ed, r in power(cartesian(nd, nd))], is-prec-closed(spa, nd, ed, r) implies forall([x, y], [x, y] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed) implies [x, y] in r))
- `ps-partial-sum-as-series` — forall([coef in fun(nn, rr), x in rr, k in nn], ps-partial-sum(coef, x, k) = series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(n, nn, coef(n) * x ^ n), k))
- `ps-send` — forall([spa, nd, ed, x, y], ed in power(cartesian(nd, nd)) implies [x, y] in ed implies [x, y] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed))
- `ps-ssb` — forall([spa, nd, ed, x, y], x in nd implies y in nd implies same-strand-before(spa, x, y) implies [x, y] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed))
- `ps-trans` — forall([spa, nd, ed, x, y, z], [x, y] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed) implies [y, z] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed) implies [x, z] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed))
- `pseudometric-pos` — forall([dst, crr], is-pseudometric(dst, crr) implies forall([u in crr, v in crr], 0 <= dst(u, v)))
- `pseudometric-self-zero` — forall([dst, crr], is-pseudometric(dst, crr) implies forall([u in crr], dst(u, u) = 0))
- `pseudometric-sym` — forall([dst, crr], is-pseudometric(dst, crr) implies forall([u in crr, v in crr], dst(u, v) = dst(v, u)))
- `pseudometric-triangle` — forall([dst, crr], is-pseudometric(dst, crr) implies forall([u in crr, v in crr, w in crr], dst(u, w) <= dst(u, v) + dst(v, w)))
- `pt-set-dist-ge-elim` — forall([m], is-metric-space(m) implies forall([x, es, r], x in pts(m) implies es subset pts(m) implies r in rr-pos-star implies r <= pt-set-dist(m, x, es) implies forall([mzz_ in es], r <= (dist(m))(x, mzz_))))
- `pt-set-dist-ge-intro` — forall([m, x, es, r in rr-pos-star], forall([mzz_ in es], r <= (dist(m))(x, mzz_)) implies r <= pt-set-dist(m, x, es))
- `pt-set-dist-unfold` — forall([m, x, es], pt-set-dist(m, x, es) == einf({mov_ in rr-pos-star: forsome([moz_ in es], mov_ = (dist(m))(x, moz_))}))
- `ptwise-cauchy-compact-equicont-unif` — forall([s, fam], is-compact(s) implies fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), rr)) implies is-equicontinuous(s, rr-ms, fam) implies is-ptwise-cauchy(s, fam) implies is-unif-cauchy(s, fam))
- `ptwise-eplus-value` — forall([omega, f, g, x in omega], f(x) in rr-pos-star implies g(x) in rr-pos-star implies (ptwise-eplus(omega, f, g))(x) = eplus(f(x), g(x)))
- `ptwise-eplus-value-q` — forall([omega, g1, g2, x in omega], (ptwise-eplus(omega, g1, g2))(x) == eplus(g1(x), g2(x)))
- `ptwise-epow-value` — forall([omega, f in fun(omega, rr-pos-star), p_ in rr], 0 < p_ implies forall([x in omega], (ptwise-epow(omega, f, p_))(x) = epow(f(x), p_)))
- `ptwise-etimes-value` — forall([omega, f, g, x in omega], f(x) in rr-pos-star implies g(x) in rr-pos-star implies (ptwise-etimes(omega, f, g))(x) = etimes(f(x), g(x)))
- `ptwise-etimes-value-q` — forall([omega, g1, g2, x in omega], (ptwise-etimes(omega, g1, g2))(x) == etimes(g1(x), g2(x)))
- `ptwise-scale-measurable` — forall([omega, ca, g, k], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, g) implies k in rr implies 0 <= k implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, ptwise-scale(omega, k, g)))
- `ptwise-scale-value` — forall([omega, c_, f, x in omega], c_ in rr-pos-star implies f(x) in rr-pos-star implies (ptwise-scale(omega, c_, f))(x) = etimes(c_, f(x)))
- `ptwise-scale-value-q` — forall([omega, k, g, x in omega], (ptwise-scale(omega, k, g))(x) == etimes(k, g(x)))
- `ptwise-sup-apply` — forall([omega, cf, x in omega], (ptwise-sup(omega, cf))(x) == esup(image(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, (cf(n_))(x)), nn)))
- `pw-affine-antiderivative` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([pac_ in rr, pam_ in rr, pwf_, pphi_], pwf_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pwf_(pay_) == pac_ + pam_ * pay_) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pphi_(pay_) == pam_) implies is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b)))
- `pw-antiderivative-differ-by-constant` — forall([pwf_, paw_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, pphi_, a, b) implies forall([pbs_ in ccint(a, b)], pwf_(pbs_) = paw_(pbs_) + pwf_(a) - paw_(a)))
- `pw-antiderivative-differ-by-some-constant` — forall([pwf_, paw_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, pphi_, a, b) implies forsome([pbc_ in rr], forall([pbs_ in ccint(a, b)], pwf_(pbs_) = paw_(pbs_) + pbc_)))
- `pw-antiderivative-endpoint-difference` — forall([pwf_, paw_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, pphi_, a, b) implies pwf_(b) - pwf_(a) = paw_(b) - paw_(a))
- `pw-antiderivative-integrand-congruence` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, ppsi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies ppsi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pphi_(pay_) == ppsi_(pay_)) implies is-primitive(pwf_, ppsi_, a, b))
- `pw-antiderivative-linear` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pcc_ in rr, pdd_ in rr, pwf_, paw_, pphi_, ppsi_], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, ppsi_, a, b) implies forall([pauh_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr), pchi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pauh_(pay_) == pcc_ * pwf_(pay_) + pdd_ * paw_(pay_)) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pchi_(pay_) == pcc_ * pphi_(pay_) + pdd_ * ppsi_(pay_)) implies is-primitive(pauh_, pchi_, a, b) and pw-int(pchi_, a, b) = pcc_ * pw-int(pphi_, a, b) + pdd_ * pw-int(ppsi_, a, b)))
- `pw-antiderivative-one-piece` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([pwf_, pphi_], pwf_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies is-continuous-on(pwf_, ccint(a, b)) implies forall([pat_ in ooint(a, b)], has-deriv-at(pwf_, pat_, pphi_(pat_))) implies is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b)))
- `pw-antiderivative-real-mul` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pwf_, pphi_, pcc_ in rr], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies forall([pauh_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr), pchi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pauh_(pay_) == pcc_ * pwf_(pay_)) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pchi_(pay_) == pcc_ * pphi_(pay_)) implies is-primitive(pauh_, pchi_, a, b) and pw-int(pchi_, a, b) = pcc_ * pw-int(pphi_, a, b)))
- `pw-antiderivative-reflect` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pwf_, pphi_], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies forall([prg_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr), prk_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prg_(pay_) == pwf_(a + b - pay_)) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prk_(pay_) == -1 * pphi_(a + b - pay_)) implies is-primitive(prg_, prk_, a, b)))
- `pw-antiderivative-restrict` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pcv_ in rr, pdv_ in rr, pwf_, pphi_], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies a <= pcv_ implies pcv_ < pdv_ implies pdv_ <= b implies is-primitive(restrict(pwf_, ccint(pcv_, pdv_)), restrict(pphi_, ccint(pcv_, pdv_)), pcv_, pdv_))
- `pw-antiderivative-sum` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pwf_, paw_, pphi_, ppsi_], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, ppsi_, a, b) implies forall([pauh_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr), pchi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pauh_(pay_) == pwf_(pay_) + paw_(pay_)) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pchi_(pay_) == pphi_(pay_) + ppsi_(pay_)) implies is-primitive(pauh_, pchi_, a, b) and pw-int(pchi_, a, b) = pw-int(pphi_, a, b) + pw-int(ppsi_, a, b)))
- `pw-antiderivative-value-in-rr` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pwf_(pay_) in rr))
- `pw-continuous-endpoints` — forall([pphi_, a, b], is-pw-continuous-on(pphi_, a, b) implies a in rr and b in rr and a < b)
- `pw-continuous-in-fun` — forall([pphi_, a, b], is-pw-continuous-on(pphi_, a, b) implies pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr))
- `pw-continuous-one-piece` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], is-continuous-on(pphi_, ccint(a, b)) implies is-pw-continuous-on(pphi_, a, b)))
- `pw-continuous-reflect` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pphi_, prc_ in rr, prq_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], is-pw-continuous-on(pphi_, a, b) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prq_(pay_) == prc_ * pphi_(a + b - pay_)) implies is-pw-continuous-on(prq_, a, b))
- `pw-int-abs-bound` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, paw_, pabs_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, pabs_, a, b) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pabs_(pay_) == abs(pphi_(pay_))) implies abs(pw-int(pphi_, a, b)) <= pw-int(pabs_, a, b))
- `pw-int-adjacent` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pcv_ in ooint(a, b), pwf_, pphi_], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies pw-int(pphi_, a, b) = pw-int(restrict(pphi_, ccint(a, pcv_)), a, pcv_) + pw-int(restrict(pphi_, ccint(pcv_, b)), pcv_, b))
- `pw-int-affine-subst` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies lrpc_ < lrpd_ implies forall([pwf_, pphi_], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies forall([lrph_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), rr), lrps_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), rr)], forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrph_(lrpz_) == pwf_(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrps_(lrpz_) == lrpl_ * pphi_(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies is-primitive(lrph_, lrps_, lrpc_, lrpd_) and pw-int(lrps_, lrpc_, lrpd_) = pw-int(pphi_, a, b))))
- `pw-int-congruence` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, ppsi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies ppsi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pphi_(pay_) == ppsi_(pay_)) implies pw-int(pphi_, a, b) = pw-int(ppsi_, a, b))
- `pw-int-const` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([pac_ in rr, pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pphi_(pay_) == pac_) implies pw-int(pphi_, a, b) = pac_ * (b - a)))
- `pw-int-in-rr` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies pw-int(pphi_, a, b) in rr)
- `pw-int-interior-congruence` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, ppsi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies ppsi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([pay_ in ooint(a, b)], pphi_(pay_) == ppsi_(pay_)) implies pw-int(pphi_, a, b) = pw-int(ppsi_, a, b))
- `pw-int-monotone` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, paw_, ppsi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, ppsi_, a, b) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pphi_(pay_) <= ppsi_(pay_)) implies pw-int(pphi_, a, b) <= pw-int(ppsi_, a, b))
- `pw-int-nonneg` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], 0 <= pphi_(pay_)) implies 0 <= pw-int(pphi_, a, b))
- `pw-int-nonneg-zero` — forall([cmzf_, cmzh_, cmza_, cmzb_], is-primitive(cmzf_, cmzh_, cmza_, cmzb_) implies is-continuous-on(cmzh_, ccint(cmza_, cmzb_)) implies forall([cmzt_ in ccint(cmza_, cmzb_)], 0 <= cmzh_(cmzt_)) implies pw-int(cmzh_, cmza_, cmzb_) = 0 implies forall([cmzt_ in ccint(cmza_, cmzb_)], cmzh_(cmzt_) = 0))
- `pw-int-reflect` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pwf_, pphi_], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies forall([prh_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr), prs_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prh_(pay_) == -1 * pwf_(a + b - pay_)) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prs_(pay_) == pphi_(a + b - pay_)) implies is-primitive(prh_, prs_, a, b) and pw-int(prs_, a, b) = pw-int(pphi_, a, b)))
- `pw-int-value` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies pw-int(pphi_, a, b) = pwf_(b) - pwf_(a))
- `pw-lt-ne` — forall([pcu_ in rr, pcv_ in rr], pcu_ < pcv_ implies not(pcu_ = pcv_) and not(pcv_ = pcu_))
- `pw-nondecreasing-on-interval` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([h in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], is-continuous-on(h, ccint(a, b)) implies forall([pas_ in set], card(pas_) in nn implies forall([pat_ in ooint(a, b)], not(pat_ in pas_) implies forsome([pal_], has-deriv-at(h, pat_, pal_) and 0 <= pal_)) implies h(a) <= h(b))))
- `pw-not-in-insert` — forall([pcy_ in set, pcw_, pct_], not(pct_ in pcw_) implies not(pct_ = pcy_) implies not(pct_ in union(pcw_, pair(pcy_, pcy_))))
- `pw-restrict-continuous-on` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([f, pwf_], f in fun(rr, rr) implies forall([pay_ in rr], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, pay_)) implies pwf_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pwf_(pay_) == f(pay_)) implies is-continuous-on(pwf_, ccint(a, b))))
- `pw-step-identity` — forall([c, u, v], c in rr implies u in rr implies v in rr implies (c + 1) * (u * v) = 1 * (u * v) + u * (c * v))
- `pw-zero-deriv-off-finite-set` — forall([pas_ in set], card(pas_) in nn implies forall([pah_ in fun(rr, rr)], forall([pax_ in rr], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, pah_, pax_)) implies forall([pau_ in rr, pav_ in rr], pau_ < pav_ implies forall([pat_ in ooint(pau_, pav_)], not(pat_ in pas_) implies is-diff-at(pah_, pat_, 0)) implies pah_(pau_) = pah_(pav_))))
- `pw-zero-deriv-total` — forall([pah_ in fun(rr, rr)], forall([pax_ in rr], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, pah_, pax_)) implies forall([pau_ in rr, pav_ in rr], pau_ < pav_ implies forall([pat_ in ooint(pau_, pav_)], is-diff-at(pah_, pat_, 0)) implies pah_(pau_) = pah_(pav_)))
- `qq-add-cancel` — forall([a in qq, b in qq, c in qq], a + c = b + c implies a = b)
- `qq-dense-in-rr` — forall([eps, x], pos-rr(eps) implies x in rr implies forsome([a in qq], a - eps < x and x < a + eps))
- `qq-field-is-field` — is-field(qq-field)
- `qq-field-mul-inv-type` — vnb-lambda(x_, difference(qq, singleton(0)), recip(x_)) in fun(difference(qq, singleton(0)), difference(qq, singleton(0)))
- `qq-is-commutative-ring` — is-commutative-ring(qq-ring)
- `qq-is-integral-domain` — is-integral-domain(qq-ring)
- `qq-is-ring` — is-ring(qq-ring)
- `qq-line-is-module` — is-module(qq-line)
- `qq-line-is-vector-space` — is-vector-space(qq-line)
- `qq-nonneg-is-fraction` — forall([q], q in qq and 0 <= q implies forsome([a in nn, b in nn], not(b = 0) and q * b = a))
- `qq-recip-nonzero` — forall([a_ in qq], not(a_ = 0) implies not(recip(a_) = 0))
- `quarter-step` — forall([gbj_ in rr, gba_ in rr, gbb_ in rr, gbc_ in rr, gbd_ in rr], 0 <= gba_ implies 0 <= gbb_ implies 0 <= gbc_ implies 0 <= gbd_ implies gbj_ <= ((gba_ + gbb_) + gbc_) + gbd_ implies gbj_ <= 4 * gba_ or gbj_ <= 4 * gbb_ or gbj_ <= 4 * gbc_ or gbj_ <= 4 * gbd_)
- `quotient-is-set` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies quotient(s) in set)
- `quotient-rep` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([x in quotient(s)], forsome([a in pts(s)], x = class(s, a))))
- `quotient-unfold` — forall([s], quotient(s) == image(proj(s), pts(s)))
- `quotient-universal` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([z, f], f in fun(pts(s), z) and respects(s, f) implies forsome([g in fun(quotient(s), z)], forall([a in pts(s)], g(class(s, a)) = f(a)) and forall([g_], g_ in fun(quotient(s), z) and forall([a in pts(s)], g_(class(s, a)) = f(a)) implies g_ = g))))
- `r-exp-add` — forall([u_, v_], u_ in rr implies v_ in rr implies r-exp(u_ + v_) = r-exp(u_) * r-exp(v_))
- `r-exp-char` — forall([y_, x_], y_ in rr implies x_ in rr implies 0 < x_ implies log(x_) = y_ implies r-exp(y_) = x_)
- `r-exp-continuous-at` — forall([t_ in rr], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, vnb-lambda(y_, rr, r-exp(y_)), t_))
- `r-exp-deriv` — forall([t_ in rr], is-diff-at(vnb-lambda(y_, rr, r-exp(y_)), t_, r-exp(t_)))
- `r-exp-diff-at-log` — forall([c_, w_], c_ in rr implies w_ in rr implies 0 < c_ implies w_ = log(c_) implies is-diff-at(vnb-lambda(y_, rr, r-exp(y_)), w_, c_))
- `r-exp-ge-one-plus` — forall([rsz_ in rr], 1 + rsz_ <= r-exp(rsz_))
- `r-exp-in-rr` — forall([y_ in rr], r-exp(y_) in rr)
- `r-exp-lam-in-fun` — vnb-lambda(y_, rr, r-exp(y_)) in fun(rr, rr)
- `r-exp-log` — forall([x_ in rr], 0 < x_ implies r-exp(log(x_)) = x_)
- `r-exp-log-not-global` — not(forall([x_ in rr], r-exp(log(x_)) = x_))
- `r-exp-mono` — forall([u_, v_], u_ in rr implies v_ in rr implies u_ <= v_ implies r-exp(u_) <= r-exp(v_))
- `r-exp-neg` — forall([y_ in rr], r-exp(-y_) = recip-star(r-exp(y_)))
- `r-exp-pos` — forall([y_ in rr], 0 < r-exp(y_))
- `r-exp-prop` — forall([y_ in rr], r-exp(y_) in rr and 0 < r-exp(y_) and log(r-exp(y_)) = y_)
- `r-exp-strictly-increasing` — forall([u_, v_], u_ in rr implies v_ in rr implies u_ < v_ implies r-exp(u_) < r-exp(v_))
- `r-exp-zero` — r-exp(0) = 1
- `r12d-cross-est` — forall([m], is-metric-space(m) implies forall([bigf, rf, rad, mm], bigf in fun(nn, quotient(cauchy-setoid(m))) implies rf in fun(nn, cseq(m)) implies rad in fun(nn, rr) implies mm in fun(nn, nn) implies forall([p_ in nn], bigf(p_) = class(cauchy-setoid(m), rf(p_))) implies forall([p_ in nn, i_, j_], i_ in nn implies j_ in nn implies mm(p_) <= i_ implies mm(p_) <= j_ implies (dist(m))((rf(p_))(i_), (rf(p_))(j_)) <= rad(p_)) implies forall([p_, q_, c], p_ in nn implies q_ in nn implies c in rr implies pos-rr(c) implies mm(p_) <= q_ implies (dist(m))((rf(q_))(mm(q_)), (rf(p_))(q_)) <= (rad(q_) + rad(p_)) + ((dist(completion(m)))(bigf(q_), bigf(p_)) + c))))
- `r12d-diag-at` — forall([rf, mm, p_ in nn], (vnb-lambda(pv_, nn, (rf(pv_))(mm(pv_))))(p_) == (rf(p_))(mm(p_)))

- `road-affine-reparam` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies lrpc_ < lrpd_ implies forall([pgam, dgam, lrpr_, lrpk_], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies lrpr_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), cc) implies lrpk_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), cc) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpr_(lrpz_) == pgam(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpk_(lrpz_) == lrpl_ * dgam(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies is-road(lrpr_, lrpk_, lrpc_, lrpd_)))

- `road-length-affine-reparam` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies lrpc_ < lrpd_ implies forall([pgam, dgam, lrpk_], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies lrpk_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), cc) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpk_(lrpz_) == lrpl_ * dgam(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies road-length(lrpk_, lrpc_, lrpd_) = road-length(dgam, a, b)))

- `road-length-regulated` — forall([pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies is-regulated-on(vnb-lambda(rlt_, ccint(a, b), magnitude(dgam(rlt_))), a, b))
- `road-length-segment` — forall([p in cc, q in cc], road-length(seg-deriv(p, q), 0, 1) = magnitude(q - p))

- `road-product-constant` — forall([pgam, dgam, qgam, dqgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies is-road(qgam, dqgam, a, b) implies forall([wzt_ in ccint(a, b)], dgam(wzt_) * qgam(wzt_) + pgam(wzt_) * dqgam(wzt_) = 0) implies pgam(b) * qgam(b) = pgam(a) * qgam(a))
- `road-restrict` — forall([pgam, dgam, a, b, licv_ in rr, lidv_ in rr], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies a <= licv_ implies licv_ < lidv_ implies lidv_ <= b implies is-road(restrict(pgam, ccint(licv_, lidv_)), restrict(dgam, ccint(licv_, lidv_)), licv_, lidv_))

- `rpow-neg` — forall([a], a in rr and 0 < a implies forall([b in qq], rpow(a, 0 - b) = recip(rpow(a, b))))

- `rpow-pow` — forall([a], a in rr and 0 < a implies forall([b in qq, d in qq], rpow(rpow(a, b), d) = rpow(a, b * d)))

- `rpow-star-mono-exp` — forall([x_, s_, t_], x_ in rr implies s_ in rr implies t_ in rr implies 1 < x_ implies s_ < t_ implies rpow-star(x_, s_) < rpow-star(x_, t_))
- `rpow-star-mul-base` — forall([x_, y_, s_], x_ in rr implies y_ in rr implies s_ in rr implies 0 < x_ implies 0 < y_ implies rpow-star(x_ * y_, s_) = rpow-star(x_, s_) * rpow-star(y_, s_))
- `rpow-star-nat` — forall([cpsk_ in nn, cpsx_ in rr], 0 < cpsx_ implies rpow-star(cpsx_, cpsk_) = cpsx_ ^ cpsk_)
- `rpow-star-neg` — forall([x_, s_], x_ in rr implies s_ in rr implies 0 < x_ implies rpow-star(x_, -s_) = recip-star(rpow-star(x_, s_)))
- `rpow-star-nonneg-in-rr` — forall([cpsx_ in rr], 0 <= cpsx_ implies forall([cpss_ in rr], 0 <= cpss_ implies rpow-star(cpsx_, cpss_) in rr))
- `rpow-star-nonneg-nonneg` — forall([cpsx_ in rr], 0 <= cpsx_ implies forall([cpss_ in rr], 0 <= cpss_ implies 0 <= rpow-star(cpsx_, cpss_)))
- `rpow-star-one` — forall([x_ in rr], 0 < x_ implies rpow-star(x_, 1) = x_)

- `rpow-zero` — forall([a], a in rr and 0 < a implies rpow(a, 0) = 1)

- `rps-finsum-fiber-le` — forall([ofs, oft, ofp, off, ofg], ofs in set implies card(ofs) in nn implies oft in set implies card(oft) in nn implies forall([z_ in ofs], ofp(z_) in oft) implies forall([z_ in ofs], off(z_) in rr-pos-star) implies forall([z_ in oft], ofg(z_) in rr-pos-star) implies forall([z_ in oft], finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, off, {ofw_ in ofs: ofp(ofw_) = z_}) <= ofg(z_)) implies finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, off, ofs) <= finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, ofg, oft))

- `rps-finsum-mono-set` — forall([f, s, t in set], card(t) in nn implies s subset t implies forall([z_ in t], f(z_) in rr-pos-star) implies finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, s) <= finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, t))
- `rps-finsum-scale-ptwise` — forall([c in rr], 0 <= c implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f, h], forall([z_ in s], f(z_) in rr-pos-star) implies forall([z_ in s], h(z_) = etimes(c, f(z_))) implies finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, h, s) = etimes(c, finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, s)))))
- `rps-le-of-forall-eps` — forall([x, y], x in rr-pos-star implies y in rr implies 0 <= y implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies x <= eplus(y, eps)) implies x <= y)

- `rps-prefix-bump` — forall([n_ in nn, k, f, g, c_], k in nn implies f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies g in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies c_ in rr-pos-star implies forall([q in nn], f(q) <= g(q)) implies eplus(f(k), c_) <= g(k) implies k < n_ implies eplus(finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, ord-segment(n_)), c_) <= finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, g, ord-segment(n_)))
- `rps-prefix-even-odd` — forall([n in nn, f, g, h], f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies g in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies h in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies forall([q in nn], g(q) = f(2 * q)) implies forall([q in nn], h(q) = f(succ(2 * q))) implies finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, ord-segment(2 * n)) = eplus(finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, g, ord-segment(n)), finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, h, ord-segment(n))))

- `rps-prefix-mono-range` — forall([f, m_, n_], f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies m_ in nn implies n_ in nn implies m_ <= n_ implies finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, ord-segment(m_)) <= finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, ord-segment(n_)))
- `rps-prefix-shift-le` — forall([k in nn, n in nn, f, g], f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies g in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies forall([j in nn], g(j) <= f(n + j)) implies eplus(finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, ord-segment(n)), finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, g, ord-segment(k))) <= finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, ord-segment(n + k)))
- `rps-prefix-succ` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star), n in nn], finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, ord-segment(succ(n))) = eplus(finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, ord-segment(n)), f(n)))

- `rq-mul-computes` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies forall([a, b], a in carr(r) implies b in carr(r) implies (mul(ringoid-quotient-ring(r)))(class(ringoid-setoid(r), a), class(ringoid-setoid(r), b)) = class(ringoid-setoid(r), (mul(r))(a, b))))
- `rq-neg-computes` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies forall([a in carr(r)], (neg(ringoid-quotient-ring(r)))(class(ringoid-setoid(r), a)) = class(ringoid-setoid(r), (neg(r))(a))))

- `rr-abs-of-nonpos` — forall([x in rr], x <= 0 implies abs(x) = -x)

- `rr-sub-in-rr` — forall([u, v], u in rr implies v in rr implies u - v in rr)
- `rr-sub-ne-zero` — forall([u in rr, v in rr], not(u = v) implies not(u - v = 0))
- `rr-subseq-converges-abs` — forall([wcvb_, wcvg_], strictly-mono-nn(wcvg_) implies forall([wcvq_], converges-to(rr-ms, subseq(wcvb_, wcvg_), wcvq_) implies forall([wcve_], pos-rr(wcve_) implies forsome([wcvn_ in nn], forall([wcvj_ in nn], wcvn_ <= wcvj_ implies abs(wcvb_(wcvg_(wcvj_)) - wcvq_) <= wcve_)))))
- `rr-subset-nf-pts` — rr subset pts(nf-metric-space(rr-normed-field))
- `rr-subset-rr-star` — rr subset rr-star
- `rr-sup-approx` — forall([s_, d_], s_ subset rr implies forsome([x_], x_ in s_) implies rr-bounded-above(s_) implies d_ in rr implies 0 < d_ implies forsome([w_ in s_], sup(s_) - d_ < w_))
- `rr-upper-of-two` — forall([u, v], u in rr implies v in rr implies forsome([w_ in rr], u <= w_ and v <= w_))
- `rr-upper-of-two-below` — forall([u, v, m], u in rr implies v in rr implies m in rr implies u < m implies v < m implies forsome([w_ in rr], u <= w_ and v <= w_ and w_ < m))
- `rr-young-2` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a * b <= (/)(a * a + b * b, 2))
- `rr-zero-lt-one` — 0 < 1
- `rr-zero-lt-two` — 0 < 2
- `rr-zero-mul` — forall([v in rr], 0 * v = 0)
- `rr-zero-plus` — forall([t_ in rr], 0 + t_ = t_)
- `rw-univ-ctx` — forall([kk, g, a, b], [kk, g, a, b] in rw-univ implies g in ctx-set)
- `rw-univ-is-set` — rw-univ in set
- `scale-continuous-at` — forall([c in rr, f, a], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, a) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, vnb-lambda(x, rr, c * f(x)), a))
- `scale-lam-in-fun` — forall([c, f], c in rr implies f in fun(rr, rr) implies vnb-lambda(x, rr, c * f(x)) in fun(rr, rr))
- `seg-curve-apply` — forall([m, f, a, eta, t_ in rr], (seg-curve(m, f, a, eta))(t_) == f((vadd(m))(a, (act(m))(t_, eta))))
- `seg-curve-diff-at` — forall([m], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies forall([f in fun(vec(m), rr), b_ in vec(m), eta in vec(m), s_ in rr, k_], is-dir-diff-at(m, f, (vadd(m))(b_, (act(m))(s_, eta)), eta, k_) implies is-diff-at(seg-curve(m, f, b_, eta), s_, k_)))
- `seg-curve-in-fun` — forall([m, f, a, eta], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies f in fun(vec(m), rr) implies a in vec(m) implies eta in vec(m) implies seg-curve(m, f, a, eta) in fun(rr, rr))
- `seg-deriv-bridge` — forall([goua_, goub_, gouw_], goub_ - goua_ = gouw_ implies seg-deriv(goua_, goub_) == vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), gouw_))
- `seg-image-insert` — forall([n_ in nn, b_, g_ in bijection(ord-segment(succ(n_)), b_)], b_ = union(image(g_, ord-segment(n_)), pair(g_(n_), g_(n_))))
- `seg-image-omits-top` — forall([n_ in nn, b_, g_ in bijection(ord-segment(succ(n_)), b_)], not(g_(n_) in image(g_, ord-segment(n_))))
- `seg-image-subset` — forall([n_ in nn, b_, g_ in bijection(ord-segment(succ(n_)), b_), w_ in image(g_, ord-segment(n_))], w_ in b_)
- `seg-int-abs-bound` — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc], trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) subset u implies forall([goum_ in rr], forall([gouz_ in trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1)], magnitude(f(gouz_)) <= goum_) implies magnitude(seg-int(f, goua_, goub_)) <= magnitude(goub_ - goua_) * goum_)))
- `seg-int-bridge` — forall([f, goua_, goub_, goup_, gouw_], goua_ = goup_ implies goub_ - goua_ = gouw_ implies seg-int(f, goua_, goub_) == line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), goup_ + psx_ * gouw_), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), gouw_), 0, 1))
- `seg-int-congruence` — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([goxw_, goxg_ in fun(goxw_, cc), goxa_ in cc, goxb_ in cc], trace(seg-path(goxa_, goxb_), 0, 1) subset u implies trace(seg-path(goxa_, goxb_), 0, 1) subset goxw_ implies forall([goxz_ in trace(seg-path(goxa_, goxb_), 0, 1)], goxg_(goxz_) == f(goxz_)) implies seg-int(goxg_, goxa_, goxb_) = seg-int(f, goxa_, goxb_)))
- `seg-int-const` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([goup_ in cc, gouw_ in cc, goug_ in fun(u, cc)], forall([gouz_ in u], goug_(gouz_) == goup_ + 0 * (gouz_ - gouw_)) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc], trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) subset u implies seg-int(goug_, goua_, goub_) = goup_ * (goub_ - goua_))))
- `seg-int-degenerate` — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([gouz_ in u], seg-int(f, gouz_, gouz_) = 0))
- `seg-int-in-cc` — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc], trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) subset u implies seg-int(f, goua_, goub_) in cc))
- `seg-int-reverse-at` — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc], trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) subset u implies seg-int(f, goub_, goua_) = -1 * seg-int(f, goua_, goub_)))
- `seg-int-split-at` — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc], trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) subset u implies forall([gouc_ in trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1)], seg-int(f, goua_, goub_) = seg-int(f, goua_, gouc_) + seg-int(f, gouc_, goub_))))
- `seg-int-sum` — forall([u, f, g], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies g in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), g, rgy_)) implies forall([gouh_ in fun(u, cc)], forall([gouz_ in u], gouh_(gouz_) == f(gouz_) + g(gouz_)) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc], trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) subset u implies seg-int(gouh_, goua_, goub_) = seg-int(f, goua_, goub_) + seg-int(g, goua_, goub_))))
- `seg-int-unfold` — forall([f, goua_, goub_], seg-int(f, goua_, goub_) == line-int(f, seg-path(goua_, goub_), seg-deriv(goua_, goub_), 0, 1))
- `seg-mem-lt` — forall([n_ in nn, j_ in nn], j_ in ord-segment(n_) iff j_ < n_)
- `seg-mem-succ-le` — forall([n_ in nn, j_ in nn], j_ in ord-segment(succ(n_)) iff j_ <= n_)
- `seg-path-apply` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gout_ in ccint(0, 1)], (seg-path(goua_, goub_))(gout_) = goua_ + gout_ * (goub_ - goua_))
- `seg-path-bridge` — forall([goua_, goub_, goup_, gouw_], goua_ = goup_ implies goub_ - goua_ = gouw_ implies seg-path(goua_, goub_) == vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), goup_ + psx_ * gouw_))
- `seg-path-is-road` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc], is-road(seg-path(goua_, goub_), seg-deriv(goua_, goub_), 0, 1))
- `seg-perm-restrict-is-bijection` — forall([n in nn, phi in bijection(ord-segment(succ(n)), ord-segment(succ(n))), k], phi(n) = k implies vnb-lambda(i_, ord-segment(n), if(phi(i_) = n, k, phi(i_))) in bijection(ord-segment(n), ord-segment(n)))
- `seg-restrict-is-bijection` — forall([n_ in nn, b_, g_ in bijection(ord-segment(succ(n_)), b_)], vnb-lambda(i_, ord-segment(n_), g_(i_)) in bijection(ord-segment(n_), image(g_, ord-segment(n_))))
- `seg-shift-is-road` — forall([p in cc, q in cc, k in rr, m in rr], m = k + 1 implies is-road(vnb-lambda(trs_, ccint(k, m), (seg-path(p, q))(trs_ - k)), vnb-lambda(trs_, ccint(k, m), (seg-deriv(p, q))(trs_ - k)), k, m))
- `seg-shift-length` — forall([p in cc, q in cc, k in rr, m in rr], m = k + 1 implies road-length(vnb-lambda(trs_, ccint(k, m), (seg-deriv(p, q))(trs_ - k)), k, m) = magnitude(q - p))
- `seg-shift-line-int` — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([p in cc, q in cc, k in rr, m in rr], m = k + 1 implies trace(seg-path(p, q), 0, 1) subset u implies line-int(f, vnb-lambda(trs_, ccint(k, m), (seg-path(p, q))(trs_ - k)), vnb-lambda(trs_, ccint(k, m), (seg-deriv(p, q))(trs_ - k)), k, m) = line-int(f, seg-path(p, q), seg-deriv(p, q), 0, 1)))
- `seg-shift-trace` — forall([p in cc, q in cc, k in rr, m in rr], m = k + 1 implies trace(vnb-lambda(trs_, ccint(k, m), (seg-path(p, q))(trs_ - k)), k, m) = trace(seg-path(p, q), 0, 1))
- `seg-trace-bridge` — forall([goua_, goub_, goup_, gouw_], goua_ = goup_ implies goub_ - goua_ = gouw_ implies trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) == trace(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), goup_ + psx_ * gouw_), 0, 1))
- `seg-trace-elim` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouz_ in trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1)], forsome([gout_ in ccint(0, 1)], gouz_ = goua_ + gout_ * (goub_ - goua_)))
- `seg-trace-in-conv3` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc], trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) and trace(seg-path(goub_, gouc_), 0, 1) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) and trace(seg-path(gouc_, goua_), 0, 1) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_))
- `seg-trace-in-convex` — forall([u], is-convex-cc(u) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc], goua_ in u implies goub_ in u implies trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1) subset u))
- `seg-trace-intro` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gout_ in ccint(0, 1)], goua_ + gout_ * (goub_ - goua_) in trace(seg-path(goua_, goub_), 0, 1))
- `seg0-empty` — empty-set = ord-segment(0)
- `segment-int-abs-bound` — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([pz0_ in cc, pzw_ in cc], trace(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), 0, 1) subset u implies forall([lrpn_ in rr], forall([lrpy_ in trace(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), 0, 1)], magnitude(f(lrpy_)) <= lrpn_) implies magnitude(line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pzw_), 0, 1)) <= magnitude(pzw_) * lrpn_)))
- `segment-int-reverse` — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([pz0_ in cc, pzw_ in cc], trace(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), 0, 1) subset u implies line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), (pz0_ + pzw_) + psx_ * (-1 * pzw_)), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), -1 * pzw_), 0, 1) = -1 * line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pzw_), 0, 1)))
- `segment-int-split` — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([pz0_ in cc, pzw_ in cc, lrpt_ in ooint(0, 1)], trace(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), 0, 1) subset u implies line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pzw_), 0, 1) = line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * (lrpt_ * pzw_)), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), lrpt_ * pzw_), 0, 1) + line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), (pz0_ + lrpt_ * pzw_) + psx_ * ((1 - lrpt_) * pzw_)), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), (1 - lrpt_) * pzw_), 0, 1)))
- `segment-is-road` — forall([pz0_, pzw_], pz0_ in cc implies pzw_ in cc implies is-road(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pzw_), 0, 1))
- `semigroup-assoc` — forall([s], is-semigroup(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a, b), c) = (opr(s))(a, (opr(s))(b, c))))
- `sends-to-dirs` — forall([spa, x, y], sends-to(spa, x, y) implies is-sent(spa, x) and is-received(spa, y) and node-content(spa, x) = node-content(spa, y))
- `sent-ne-received` — not(sent = received)
- `sent-received-in-pair` — sent in pair(sent, received) and received in pair(sent, received)
- `sep-fiber-insert-other` — forall([s, x, phi, z], x in set implies not(phi(x) = z) implies {fw_ in union(s, pair(x, x)): phi(fw_) = z} = {fw_ in s: phi(fw_) = z})
- `sep-fiber-insert-same` — forall([s, x, phi], x in set implies phi(x) in set implies {fw_ in union(s, pair(x, x)): phi(fw_) = phi(x)} = union({fw_ in s: phi(fw_) = phi(x)}, pair(x, x)))
- `separate-trace-exists` — forall([spa, l], is-strand-space(spa) implies l in tuples(msg-set(tokens(spa), keys(spa))) implies forsome([s in strands(tokens(spa), keys(spa))], is-separate-trace(spa, s)))
- `separate-trace-no-origin` — forall([spa, u, n], is-strand-space(spa) implies n in nodes(spa) implies is-separate-trace(spa, (strand-map(spa))(nth(2, n))) implies not(originates(spa, u, n)))
- `seq-compact-countable-product` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([n in nn], seq-compact(ms(n))) implies seq-compact(product-metric(ms)))
- `seq-compact-image` — forall([md, mt, cmf_], is-metric-space(md) implies is-metric-space(mt) implies is-continuous(md, mt, cmf_) implies seq-compact(md) implies seq-compact(subspace-ms(mt, image(cmf_, pts(md)))))
- `seq-compact-implies-compact` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies seq-compact(s) implies is-compact(s))
- `seq-compact-implies-totally-bounded` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies seq-compact(s) implies totally-bounded(s))
- `seq-iff` — forall([g, f], [g, f] in seq-set iff g in ctx-set and f in clf)
- `seq-limit-converges-to` — forall([f], converges(rr-ms, f) implies converges-to(rr-ms, f, seq-limit(f)))
- `seq-limit-in-rr` — forall([f], seq-limit(f) in rr)
- `seq-limit-value` — forall([f, lv], converges-to(rr-ms, f, lv) implies seq-limit(f) = lv)
- `seq-set-is-set` — seq-set in set
- `sequential-implies-continuous-at` — forall([s, t, f, a], is-metric-space(s) implies is-metric-space(t) implies f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) implies a in pts(s) implies forall([sq in sqn(pts(s))], converges-to(s, sq, a) implies converges-to(t, compose(f, sq), f(a))) implies is-continuous-at(s, t, f, a))
- `series-abs-converges` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([j in nn], g(j) = abs(f(j))) implies series-converges(g) implies series-converges(f))
- `series-abs-triangle` — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([j in nn], g(j) = abs(f(j))) implies abs(series-partial-sum(f, k)) <= series-partial-sum(g, k))
- `series-abs-triangle-block` — forall([d in nn, m in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([j in nn], g(j) = abs(f(j))) implies abs(series-partial-sum(f, m + d) - series-partial-sum(f, m)) <= series-partial-sum(g, m + d) - series-partial-sum(g, m))
- `series-abs-triangle-le` — forall([k in nn, m in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([j in nn], g(j) = abs(f(j))) implies m <= k implies abs(series-partial-sum(f, k) - series-partial-sum(f, m)) <= series-partial-sum(g, k) - series-partial-sum(g, m))
- `series-block-le` — forall([k in nn, n_ in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], 0 <= f(i_) and f(i_) <= g(i_)) implies n_ <= k implies series-partial-sum(f, k) - series-partial-sum(f, n_) <= series-partial-sum(g, k) - series-partial-sum(g, n_))
- `series-bounded-converges` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpsk_ in nn], 0 <= f(cpsk_)) implies forall([cpsb_ in rr], forall([cpsk_ in nn], series-partial-sum(f, cpsk_) <= cpsb_) implies series-converges(f)))
- `series-cauchy-criterion` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], series-converges(f) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([bnd in nn], forall([m in nn, n_ in nn], bnd <= m and m <= n_ implies abs(series-partial-sum(f, n_) - series-partial-sum(f, m)) <= eps))))
- `series-converges-sum` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr), h in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], 0 <= f(i_)) implies forall([i_ in nn], 0 <= g(i_)) implies forall([i_ in nn], h(i_) = f(i_) + g(i_)) implies series-converges(f) implies series-converges(g) implies series-converges(h))
- `series-converges-to-add` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr), h in fun(nn, rr), lv in rr, mv in rr], forall([i_ in nn], h(i_) = f(i_) + g(i_)) implies series-converges-to(f, lv) implies series-converges-to(g, mv) implies series-converges-to(h, lv + mv))
- `series-converges-to-converges` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), lv in rr], series-converges-to(f, lv) implies series-converges(f))
- `series-dominated-partial-bound` — forall([cpdk_ in nn, f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], 0 <= f(cpdj_)) implies forall([g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], 0 <= g(cpdj_)) implies forall([cpdn_ in nn], forall([cpdj_ in nn], cpdn_ <= cpdj_ implies f(cpdj_) <= g(cpdj_)) implies series-partial-sum(f, cpdk_) <= series-partial-sum(f, cpdn_) + series-partial-sum(g, cpdk_))))
- `series-eventually-dominated-converges` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], 0 <= f(cpdj_)) implies forall([g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], 0 <= g(cpdj_)) implies forall([cpdn_ in nn], forall([cpdj_ in nn], cpdn_ <= cpdj_ implies f(cpdj_) <= g(cpdj_)) implies series-converges(g) implies series-converges(f))))
- `series-eventually-geometric-converges` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpsk_ in nn], 0 <= f(cpsk_)) implies forall([cpsq_ in rr], 0 <= cpsq_ implies cpsq_ < 1 implies forall([cpsc_ in rr], 0 <= cpsc_ implies forall([cpsn_ in nn], forall([cpsk_ in nn], cpsn_ <= cpsk_ implies f(cpsk_) <= cpsc_ * cpsq_ ^ cpsk_) implies series-converges(f)))))
- `series-frequently-large-diverges` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), cpsc_ in rr], 0 < cpsc_ implies forall([cpsn_ in nn], forsome([cpsk_ in nn], cpsn_ <= cpsk_ and cpsc_ <= f(cpsk_))) implies not(series-converges(f)))
- `series-head-null` — forall([n_ in nn, u], forall([j_ in nn], u(j_) in fun(nn, rr)) implies forall([i_ in nn], converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(j_, nn, (u(j_))(i_)), 0)) implies forall([hd in fun(nn, rr)], forall([j_ in nn], hd(j_) = series-partial-sum(u(j_), n_)) implies converges-to(rr-ms, hd, 0)))
- `series-limit-add` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr), h in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], h(i_) = f(i_) + g(i_)) implies series-converges(f) implies series-converges(g) implies series-limit(h) = series-limit(f) + series-limit(g))
- `series-limit-converges-to` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], series-converges(f) implies series-converges-to(f, series-limit(f)))
- `series-limit-in-rr` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], series-converges(f) implies series-limit(f) in rr)
- `series-limit-iota` — forall([f], iota(l, series-converges-to(f, l)) == series-limit(f))
- `series-limit-le` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr), lv in rr, mv in rr], forall([n_ in nn], f(n_) <= g(n_)) implies series-converges-to(f, lv) implies series-converges-to(g, mv) implies lv <= mv)
- `series-nonneg-zero-sum` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([n_ in nn], 0 <= f(n_)) implies series-converges-to(f, 0) implies forall([n_ in nn], f(n_) = 0))
- `series-partial-sum-abs-le` — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, rr)], abs(series-partial-sum(f, k)) <= series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, abs(f(n_))), k))
- `series-partial-sum-add` — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr), h in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], h(i_) = f(i_) + g(i_)) implies series-partial-sum(h, k) = series-partial-sum(f, k) + series-partial-sum(g, k))
- `series-partial-sum-add-ptwise` — forall([n_ in nn, f_, g_, h_], forall([k_ in nn], f_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], g_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], h_(k_) = f_(k_) + g_(k_)) implies series-partial-sum(h_, n_) = series-partial-sum(f_, n_) + series-partial-sum(g_, n_))
- `series-partial-sum-agree-below` — forall([n in nn, tcu_, tcg_], forall([tck_ in nn], tck_ < n implies tcg_(tck_) in rr) implies forall([tck_ in nn], tck_ < n implies tcu_(tck_) = tcg_(tck_)) implies series-partial-sum(tcu_, n) = series-partial-sum(tcg_, n))
- `series-partial-sum-antiderivable` — forall([n_ in nn, s_, ph_, a, b], a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies ph_ in fun(rr, rr) implies forall([j_ in nn], is-antiderivable(s_(j_), a, b)) implies forall([x_ in rr], ph_(x_) == series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(j_, nn, (s_(j_))(x_)), n_)) implies is-antiderivable(ph_, a, b))
- `series-partial-sum-bounded` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], 0 <= f(i_)) implies series-converges(f) implies forsome([bnd in rr], forall([kx in nn], series-partial-sum(f, kx) <= bnd)))
- `series-partial-sum-in-rr` — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, rr)], series-partial-sum(f, k) in rr)
- `series-partial-sum-in-rr-below` — forall([itn_ in nn, itf_], forall([itk_ in nn], itk_ < itn_ implies itf_(itk_) in rr) implies series-partial-sum(itf_, itn_) in rr)
- `series-partial-sum-in-rr-ptwise` — forall([n_ in nn, f_], forall([k_ in nn], f_(k_) in rr) implies series-partial-sum(f_, n_) in rr)
- `series-partial-sum-is-ring-sum` — forall([n_ in nn, f_], series-partial-sum(f_, n_) == sum(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field), f_, n_))
- `series-partial-sum-le-termwise` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([n_ in nn], f(n_) <= g(n_)) implies forall([k in nn], series-partial-sum(f, k) <= series-partial-sum(g, k)))
- `series-partial-sum-le-termwise-ptwise` — forall([n_ in nn, f_, g_], forall([k_ in nn], f_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], g_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], f_(k_) <= g_(k_)) implies series-partial-sum(f_, n_) <= series-partial-sum(g_, n_))
- `series-partial-sum-mono` — forall([k in nn, m in nn, f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], 0 <= f(i_)) implies m <= k implies series-partial-sum(f, m) <= series-partial-sum(f, k))
- `series-partial-sum-monotone-nonneg` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([n_ in nn], 0 <= f(n_)) implies forall([k in nn], series-partial-sum(f, k) <= series-partial-sum(f, succ(k))))
- `series-partial-sum-nonneg` — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], 0 <= f(i_)) implies 0 <= series-partial-sum(f, k))
- `series-partial-sum-scale-ptwise` — forall([n_ in nn, c_, f_, h_], c_ in rr implies forall([k_ in nn], f_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], h_(k_) = c_ * f_(k_)) implies series-partial-sum(h_, n_) = c_ * series-partial-sum(f_, n_))
- `series-partial-sum-seq-apply` — forall([f, j in nn], (vnb-lambda(k, nn, series-partial-sum(f, k)))(j) == series-partial-sum(f, j))
- `series-partial-sum-seq-in-fun` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], vnb-lambda(k, nn, series-partial-sum(f, k)) in fun(nn, rr))
- `series-partial-sum-shift` — forall([n in nn, tcu_ in fun(nn, rr)], series-partial-sum(tcu_, succ(n)) = tcu_(0) + series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(tci_, nn, tcu_(succ(tci_))), n))
- `series-partial-sum-succ` — forall([f, k in nn], series-partial-sum(f, k) in rr implies f(k) in rr implies series-partial-sum(f, succ(k)) == series-partial-sum(f, k) + f(k))
- `series-partial-sum-unfold` — forall([f, k], series-partial-sum(f, k) == sum-ag(normed-field-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), f, k))
- `series-partial-sum-weighted-expansion` — forall([n_ in nn, x_, y_, g_, w_, p_, q_, s_], x_ in rr implies y_ in rr implies forall([k_ in zz], g_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in zz], w_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], q_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], s_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], p_(k_) = w_(k_) * (x_ * g_(k_ - 1) + y_ * g_(k_))) implies forall([k_ in nn], q_(k_) = w_(succ(k_)) * g_(k_)) implies forall([k_ in nn], s_(k_) = w_(k_) * g_(k_)) implies series-partial-sum(p_, succ(n_)) = x_ * (w_(0) * g_(0 - 1) + series-partial-sum(q_, n_)) + y_ * (series-partial-sum(s_, n_) + w_(n_) * g_(n_)))
- `series-partial-sum-zero` — forall([f], series-partial-sum(f, 0) == 0)
- `series-partial-sum-zero-seq` — forall([k_ in nn], series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, 0), k_) = 0)
- `series-scale-converges` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpsk_ in nn], 0 <= f(cpsk_)) implies forall([cpsc_ in rr], 0 <= cpsc_ implies forall([h in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpsk_ in nn], h(cpsk_) = cpsc_ * f(cpsk_)) implies series-converges(f) implies series-converges(h))))
- `series-shift-converges-iff` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], 0 <= f(cpdj_)) implies forall([g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], g(cpdj_) = f(succ(cpdj_))) implies series-converges(f) iff series-converges(g)))
- `series-shift-partial-sum` — forall([cpdk_ in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], g(cpdj_) = f(succ(cpdj_))) implies series-partial-sum(f, succ(cpdk_)) = f(0) + series-partial-sum(g, cpdk_))
- `series-tail-small` — forall([g in fun(nn, rr)], series-converges(g) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([bnd in nn], forall([k in nn], bnd <= k implies series-partial-sum(g, k) - series-partial-sum(g, bnd) <= eps))))
- `series-term-le-sum` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([n_ in nn], 0 <= f(n_)) implies forall([lm_], series-converges-to(f, lm_) implies forall([n_ in nn], f(n_) <= lm_)))
- `set-dist-pos-elim` — forall([m], is-metric-space(m) implies forall([aa, bb], aa subset pts(m) implies bb subset pts(m) implies not(set-dist(m, aa, bb) = 0) implies forsome([r], pos-rr(r) and forall([mxx_ in aa, myy_ in bb], r <= (dist(m))(mxx_, myy_)))))

- `set-dist-union-pos` — forall([m], is-metric-space(m) implies forall([aa, bb, ds], aa subset pts(m) implies bb subset pts(m) implies ds subset pts(m) implies not(set-dist(m, aa, ds) = 0) implies not(set-dist(m, bb, ds) = 0) implies not(set-dist(m, union(aa, bb), ds) = 0)))
- `shift-continuous-at` — forall([k in rr, f, a], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, a) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, vnb-lambda(x, rr, f(x) + k), a))

- `simple-fn-of-partition` — forall([omega, ca, ks, k, hh, t], is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) implies ks in set implies card(ks) in nn implies forall([z_ in omega], k(z_) in ks) implies forall([z_ in ks], {fx_ in omega: k(fx_) = z_} in ca) implies forall([z_ in ks], hh(z_) in rr) implies forall([z_ in ks], 0 <= hh(z_)) implies t in fun(omega, rr-pos-star) implies forall([z_ in omega], t(z_) = hh(k(z_))) implies is-simple-fn(omega, ca, t))
