- `subst-efvar-miss` — forall([m, u, n], u in expr-set implies n in nn implies not(n = m) implies expr-subst(efvar(n), m, u) == efvar(n))
- `subst-fresh` — forall([m, u in expr-set, e in expr-set], not(m in expr-fv(e)) implies expr-subst(e, m, u) = e)
- `subst-fun-unfold` — forall([m, u], subst-fun(m, u) == vnb-lambda(mxw_, expr-set, expr-subst(mxw_, m, u)))
- `subst-hole-l` — forall([z, s, c, h], z in nn implies s in expr-set implies c in expr-set implies h in nn implies not(z in expr-fv(c)) implies expr-subst(eapp(h, [efvar(z), c]), z, s) = eapp(h, [s, c]))
- `subst-hole-list` — forall([z, h, l, lz, l2, i], z in nn implies h in nn implies l in tuples(expr-set) implies lz in tuples(expr-set) implies l2 in tuples(expr-set) implies length(lz) = length(l) implies length(l2) = length(l) implies i in nn implies 1 <= i implies i <= length(l) implies nth(i, lz) = efvar(z) implies forall([mrj_ in nn], 1 <= mrj_ implies mrj_ <= length(l) implies not(mrj_ = i) implies nth(mrj_, lz) = nth(mrj_, l)) implies forall([mrj_ in nn], 1 <= mrj_ implies mrj_ <= length(l) implies not(mrj_ = i) implies nth(mrj_, l2) = nth(mrj_, l)) implies not(z in expr-fv(eapp(h, l))) implies expr-subst(eapp(h, lz), z, nth(i, l2)) = eapp(h, l2))
- `subst-hole-r` — forall([z, s, c, h], z in nn implies s in expr-set implies c in expr-set implies h in nn implies not(z in expr-fv(c)) implies expr-subst(eapp(h, [c, efvar(z)]), z, s) = eapp(h, [c, s]))
- `subst-in-expr` — forall([m, u in expr-set, e in expr-set], expr-subst(e, m, u) in expr-set)
- `subst-open-commute` — forall([n, u, v], u in expr-set implies v in expr-set implies expr-lc(v) implies forall([e in expr-set, ix in nn], expr-subst(expr-open(e, ix, u), n, v) = expr-open(expr-subst(e, n, v), ix, expr-subst(u, n, v))))
- `subst-open-name` — forall([y, e, v], y in nn implies e in expr-set implies v in expr-set implies expr-lc(v) implies not(y in expr-fv(e)) implies expr-subst(expr-open(e, 0, efvar(y)), y, v) = expr-open(e, 0, v))
- `subst-stage-coh` — forall([d in nn, m, u, j, e], j in nn implies e in expr-stage(j) implies (subst-stage(m, u, j + d))(e) == (subst-stage(m, u, j))(e))
- `subst-stage-fun` — forall([n in nn, m, u in expr-set], subst-stage(m, u, n) in fun(expr-stage(n), expr-set))
- `subst-stage-step` — forall([m, u, k, e], k in nn implies e in expr-stage(k) implies (subst-stage(m, u, succ(k)))(e) == (subst-stage(m, u, k))(e))
- `subterm-antisym` — forall([t, k], is-token-set(t) implies k in set implies forall([a, b], is-subterm(t, k, a, b) implies is-subterm(t, k, b, a) implies a = b))
- `subterm-cases` — forall([t, k], t in set implies k in set implies forall([a, b], is-subterm(t, k, a, b) implies a = b or forsome([l in tuples(msg-set(t, k))], b = lst(l) and forsome([i in nn], 1 <= i and i <= length(l) and is-subterm(t, k, a, nth(i, l)))) or forsome([g in msg-set(t, k), y in k], b = encr(g, y) and is-subterm(t, k, a, g))))
- `subterm-component` — forall([t, k, a, l, i], l in tuples(msg-set(t, k)) implies i in nn implies 1 <= i implies i <= length(l) implies is-subterm(t, k, a, nth(i, l)) implies is-subterm(t, k, a, lst(l)))
- `subterm-encr` — forall([t, k, a, g, y], g in msg-set(t, k) implies y in k implies is-subterm(t, k, a, g) implies is-subterm(t, k, a, encr(g, y)))
- `subterm-encr-other-key` — forall([t, k], t in set implies k in set implies forall([h, h2, y, y2], h in msg-set(t, k) implies h2 in msg-set(t, k) implies y in k implies y2 in k implies not(y = y2) implies is-subterm(t, k, encr(h2, y2), encr(h, y)) implies is-subterm(t, k, encr(h2, y2), h)))
- `subterm-in-msgs` — forall([t, k, a, b], is-subterm(t, k, a, b) implies a in msg-set(t, k) and b in msg-set(t, k))
- `subterm-least` — forall([t, k, r in power(cartesian(msg-set(t, k), msg-set(t, k)))], is-subterm-closed(t, k, r) implies forall([a, b], is-subterm(t, k, a, b) implies [a, b] in r))
- `subterm-of-encr` — forall([t, k], t in set implies k in set implies forall([a, g, y], g in msg-set(t, k) implies y in k implies is-subterm(t, k, a, encr(g, y)) implies a = encr(g, y) or is-subterm(t, k, a, g)))
- `subterm-of-flat-encr-list` — forall([t, k, d, w, l, ky], is-token-set(t) implies k in set implies forall([x in d], x in t) implies l in tuples(d) implies ky in k implies is-subterm(t, k, w, encr(lst(l), ky)) implies w = encr(lst(l), ky) or w = lst(l) or w in d)
- `subterm-of-flat-encr-token` — forall([t, k, d, w, x, ky], is-token-set(t) implies k in set implies forall([z in d], z in t) implies x in d implies ky in k implies is-subterm(t, k, w, encr(x, ky)) implies w = encr(x, ky) or w in d)
- `subterm-of-flat-list` — forall([t, k, d, w, l], is-token-set(t) implies k in set implies forall([x in d], x in t) implies l in tuples(d) implies is-subterm(t, k, w, lst(l)) implies w = lst(l) or w in d)
- `subterm-of-list` — forall([t, k], t in set implies k in set implies forall([a, l in tuples(msg-set(t, k))], is-subterm(t, k, a, lst(l)) implies a = lst(l) or forsome([i in nn], 1 <= i and i <= length(l) and is-subterm(t, k, a, nth(i, l)))))
- `subterm-of-token` — forall([t, k], is-token-set(t) implies k in set implies forall([a, tk in t], is-subterm(t, k, a, tk) implies a = tk))
- `subterm-rank` — forall([t, k], is-token-set(t) implies k in set implies forall([a, b], is-subterm(t, k, a, b) implies a = b or succ(msg-rank(t, k, a)) <= msg-rank(t, k, b)))
- `subterm-refl` — forall([t, k, a in msg-set(t, k)], is-subterm(t, k, a, a))
- `subterm-rel-unfold` — forall([t, k], subterm-rel(t, k) == {p_ in cartesian(msg-set(t, k), msg-set(t, k)): forall([q_ in power(cartesian(msg-set(t, k), msg-set(t, k)))], is-subterm-closed(t, k, q_) implies p_ in q_)})
- `subterm-trans` — forall([t, k], t in set implies k in set implies forall([a, b, c], is-subterm(t, k, a, b) implies is-subterm(t, k, b, c) implies is-subterm(t, k, a, c)))
- `succ-in-interval` — forall([q in nn, z in interval(1, q)], succ(z) in interval(1, succ(q)))
- `succ-nn-minus-1` — forall([i in nn], 1 <= i implies succ(nn-minus(i, 1)) = i)
- `succ-nn-ord` — forall([n in nn], succ(n) = succ_ord(n))  _[warrant: informal]_
- `succ-not-one` — forall([q, z in interval(1, q)], not(succ(z) = 1))
- `sum-ag-act-collect-ind` — forall([n in nn, md], is-module(md) implies forall([x in vec(md), gc_, gv_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gc_(i_) in carr(scal(md))) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gv_(i_) == (act(md))(gc_(i_), x)) implies sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), gv_, n) = (act(md))(sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(scal(md)), gc_, n), x)))
- `sum-ag-act-ind` — forall([n in nn, md], is-module(md) implies forall([r in carr(scal(md)), ga_, gb_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], ga_(i_) in carr(module-vector-ag(md))) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gb_(i_) == (act(md))(r, ga_(i_))) implies sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), gb_, n) = (act(md))(r, sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), ga_, n))))
- `sum-ag-add-ind` — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([ga_, gb_, gc_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], ga_(i_) in carr(ag)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gb_(i_) in carr(ag)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gc_(i_) == (opr(ag))(ga_(i_), gb_(i_))) implies sum-ag(ag, gc_, n) = (opr(ag))(sum-ag(ag, ga_, n), sum-ag(ag, gb_, n))))
- `sum-ag-all-id-ind` — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([g_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], g_(i_) = iden(ag)) implies sum-ag(ag, g_, n) = iden(ag)))
- `sum-ag-as-reduce` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(ag)), n], n in nn and 1 <= n implies sum-ag(ag, f, n) = reduce(opr(ag), f, n)))
- `sum-ag-as-reduce-ind` — forall([k in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(ag))], sum-ag(ag, f, succ(k)) = reduce(opr(ag), f, succ(k))))
- `sum-ag-cc-in-cc` — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, cc)], sum-ag(normed-field-additive-ag(cc-normed-field), f, k) in cc)
- `sum-ag-comm-monoid-add-ind` — forall([n in nn, m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([ga_, gb_, gc_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], ga_(i_) in carr(m)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gb_(i_) in carr(m)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gc_(i_) == (opr(m))(ga_(i_), gb_(i_))) implies sum-ag(m, gc_, n) = (opr(m))(sum-ag(m, ga_, n), sum-ag(m, gb_, n))))
- `sum-ag-comm-monoid-type-ind` — forall([n in nn, m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(m))], sum-ag(m, f, n) in carr(m)))
- `sum-ag-comm-monoid-type-ptwise` — forall([n in nn, m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([g_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], g_(i_) in carr(m)) implies sum-ag(m, g_, n) in carr(m)))
- `sum-ag-fubini-ind` — forall([m in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([n in nn, ff_, gg_, rs_, cs_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(m), j_ in ord-segment(n)], (ff_(i_))(j_) in carr(ag)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(m), j_ in ord-segment(n)], (gg_(j_))(i_) == (ff_(i_))(j_)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(m)], rs_(i_) == sum-ag(ag, ff_(i_), n)) implies forall([j_ in ord-segment(n)], cs_(j_) == sum-ag(ag, gg_(j_), m)) implies forall([fbi_ in ord-segment(m)], rs_(fbi_) in carr(ag)) implies forall([fbj_ in ord-segment(n)], cs_(fbj_) in carr(ag)) implies sum-ag(ag, rs_, m) = sum-ag(ag, cs_, n)))
- `sum-ag-in-subset-ind` — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([sm], iden(ag) in sm implies forall([x_ in sm, y_ in sm], (opr(ag))(x_, y_) in sm) implies forall([g_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], g_(i_) in sm) implies sum-ag(ag, g_, n) in sm)))
- `sum-ag-permutation-invariance` — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([g in fun(nn, carr(ag)), h in fun(nn, carr(ag)), phi in bijection(ord-segment(n), ord-segment(n))], forall([i in ord-segment(n)], h(i) = g(phi(i))) implies sum-ag(ag, g, n) = sum-ag(ag, h, n)))  _[warrant: informal]_
- `sum-ag-permutation-invariance-laws` — forall([n in nn, s], iden(s) in carr(s) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a_, b_) in carr(s)) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s), c_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a_, b_), c_) = (opr(s))(a_, (opr(s))(b_, c_))) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a_, b_) = (opr(s))(b_, a_)) implies forall([g in fun(nn, carr(s)), h in fun(nn, carr(s)), phi in bijection(ord-segment(n), ord-segment(n))], forall([i in ord-segment(n)], h(i) = g(phi(i))) implies sum-ag(s, g, n) = sum-ag(s, h, n)))
- `sum-ag-replace-entry-laws` — forall([n in nn, s], iden(s) in carr(s) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a_, b_) in carr(s)) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s), c_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a_, b_), c_) = (opr(s))(a_, (opr(s))(b_, c_))) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a_, b_) = (opr(s))(b_, a_)) implies forall([g in fun(nn, carr(s)), gp in fun(nn, carr(s)), k in ord-segment(n)], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], not(i_ = k) implies g(i_) == gp(i_)) implies (opr(s))(sum-ag(s, g, n), gp(k)) = (opr(s))(sum-ag(s, gp, n), g(k))))
- `sum-ag-ring-left-ind` — forall([n in nn, rng], is-ring(rng) implies forall([r in carr(rng), ga_, gb_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], ga_(i_) in carr(rng)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gb_(i_) == (mul(rng))(r, ga_(i_))) implies sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(rng), gb_, n) = (mul(rng))(r, sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(rng), ga_, n))))
- `sum-ag-ring-right-ind` — forall([n in nn, rng], is-ring(rng) implies forall([r in carr(rng), ga_, gb_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], ga_(i_) in carr(rng)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gb_(i_) == (mul(rng))(ga_(i_), r)) implies sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(rng), gb_, n) = (mul(rng))(sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(rng), ga_, n), r)))
- `sum-ag-rr-in-rr` — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, rr)], sum-ag(normed-field-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), f, k) in rr)
- `sum-ag-segment-congruence` — forall([n in nn, ag, g, h], forall([i in ord-segment(n)], g(i) == h(i)) implies sum-ag(ag, g, n) == sum-ag(ag, h, n))
- `sum-ag-single-ind` — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([g_, p_ in ord-segment(n)], g_(p_) in carr(ag) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], not(i_ = p_) implies g_(i_) = iden(ag)) implies sum-ag(ag, g_, n) = g_(p_)))
- `sum-ag-singleton` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(ag))], sum-ag(ag, f, 1) = f(0)))
- `sum-ag-two-support-ind` — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([g_, p_, q_], p_ in ord-segment(n) implies q_ in ord-segment(n) implies not(p_ = q_) implies g_(p_) in carr(ag) implies g_(q_) in carr(ag) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], not(i_ = p_) implies not(i_ = q_) implies g_(i_) = iden(ag)) implies sum-ag(ag, g_, n) = (opr(ag))(g_(p_), g_(q_))))
- `sum-ag-type` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(ag)), n in nn], sum-ag(ag, f, n) in carr(ag)))
- `sum-ag-type-ind` — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(ag))], sum-ag(ag, f, n) in carr(ag)))
- `sum-ag-type-laws` — forall([n in nn, s], iden(s) in carr(s) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a_, b_) in carr(s)) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s), c_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a_, b_), c_) = (opr(s))(a_, (opr(s))(b_, c_))) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a_, b_) = (opr(s))(b_, a_)) implies forall([g in fun(nn, carr(s))], sum-ag(s, g, n) in carr(s)))
- `sum-ag-type-ptwise` — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([g_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], g_(i_) in carr(ag)) implies sum-ag(ag, g_, n) in carr(ag)))
- `sum-continuous-at` — forall([g, h, a], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, g, a) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, h, a) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, vnb-lambda(x, rr, g(x) + h(x)), a))
- `sum-expansion` — forall([n in nn, r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in carr(r), y in carr(r), g in fun(zz, carr(r))], sum(r, vnb-lambda(k, zz, (add(r))((mul(r))(x, g(k - 1)), (mul(r))(y, g(k)))), succ(n)) = (add(r))((add(r))((mul(r))((add(r))(x, y), sum(r, g, n)), (mul(r))(x, g(0 - 1))), (mul(r))(y, g(n)))))
- `sum-in-carr-zz-ind` — forall([n_ in nn, r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([g in fun(zz, carr(r))], sum(r, g, n_) in carr(r)))
- `sum-lam-in-fun` — forall([g, h], g in fun(rr, rr) implies h in fun(rr, rr) implies vnb-lambda(x, rr, g(x) + h(x)) in fun(rr, rr))
- `sum-left-scalar` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([a in carr(r), f in fun(nn, carr(r)), n in nn], sum(r, vnb-lambda(i, nn, (mul(r))(a, f(i))), n) = (mul(r))(a, sum(r, f, n))))
- `sum-left-scalar-ind` — forall([n in nn, r], is-ring(r) implies forall([a in carr(r), f in fun(nn, carr(r))], sum(r, vnb-lambda(i, nn, (mul(r))(a, f(i))), n) = (mul(r))(a, sum(r, f, n))))
- `sum-set-disjoint-union-defined` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([x, s1, s2, f], x in set and s1 in set and s2 in set and intersection(s1, s2) = empty-set and union(s1, s2) subset x and f in fun(x, carr(r)) and card(s1) in nn and card(s2) in nn implies sum-set(r, union(s1, s2), f) = (add(r))(sum-set(r, s1, f), sum-set(r, s2, f))))
- `sum-set-empty` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([f], sum-set(r, empty-set, f) == zero(r)))
- `sum-set-left-scalar` — forall([s], is-ring(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), x], x in set and card(x) in nn implies forall([f in fun(x, carr(s))], (mul(s))(a, sum-set(s, x, f)) = sum-set(s, x, vnb-lambda(z, x, (mul(s))(a, f(z)))))))
- `sum-set-right-scalar` — forall([s], is-ring(s) implies forall([b in carr(s), x], x in set and card(x) in nn implies forall([f in fun(x, carr(s))], (mul(s))(sum-set(s, x, f), b) = sum-set(s, x, vnb-lambda(z, x, (mul(s))(f(z), b))))))
- `sum-set-singleton-defined` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([x in set, f], f(x) in carr(r) implies sum-set(r, pair(x, x), f) = f(x)))
- `sum-set-type-defined` — forall([r, x, s, f], is-ring(r) and x in set and s subset x and f in fun(x, carr(r)) and card(s) in nn implies sum-set(r, s, f) in carr(r))
- `sum-singleton` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(r))], sum(r, f, 1) = f(0)))
- `sum-type` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(r)), n in nn], sum(r, f, n) in carr(r)))
- `sum-type-ind` — forall([n in nn, r], is-ring(r) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(r))], sum(r, f, n) in carr(r)))
- `summable-bound-converges` — forall([s, f, rad], is-complete(s) and f in fun(nn, pts(s)) and rad in fun(nn, rr) and series-converges(rad) and forall([k in nn], (dist(s))(f(k), f(succ(k))) <= rad(k)) implies converges(s, f))
- `summable-bound-implies-cauchy` — forall([s, f, rad], is-metric-space(s) and f in fun(nn, pts(s)) and rad in fun(nn, rr) and series-converges(rad) and forall([k in nn], (dist(s))(f(k), f(succ(k))) <= rad(k)) implies is-cauchy-seq(s, f))
- `sums-to-unique` — forall([grp], is-normed-ag(grp) implies forall([f in fun(dom(f), carr(grp)), r1 in carr(grp), r2 in carr(grp)], sums-to(grp, f, r1) and sums-to(grp, f, r2) implies r1 = r2))
- `supp-add-subset` — forall([a_, m_, g_, h_, z_], is-ring(a_) implies g_ in finsupp(a_, m_) implies h_ in finsupp(a_, m_) implies z_ in supp(a_, m_, monalg-add(a_, m_, g_, h_)) implies z_ in union(supp(a_, m_, g_), supp(a_, m_, h_)))
- `supp-in-set` — forall([a_, m_, f_], carr(m_) in set implies supp(a_, m_, f_) in set)
- `supp-membership` — forall([a_, m_, f_, x_], x_ in supp(a_, m_, f_) iff x_ in carr(m_) and not(f_(x_) = zero(a_)))
- `supp-unfold` — forall([a_, m_, f_], supp(a_, m_, f_) == {x_ in carr(m_): not(f_(x_) = zero(a_))})
- `swap-to-corner` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([m, n, a, i0, j0], a in mat(m, n, carr(r)) implies 1 in interval(1, m) implies 1 in interval(1, n) implies i0 in interval(1, m) implies j0 in interval(1, n) implies not(1 = i0) implies not(1 = j0) implies forsome([b], mat-equiv(r, m, n, a, b) and entry(b, 1, 1) = entry(a, i0, j0))))

- `y-section-measurable` — forall([xs, ca, ys, cb, cs, y], is-sigma-algebra(xs, ca) implies is-sigma-algebra(ys, cb) implies cs in product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb) implies y in ys implies y-section(xs, cs, y) in ca)
- `y-section-measure-apply` — forall([xs, ys, mu, cs, y in ys], (y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, cs))(y) == mu(y-section(xs, cs, y)))
- `y-section-measure-difference` — forall([xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu, aa, bb], is-measure(xs, ca, mu) implies is-measure(ys, cb, nu) implies aa in product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb) implies bb in product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb) implies aa subset bb implies is-measurable-fn(ys, cb, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, aa)) implies is-measurable-fn(ys, cb, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, bb)) implies forall([pmz_ in ys], mu(y-section(xs, bb, pmz_)) in rr) implies integral(ys, cb, nu, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, bb)) in rr implies is-measurable-fn(ys, cb, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, complement-in(bb, aa))) and integral(ys, cb, nu, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, aa)) in rr and integral(ys, cb, nu, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, complement-in(bb, aa))) = integral(ys, cb, nu, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, bb)) - integral(ys, cb, nu, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, aa)))
- `y-section-measure-rectangle` — forall([xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu, aa, bb], is-measure(xs, ca, mu) implies is-measure(ys, cb, nu) implies aa in ca implies bb in cb implies mu(aa) in rr implies is-measurable-fn(ys, cb, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, cartesian(aa, bb))) and integral(ys, cb, nu, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, cartesian(aa, bb))) = etimes(mu(aa), nu(bb)))
- `y-section-measure-type` — forall([xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu, cs], is-measure(xs, ca, mu) implies is-measure(ys, cb, nu) implies cs in product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb) implies y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, cs) in fun(ys, rr-pos-star))
- `y-section-measure-union` — forall([xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu, f], is-measure(xs, ca, mu) implies is-measure(ys, cb, nu) implies f in fun(nn, product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb)) implies forall([pmn_ in nn], f(pmn_) subset f(succ(pmn_))) implies forall([pmn_ in nn], is-measurable-fn(ys, cb, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, f(pmn_)))) implies is-measurable-fn(ys, cb, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, big-union(n_, nn, f(n_)))) and integral(ys, cb, nu, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, big-union(n_, nn, f(n_)))) = esup(image(vnb-lambda(pmn_, nn, integral(ys, cb, nu, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, f(pmn_)))), nn)))
- `y-section-membership` — forall([xs, cs, y, z], z in y-section(xs, cs, y) iff z in xs and [z, y] in cs)
- `y-section-mono` — forall([xs, aa, bb, y], aa subset bb implies y-section(xs, aa, y) subset y-section(xs, bb, y))
- `y-section-rectangle-in` — forall([xs, aa, bb, y], aa subset xs implies y in bb implies y-section(xs, cartesian(aa, bb), y) = aa)
- `y-section-rectangle-out` — forall([xs, aa, bb, y], not(y in bb) implies y-section(xs, cartesian(aa, bb), y) = empty-set)
- `y-section-simple-integral` — forall([xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, s, y], is-measure(xs, ca, mu) implies is-sigma-algebra(ys, cb) implies is-simple-fn(cartesian(xs, ys), product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb), s) implies y in ys implies integral(xs, ca, mu, fn-y-section(xs, s, y)) = finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, vnb-lambda(sv_, image(s, cartesian(xs, ys)), etimes(sv_, mu(y-section(xs, {fx_ in cartesian(xs, ys): s(fx_) = sv_}, y)))), image(s, cartesian(xs, ys))))
- `y-section-unfold` — forall([xs, cs, y], y-section(xs, cs, y) == {ysx_ in xs: [ysx_, y] in cs})
- `young-extended` — forall([a in rr-pos-star, b in rr-pos-star, p], p in rr and 1 < p implies forall([q], q in rr and 1 < q implies (/)(1, p) + (/)(1, q) = 1 implies etimes(a, b) <= eplus(etimes(recip(p), epow(a, p)), etimes(recip(q), epow(b, q)))))
- `young-inequality` — forall([a], a in rr and 0 < a implies forall([b], b in rr and 0 < b implies forall([p], p in qq and 1 < p implies forall([q], q in qq and 1 < q implies (/)(1, p) + (/)(1, q) = 1 implies a * b <= (/)(rpow(a, p), p) + (/)(rpow(b, q), q)))))
- `young-inequality-star` — forall([a], a in rr and 0 < a implies forall([b], b in rr and 0 < b implies forall([p], p in rr and 1 < p implies forall([q], q in rr and 1 < q implies (/)(1, p) + (/)(1, q) = 1 implies a * b <= (/)(rpow-star(a, p), p) + (/)(rpow-star(b, q), q)))))
- `young-scaled` — forall([c_ in rr], 0 < c_ implies forall([d_ in rr], 0 < d_ implies forall([u_ in rr-pos-star, v_ in rr-pos-star, p], p in rr and 1 < p implies forall([q], q in rr and 1 < q implies (/)(1, p) + (/)(1, q) = 1 implies etimes(c_ * d_, etimes(u_, v_)) <= eplus(etimes(recip(p) * epow(c_, p), epow(u_, p)), etimes(recip(q) * epow(d_, q), epow(v_, q)))))))
- `zen-enum-in-fun` — forall([al in ord, s in set], forall([cz], ord-lt(cz, al) implies forsome([x], x in {y_ in s: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, cz) implies not(zen(s, c_) = y_))})) implies vnb-lambda(a_, ord-segment(al), zen(s, a_)) in fun(ord-segment(al), s))
- `zen-enum-injective` — forall([al in ord, s in set], forall([cz], ord-lt(cz, al) implies forsome([x], x in {y_ in s: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, cz) implies not(zen(s, c_) = y_))})) implies forall([a1_ in ord-segment(al), a2_ in ord-segment(al)], (vnb-lambda(a_, ord-segment(al), zen(s, a_)))(a1_) = (vnb-lambda(a_, ord-segment(al), zen(s, a_)))(a2_) implies a1_ = a2_))
- `zen-enum-surjective` — forall([al in ord, s in set], not(forsome([x], x in {y_ in s: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, al) implies not(zen(s, c_) = y_))})) implies forall([w in s], forsome([z in ord-segment(al)], (vnb-lambda(a_, ord-segment(al), zen(s, a_)))(z) = w)))
- `zen-exhausts` — forall([s in set], forsome([alpha in ord], not(forsome([x], x in {y_ in s: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, alpha) implies not(zen(s, c_) = y_))}))))
- `zen-hits` — forall([alpha in ord, s], forsome([x], x in {y_ in s: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, alpha) implies not(zen(s, c_) = y_))}) implies zen(s, alpha) in {y_ in s: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, alpha) implies not(zen(s, c_) = y_))})
- `zen-step` — forall([alpha in ord, x], zen(x, alpha) = choice({y_ in x: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, alpha) implies not(zen(x, c_) = y_))}))
- `zermelo-bijection` — forall([s in set], forsome([al in ord, phi], phi in bijection(ord-segment(al), s)))
- `zermelo-least-ordinal` — forall([s in set], forsome([al in ord], not(forsome([x], x in {y_ in s: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, al) implies not(zen(s, c_) = y_))})) and forall([cz], ord-lt(cz, al) implies forsome([x], x in {y_ in s: forall([c_], ord-lt(c_, cz) implies not(zen(s, c_) = y_))}))))
- `zero-deriv-off-countable` — forall([zs_], is-countable(zs_) implies zs_ subset rr implies forall([zh_ in fun(rr, rr)], forall([zx_ in rr], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, zh_, zx_)) implies forall([zu_ in rr, zv_ in rr], zu_ < zv_ implies forall([zt_ in ooint(zu_, zv_)], not(zt_ in zs_) implies is-diff-at(zh_, zt_, 0)) implies zh_(zu_) = zh_(zv_))))
- `zero-deriv-off-countable-constant` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([g in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], is-continuous-on(g, ccint(a, b)) implies forall([zd_], is-countable(zd_) implies zd_ subset ccint(a, b) implies forall([zt_ in ooint(a, b)], not(zt_ in zd_) implies has-deriv-at(g, zt_, 0)) implies forall([zs_ in ccint(a, b), zw_ in ccint(a, b)], g(zs_) = g(zw_)))))
- `zero-in-rr-pos-star` — 0 in rr-pos-star
- `zero-is-antiderivable` — forall([a, b], a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, 0), a, b))
- `zero-ring-is-ring` — is-ring(zero-ring)
- `zero-seq-in-fun` — vnb-lambda(n_, nn, 0) in fun(nn, rr)
- `zero-series-converges` — series-converges(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, 0))
- `zeromat-entries-defined` — forall([a, m, n], is-ring(a) implies m in nn implies n in nn implies forall([i_ in interval(1, m), j_ in interval(1, n)], (vnb-lambda([i, j], cartesian(interval(1, m), interval(1, n)), zero(a)))(i_, j_) in set))
- `zeromat-type` — forall([a], is-ring(a) implies forall([m, n], m in nn implies n in nn implies zeromat(a, m, n) in mat(m, n, carr(a))))
- `zeros-accumulate-value` — forall([acnv_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), acnv_) implies forall([acnh_ in fun(acnv_, cc)], forall([rgy_ in acnv_], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), acnv_), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), acnh_, rgy_)) implies forall([acna_ in acnv_], zeros-accumulate-at(acnv_, acnh_, acna_) implies acnh_(acna_) = 0)))
- `zkept-defined` — forall([a in ord, phi, grd, porel], zkept(phi, grd, porel, a) = zkept(phi, grd, porel, a))
- `zorn-chain-plus-keepset` — forall([phi, grd, porel, kset, alpha], is-partial-order(grd, porel) implies is-chain(grd, porel, kset) implies is-chain(grd, porel, union(kset, keep-set(phi, grd, porel, kset, alpha))))
- `zorn-empty-is-chain` — forall([grd, porel], grd in set implies is-chain(grd, porel, empty-set))
- `zorn-lemma` — forall([grd, porel], is-partial-order(grd, porel) implies forsome([w_], w_ in grd) implies forall([ch_], is-chain(grd, porel, ch_) implies forsome([u_], is-upper-bound(grd, porel, ch_, u_))) implies forsome([mx_], is-maximal(grd, porel, mx_)))
- `zorn-zkept-is-chain` — forall([alpha in ord, phi, grd, porel], is-partial-order(grd, porel) implies is-chain(grd, porel, zkept(phi, grd, porel, alpha)))
- `zorn-zkept-limit-is-chain` — forall([phi, grd, porel, lam], is-partial-order(grd, porel) implies limit-ord(lam) implies forall([beta in ord-segment(lam)], is-chain(grd, porel, zkept(phi, grd, porel, beta))) implies is-chain(grd, porel, big-union(beta2, ord-segment(lam), zkept(phi, grd, porel, beta2))))
- `zorn-zkept-monotone` — forall([b in ord, phi, grd, porel, a in ord], ord-le(a, b) implies zkept(phi, grd, porel, a) subset zkept(phi, grd, porel, b))
- `zup-injective` — forall([grd, porel], is-partial-order(grd, porel) and forsome([w_], w_ in grd) and forall([ch_], is-chain(grd, porel, ch_) implies forsome([u_], is-upper-bound(grd, porel, ch_, u_))) and forall([x_ in grd], forsome([y_ in grd], is-strictly-below(porel, x_, y_))) implies forall([a1_, a2_], a1_ in ord implies a2_ in ord implies zup(grd, porel, a1_) = zup(grd, porel, a2_) implies a1_ = a2_))
- `zup-tower` — forall([a_ in ord, grd, porel], is-partial-order(grd, porel) and forsome([w_], w_ in grd) and forall([ch_], is-chain(grd, porel, ch_) implies forsome([u_], is-upper-bound(grd, porel, ch_, u_))) and forall([x_ in grd], forsome([y_ in grd], is-strictly-below(porel, x_, y_))) implies zup(grd, porel, a_) in grd and forall([b_], ord-lt(b_, a_) implies zup(grd, porel, b_) in grd and is-strictly-below(porel, zup(grd, porel, b_), zup(grd, porel, a_))))
- `zz-2m-neq-1` — forall([m in zz], not(2 * m = 1))
- `zz-abs-cases` — forall([a_ in zz], a_ = abs(a_) or a_ = -abs(a_))
- `zz-abs-in-nn` — forall([a_ in zz], abs(a_) in nn)
- `zz-act-add` — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([j in zz, k in zz, a in carr(g)], zz-act(g, j + k, a) = (opr(g))(zz-act(g, j, a), zz-act(g, k, a))))
- `zz-act-assoc` — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([j in zz, k in zz, a in carr(g)], zz-act(g, j * k, a) = zz-act(g, j, zz-act(g, k, a))))
- `zz-act-assoc-nn` — forall([j in nn, g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([k in zz, a in carr(g)], zz-act(g, j * k, a) = zz-act(g, j, zz-act(g, k, a))))
- `zz-act-distrib` — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([k in zz, a in carr(g), b in carr(g)], zz-act(g, k, (opr(g))(a, b)) = (opr(g))(zz-act(g, k, a), zz-act(g, k, b))))
- `zz-act-distrib-nn` — forall([k in nn, g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([a in carr(g), b in carr(g)], zz-act(g, k, (opr(g))(a, b)) = (opr(g))(zz-act(g, k, a), zz-act(g, k, b))))
- `zz-act-neg` — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([k in nn, a in carr(g)], zz-act(g, -k, a) = (inv(g))(mpow(abelian-group-as-monoid(g), a, k))))
- `zz-act-neg-sign` — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([k in zz, a in carr(g)], zz-act(g, -k, a) = (inv(g))(zz-act(g, k, a))))
- `zz-act-nonneg` — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([k in nn, a in carr(g)], zz-act(g, k, a) = mpow(abelian-group-as-monoid(g), a, k)))
- `zz-act-one` — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([a in carr(g)], zz-act(g, 1, a) = a))
- `zz-act-type` — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([k in zz, a in carr(g)], zz-act(g, k, a) in carr(g)))
- `zz-act-zero` — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([a in carr(g)], zz-act(g, 0, a) = iden(g)))
- `zz-add-cancel` — forall([a in zz, b in zz, c in zz], a + c = b + c implies a = b)
- `zz-bezout` — forall([a, b], a in zz implies b in zz implies forsome([d in zz-bezout-set(a, b)], zz-divides(d, a) and zz-divides(d, b)))
- `zz-bezout-set-is-ideal` — forall([a, b], a in zz implies b in zz implies is-ideal(zz-ring, zz-bezout-set(a, b)))
- `zz-discrete` — forall([a_ in zz], 0 < a_ implies 1 <= a_)
- `zz-division` — forall([a_ in zz, b_ in zz], not(b_ = 0) implies forsome([q_ in zz, r_ in zz], a_ = q_ * b_ + r_ and (r_ = 0 or succ(abs(r_)) <= abs(b_))))
- `zz-even-iff-not-odd` — forall([x in zz], even(x) iff not(odd(x)))
- `zz-even-mul` — forall([x in zz, y in zz], even(x) implies even(x * y))
- `zz-in-rr` — forall([k_ in zz], k_ in rr)
- `zz-is-commutative-ring` — is-commutative-ring(zz-ring)
- `zz-is-euclidean-ring` — is-euclidean-ring(zz-ring)
- `zz-is-integral-domain` — is-integral-domain(zz-ring)
- `zz-is-ring` — is-ring(zz-ring)
- `zz-lt-succ-le` — forall([a_ in zz, b_ in zz], a_ < b_ implies a_ + 1 <= b_)
- `zz-mul-cancel-zero` — forall([a in zz, b in zz], a * b = 0 implies not(b = 0) implies a = 0)
- `zz-no-zero-divisors` — forall([a in zz, b in zz], a * b = 0 implies a = 0 or b = 0)
- `zz-nonneg-in-nn` — forall([a_ in zz], 0 <= a_ implies a_ in nn)
- `zz-not-even-and-odd` — forall([x in zz], not(even(x) and odd(x)))
- `zz-odd-mul-odd` — forall([x in zz, y in zz], odd(x) implies odd(y) implies odd(x * y))
- `zz-odd-sq-odd` — forall([x in zz], odd(x) implies odd(x * x))
- `zz-parity` — forall([a in zz], even(a) or odd(a))
- `zz-sub-in-zz` — forall([u_, v_], u_ in zz implies v_ in zz implies u_ - v_ in zz)
- `zz-trichotomy` — forall([a_ in zz], a_ < 0 or a_ = 0 or 0 < a_)

## Proof Support Set

Results we accept without a machine proof in VNB.  Logically treated as theorems.


## Stated without proof

Not proved in VNB; split by *origin*.  "Axiom" is reserved for the first group — it is NOT the umbrella for this section.

### Axioms — the fixed VNB base

The foundational axioms of VNB set theory (make-vnb-base-theory core + theorem-library/axioms).  Fixed, though not finite (separation/replacement are schemas).  Everything else rests on these.

> **The axioms below are NOT the whole trusted base.**  The set- & class-formation *schemas* (separation `{x∈A|p}`, comprehension `{x|p}`, indexed union `⋃_{z∈A}body`) carry a formula schema in their body and so live in the proof checker as primitive inference rules, not as formulas in this table.  They are stated, with their premises and conclusions, in `KERNEL-RULES.md`.  The trusted base is these axioms **plus** the kernel rules.

- `app-graph` — forall([fn_, arg_], fn_(arg_) == iota(val_, [arg_, val_] in fn_))
- `apply-tupling-2` — forall([f, a, b], f(a, b) == f([a, b]))
- `apply-tupling-3` — forall([f, a, b, c], f(a, b, c) == f([a, b, c]))
- `burali-forti` — not(ord in set)
- `cartesian-set-iff` — forall([a, b], cartesian(a, b) in set iff a in set and b in set)
- `cc-add-assoc` — forall([a, b, c], a in cc and b in cc and c in cc implies (a + b) + c = a + (b + c))
- `cc-add-closed` — forall([a, b], a in cc and b in cc implies a + b in cc)
- `cc-add-comm` — forall([a, b], a in cc and b in cc implies a + b = b + a)
- `cc-add-zero` — forall([a in cc], a + 0 = a)
- `cc-conjugate-add` — forall([a, b], a in cc and b in cc implies conjugate(a + b) = conjugate(a) + conjugate(b))
- `cc-conjugate-closed` — forall([a in cc], conjugate(a) in cc)
- `cc-conjugate-fixes-rr` — forall([a in rr], conjugate(a) = a)  _[warrant: reference]_
- `cc-conjugate-i` — conjugate(1i) = -1i  _[warrant: reference]_
- `cc-conjugate-involution` — forall([a in cc], conjugate(conjugate(a)) = a)
- `cc-conjugate-mul` — forall([a, b], a in cc and b in cc implies conjugate(a * b) = conjugate(a) * conjugate(b))
- `cc-distributive` — forall([a, b, c], a in cc and b in cc and c in cc implies a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c)
- `cc-generated-by-rr` — forall([z in cc], forsome([x in rr, y in rr], z = x + y * 1i))  _[warrant: reference]_
- `cc-i-in` — 1i in cc  _[warrant: reference]_
- `cc-i-squared` — 1i * 1i = num(-1)  _[warrant: reference]_
- `cc-is-set` — cc in set
- `cc-mul-assoc` — forall([a, b, c], a in cc and b in cc and c in cc implies (a * b) * c = a * (b * c))
- `cc-mul-closed` — forall([a, b], a in cc and b in cc implies a * b in cc)
- `cc-mul-comm` — forall([a, b], a in cc and b in cc implies a * b = b * a)
- `cc-neg-closed` — forall([a in cc], -a in cc)
- `cc-neg-inverse` — forall([a in cc], a + -a = 0)
- `cc-one-in` — 1 in cc
- `cc-one-mul` — forall([a in cc], 1 * a = a)
- `cc-recip-closed` — forall([a], a in cc and not(a = 0) implies recip(a) in cc)
- `cc-recip-inverse` — forall([a], a in cc and not(a = 0) implies a * recip(a) = 1)
- `cc-self-conj-nonneg` — forall([a in cc], a * conjugate(a) in rr and 0 <= a * conjugate(a))
- `cc-self-conj-real` — forall([a in cc], a * conjugate(a) in rr)
- `cc-zero-in` — 0 in cc
- `choice-axiom` — forall([a], forsome([x], x in a) implies choice(a) in a)
- `class-extensionality` — forall([a, b], forall([x], x in a iff x in b) implies a = b)
- `complement-in-membership` — forall([a, b, x], x in complement-in(a, b) iff x in a and not(x in b))
- `complement-in-set-closure` — forall([a, b], a in set implies complement-in(a, b) in set)
- `dom-fun-membership` — forall([a, f in fun(a), x], x in dom(f) iff x in a)
- `dom-membership` — forall([f, x], x in dom(f) iff x in set and f(x) in set)
- `dom-of-fun` — forall([a, f], f in fun(a) and a in set implies dom(f) in set and dom(f) = a)
- `empty-set-has-no-members` — forall([x], not(x in empty-set))
- `empty-set-is-set` — empty-set in set
- `eq-subst-membership` — forall([a, b, s], a = b and b in s implies a in s)
- `equality-symmetry` — forall([a, b], a = b implies b = a)
- `equality-transitivity` — forall([a, b, c], a = b and b = c implies a = c)
- `extensionality` — forall([a, b], a in set and b in set implies a = b iff forall([x], x in a iff x in b))
- `fun-apply-type` — forall([f, a, b, x], f in fun(a, b) and x in a implies f(x) in b)
- `fun-codomain-iff` — forall([a, b, f], f in fun(a, b) iff f in fun(a) and forall([x in a], f(x) in b))
- `fun-domain-apply-def` — forall([a, f, x], f in fun(a) implies f(x) = f(x) iff x in a)

- `cc-normed-field@fnrm` — fnrm(cc-normed-field) == vnb-lambda(x_, cc, magnitude(x_))

- `cc-normed-field@neg` — neg(cc-normed-field) == vnb-lambda(x_, cc, -x_)

- `cc-normed-field@zero` — zero(cc-normed-field) == 0

- `cips-act-type` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([a_ in cc, x_ in vec(v)], (act(v))(a_, x_) in vec(v)))
- `cips-ip-add-left` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v), z_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))((vadd(v))(x_, y_), z_) = (ip(v))(x_, z_) + (ip(v))(y_, z_)))

- `cips-ip-zero-vector` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(x_, x_) = 0 implies x_ = vzero(v)))

- `def-strict-eq-l` — forall([mdt_, mdhs_, mdc_], def-strict-eq-l(mdt_, mdhs_, mdc_) iff mdc_ in seq-set and forsome([mdg_, mds_, mdu_], mdc_ = [mdg_, enc-eq(mds_, mds_)] and mdhs_ = [[mdg_, enc-eq(mds_, mdu_)]]))
- `def-strict-eq-r` — forall([mdt_, mdhs_, mdc_], def-strict-eq-r(mdt_, mdhs_, mdc_) iff mdc_ in seq-set and forsome([mdg_, mds_, mdu_], mdc_ = [mdg_, enc-eq(mdu_, mdu_)] and mdhs_ = [[mdg_, enc-eq(mds_, mdu_)]]))
- `def-strict-hyp` — forall([mdt_, mdhs_, mdc_], def-strict-hyp(mdt_, mdhs_, mdc_) iff mdc_ in seq-set and forsome([mdg_, mdf_, md7h2_, mdw_], mdc_ = [mdg_, enc-eq(mdw_, mdw_)] and mdhs_ = [[mdg_, mdf_]] and md7h2_ in true-reach(mdf_) and strict-atom(md7h2_, mdw_)))

- `def-strict-in-r` — forall([mdt_, mdhs_, mdc_], def-strict-in-r(mdt_, mdhs_, mdc_) iff mdc_ in seq-set and forsome([mdg_, mdw_, mda_], mdc_ = [mdg_, enc-eq(mda_, mda_)] and mdhs_ = [[mdg_, enc-in(mdw_, mda_)]]))

- `deg-bound` — forall([a, p, n], deg-bound(a, p, n) iff forall([k_ in nn], n < k_ implies p(k_) = zero(a)))
- `det-cofactor` — forall([r, n, a], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies a in mat(succ(n), succ(n), carr(r)) implies det(r, succ(n), a) == finsum(ring-additive-ag(r), vnb-lambda(j, interval(1, succ(n)), (mul(r))(mpow(ring-multiplicative-monoid(r), (neg(r))(one(r)), succ(j)), (mul(r))(entry(a, 1, j), det(r, n, minor(a, 1, j, n))))), interval(1, succ(n))))
- `det-zero` — forall([r, a], det(r, 0, a) == one(r))
- `dual-carrier` — forall([m], vec(dual(m)) == dual-vec(m))
- `dual-norm-value` — forall([m, f in dual-vec(m)], (vnrm(dual(m)))(f) == dual-norm(m, f))
- `dual-scal` — forall([m], scal(dual(m)) == rr-normed-field)
- `dual-vec-membership` — forall([m, f], f in dual-vec(m) iff f in fun(vec(m), rr) and is-bounded-linear-functional(m, f))
- `econverges-to` — forall([f, l], econverges-to(f, l) iff f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) and l in rr-pos-star and eliminf(f) = l and elimsup(f) = l)
- `ell-one-def` — ell-one = {x_ in sqn(cc): series-converges(vnb-lambda(k_, nn, magnitude(x_(k_))))}
- `ell-two-def` — ell-two = {x_ in sqn(cc): series-converges(vnb-lambda(k_, nn, magnitude(x_(k_)) * magnitude(x_(k_))))}
- `empty-in-tuples` — forall([a], [] in tuples(a))
- `enc-ande-succ` — forall([mcl_, mca_, mcn_ in nn], enc-ande(mcl_, mca_, succ(mcn_)) == enc-and(enc-ande(mcl_, mca_, mcn_), enc-in(nth(succ(mcn_), mcl_), mca_)))
- `enc-ande-zero` — forall([mcl_, mca_], enc-ande(mcl_, mca_, 0) == enc-truth)
- `enc-andl-succ` — forall([mcx_, mcl_, mcn_ in nn], enc-andl(mcx_, mcl_, succ(mcn_)) == enc-and(enc-andl(mcx_, mcl_, mcn_), enc-in(mcx_, nth(succ(mcn_), mcl_))))
- `enc-andl-zero` — forall([mcx_, mcl_], enc-andl(mcx_, mcl_, 0) == enc-truth)
- `enc-cartl-succ` — forall([mcx_, mcl_, mcn_ in nn], enc-cartl(mcx_, mcl_, succ(mcn_)) == enc-and(enc-cartl(mcx_, mcl_, mcn_), enc-in(enc-nth(enc-num(succ(mcn_)), mcx_), nth(succ(mcn_), mcl_))))
- `enc-cartl-zero` — forall([mcx_, mcl_], enc-cartl(mcx_, mcl_, 0) == enc-truth)
- `enc-cch-succ` — forall([mix_, mia_, min_, mik_ in nn], enc-cch(mix_, mia_, min_, succ(mik_)) == enc-ex(enc-and(enc-in(ebvar(0), nth(min_ - mik_, mia_)), enc-cch(mix_, mia_, min_, mik_))))
- `enc-cch-zero` — forall([mix_, mia_, min_], enc-cch(mix_, mia_, min_, 0) == enc-eq(mix_, enc-list(idx-list(min_))))
- `enc-eql-succ` — forall([mcl_, mca_, mcn_ in nn], enc-eql(mcl_, mca_, succ(mcn_)) == enc-and(enc-eql(mcl_, mca_, mcn_), enc-eq(nth(succ(mcn_), mcl_), nth(succ(mcn_), mca_))))
- `enc-eql-zero` — forall([mcl_, mca_], enc-eql(mcl_, mca_, 0) == enc-truth)
- `enc-falsity-def` — enc-falsity == eapp(1, [])
- `enc-nnc-def` — enc-nnc == econst(3)
- `enc-ordc-def` — enc-ordc == econst(5)
- `enc-orl-succ` — forall([mcx_, mcl_, mcn_ in nn], enc-orl(mcx_, mcl_, succ(mcn_)) == enc-or(enc-orl(mcx_, mcl_, mcn_), enc-in(mcx_, nth(succ(mcn_), mcl_))))
- `enc-orl-zero` — forall([mcx_, mcl_], enc-orl(mcx_, mcl_, 0) == enc-falsity)
- `enc-setc-def` — enc-setc == econst(1)
- `enc-tcj-succ` — forall([mia_, mib_, min_, mik_ in nn], enc-tcj(mia_, mib_, min_, succ(mik_)) == if(mik_ = 0, enc-eq(nth(min_, mia_), nth(min_, mib_)), enc-and(enc-eq(nth(min_ - mik_, mia_), nth(min_ - mik_, mib_)), enc-tcj(mia_, mib_, min_, mik_))))
- `enc-tcj-zero` — forall([mia_, mib_, min_], enc-tcj(mia_, mib_, min_, 0) == enc-truth)
- `enc-truth-def` — enc-truth == eapp(0, [])

- `eqv-ok` — forall([mrt_, mrx_], eqv-ok(mrt_, mrx_) iff forsome([mrg_, mre_, mrf_], mrx_ = [2, mrg_, mre_, mrf_] and mre_ in clf and mrf_ in clf and [mrg_, enc-iff(mre_, mrf_)] in derivable(mrt_) or mrx_ = [1, mrg_, mre_, mrf_] and mre_ in clt and mrf_ in clt and [mrg_, enc-qeq(mre_, mrf_)] in derivable(mrt_)))
- `etimes-def` — etimes == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr-pos-star, rr-pos-star), if(x_ = pos-inf or y_ = pos-inf, if(x_ = 0 or y_ = 0, 0, pos-inf), bintimes(x_, y_)))
- `euclidean-ring-class` — forall([s], s in euclidean-ring iff is-euclidean-ring(s))
- `even` — forall([x], even(x) iff forsome([k in zz], x = 2 * k))
- `even-def` — forall([x], even(x) iff forsome([k in zz], x = 2 * k))
- `expr-lc` — forall([mxe_], expr-lc(mxe_) iff 0 in expr-lcd(mxe_))
- `expr-set-def` — expr-set == big-union(mxn_, nn, expr-stage(mxn_))
- `expr-stage-succ` — forall([mxn_ in nn], expr-stage(succ(mxn_)) == union(expr-stage(mxn_), union(cartesian(pair(3, 3), nn, tuples(expr-stage(mxn_))), cartesian(pair(4, 4), nn, nn, tuples(expr-stage(mxn_)), expr-stage(mxn_)))))
- `expr-stage-zero` — expr-stage(0) == union(cartesian(pair(0, 0), nn), union(cartesian(pair(1, 1), nn), cartesian(pair(2, 2), nn)))

- `field-multiplicative-group-is-group` — forall([r], is-field(r) implies is-group(field-multiplicative-group(r)))
- `field-non-zero-carrier` — forall([s], is-field(s) implies non-zero(s) = difference(carr(s), singleton(zero(s))))

- `finsum-all-id-ring-additive-ag` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(r))], forall([z in s], f(z) = zero(r)) implies finsum(ring-additive-ag(r), f, s) = zero(r))))
- `finsum-single-support-ring-additive-ag` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(r)), i0 in s], forall([j in s], not(j = i0) implies f(j) = zero(r)) implies finsum(ring-additive-ag(r), f, s) = f(i0))))
- `finsum-type-ring-additive-ag` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(r))], finsum(ring-additive-ag(r), f, s) in carr(r))))
- `fr-cauchy` — forall([m, fam, seq], fr-cauchy(m, fam, seq) iff forall([k in nn, eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap in nn], forall([i], i in nn and cap <= i implies forall([j], j in nn and cap <= j implies (fam(k))((vadd(m))(seq(i), (vneg(m))(seq(j)))) < eps)))))
- `fr-conv` — forall([m, fam, seq, lim], fr-conv(m, fam, seq, lim) iff forall([k in nn, eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap in nn], forall([i], i in nn and cap <= i implies (fam(k))((vadd(m))(seq(i), (vneg(m))(lim))) < eps))))
- `fv-stage-succ` — forall([mxn_ in nn], fv-stage(succ(mxn_)) == vnb-lambda(mxe_, expr-stage(succ(mxn_)), if(mxe_ in expr-stage(mxn_), (fv-stage(mxn_))(mxe_), if(nth(1, mxe_) = 3, big-union(mxw_, make-set(nth(3, mxe_)), (fv-stage(mxn_))(mxw_)), union(big-union(mxw_, make-set(nth(4, mxe_)), (fv-stage(mxn_))(mxw_)), (fv-stage(mxn_))(nth(5, mxe_)))))))
- `fv-stage-zero` — fv-stage(0) == vnb-lambda(mxe_, expr-stage(0), if(nth(1, mxe_) = 0, pair(nth(2, mxe_), nth(2, mxe_)), empty-set))
- `generates` — forall([md, n, u], generates(md, n, u) iff forall([x_ in vec(md)], forsome([c_ in mat(1, n, carr(scal(md)))], x_ = lincomb(md, n, c_, u))))

- `group-class` — forall([s], s in group iff is-group(s))
- `has-closed-graph` — forall([m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt], has-closed-graph(m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt) iff is-linear-map(m1, m2, tt) and forall([seq in fun(nn, vec(m1)), p1 in vec(m1), p2 in vec(m2)], fr-conv(m1, fam1, seq, p1) and fr-conv(m2, fam2, vnb-lambda(i, nn, tt(seq(i))), p2) implies p2 = tt(p1)))
- `has-deriv-at` — forall([f, a, l], has-deriv-at(f, a, l) iff forsome([ice_], pos-rr(ice_) and is-diff-on(rr-normed-field, ooint(a - ice_, a + ice_), restrict(f, ooint(a - ice_, a + ice_)), a, l)))
- `has-deriv-at-within` — forall([f, w, x, l], has-deriv-at-within(f, w, x, l) iff restrict(f, w) in fun(w, rr) and x in w and l in rr and forsome([osp_ in fun(w, rr)], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(rr-ms, w), rr-ms, osp_, x) and osp_(x) = l and forall([ost_ in w], f(ost_) - f(x) = osp_(ost_) * (ost_ - x))))
- `has-div-remainder` — forall([s, dg], has-div-remainder(s, dg) iff forall([a_ in carr(s), b in carr(s)], not(b = zero(s)) implies forsome([q in carr(s), r in carr(s)], a_ = (add(s))((mul(s))(q, b), r) and (r = zero(s) or succ(dg(r)) <= dg(b)))))
- `has-fip` — forall([s, c], has-fip(s, c) iff is-metric-space(s) and forsome([a0], a0 in c) and forall([a in c], is-closed(s, a)) and forall([f], f subset c implies card(f) in nn implies forsome([a0], a0 in f) implies forsome([p], p in intersection-of(f))))
- `has-inverses` — forall([op, unit, invop, crr], has-inverses(op, unit, invop, crr) iff forall([u in crr], op(invop(u), u) = unit and op(u, invop(u)) = unit))
- `has-left-deriv-at` — forall([f, x, l], has-left-deriv-at(f, x, l) iff forsome([ose_], pos-rr(ose_) and has-deriv-at-within(f, ocint(x - ose_, x), x, l)))
- `has-right-deriv-at` — forall([f, x, l], has-right-deriv-at(f, x, l) iff forsome([ose_], pos-rr(ose_) and has-deriv-at-within(f, coint(x, x + ose_), x, l)))
- `holomorphic-on` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) iff is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) and f in fun(u, cc) and forall([a in u], forsome([l], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, u, f, a, l))))
- `hyps-in` — forall([mchs_, mcs_], hyps-in(mchs_, mcs_) iff forall([mci_ in nn], 1 <= mci_ implies mci_ <= length(mchs_) implies nth(mci_, mchs_) in mcs_))
- `imag-part-def` — forall([z], imag-part(z) == (z - conjugate(z)) * recip(2 * 1i))
- `image-membership-iff` — forall([phi, s, w], w in image(phi, s) iff w in set and forsome([x in s], phi(x) = w))
- `improper-int-converges-to` — forall([ipf_, ipl_], improper-int-converges-to(ipf_, ipl_) iff ipl_ in cc and forall([ipe_], pos-rr(ipe_) implies forsome([ipd_], pos-rr(ipd_) and forsome([ipm_ in rr], forall([ipr_ in rr, ipq_ in rr], 0 < ipr_ implies ipr_ < ipd_ implies ipm_ < ipq_ implies ipr_ < ipq_ implies magnitude(cc-int(ipf_, ipr_, ipq_) - ipl_) <= ipe_)))))
- `inf-subsets-membership` — forall([a, s], s in inf-subsets(a) iff s subset a and not(card(s) in nn))

- `is-absolutely-summable` — forall([grp, f], is-absolutely-summable(grp, f) iff esum(vnb-lambda(i, dom(f), (nrm(grp))(f(i)))) in rr)
- `is-adversary-node` — forall([sai_, san_], is-adversary-node(sai_, san_) iff nth(2, san_) in adv-ids(sai_))
- `is-adversary-trace` — forall([sasp_, sap_, sas_], is-adversary-trace(sasp_, sap_, sas_) iff is-text-trace(sasp_, sap_, sas_) or is-flush-trace(sasp_, sas_) or is-tee-trace(sasp_, sas_) or is-concat-trace(sasp_, sas_) or is-separate-trace(sasp_, sas_) or is-encrypt-trace(sasp_, sas_) or is-decrypt-trace(sasp_, sas_))
- `is-algebra-of-sets` — forall([omega, ca], is-algebra-of-sets(omega, ca) iff omega in set and ca subset power(omega) and forsome([a_], a_ in ca) and forall([a_ in ca], complement-in(omega, a_) in ca) and forall([a_ in ca, b_ in ca], union(a_, b_) in ca) and forall([a_ in ca, b_ in ca], intersection(a_, b_) in ca))
- `is-analytic-at` — forall([anlf_, anlu_, anla_], is-analytic-at(anlf_, anlu_, anla_) iff is-open(cc-ms, anlu_) and anlf_ in fun(anlu_, cc) and anla_ in anlu_ and forsome([anlcf_ in fun(nn, cc), anlr_ in rr], 0 < anlr_ and anlr_ < cps-radius(anlcf_) and ball(cc-ms, anla_, anlr_) subset anlu_ and forall([anlz_ in ball(cc-ms, anla_, anlr_)], anlf_(anlz_) = cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(anlk_, nn, anlcf_(anlk_) * (anlz_ - anla_) ^ anlk_)))))

- `is-associative` — forall([op, crr], is-associative(op, crr) iff forall([u in crr, v in crr, w in crr], op(op(u, v), w) = op(u, op(v, w))))
- `is-bounded-linear-arrow-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-bounded-linear-arrow(a, b, f) iff is-normed-vector-space(a) and is-normed-vector-space(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forsome([blk_ in rr], 0 <= blk_ and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], (vnrm(b))(f(x1_)) <= blk_ * (vnrm(a))(x1_))))
- `is-bounded-linear-functional` — forall([m, f], is-bounded-linear-functional(m, f) iff is-linear-functional(m, f) and forsome([c_ in rr], 0 <= c_ and forall([x_ in vec(m)], abs(f(x_)) <= c_ * (vnrm(m))(x_))))
- `is-bounded-linear-functional-on` — forall([m, s, f], is-bounded-linear-functional-on(m, s, f) iff is-linear-functional-on(m, s, f) and forsome([c_ in rr], 0 <= c_ and forall([x_ in s], abs(f(x_)) <= c_ * (vnrm(m))(x_))))
- `is-bounded-metric-space` — forall([s], is-bounded-metric-space(s) iff is-metric-space(s) and forsome([b in rr], forall([x, y], x in pts(s) implies y in pts(s) implies (dist(s))(x, y) <= b)))
- `is-bundle` — forall([s], is-bundle(s) iff length(s) = 3 and is-strand-space(bspace(s)) and bnodes(s) in set and bsend(s) in power(cartesian(bnodes(s), bnodes(s))) and forall([ssx_ in bnodes(s)], ssx_ in nodes(bspace(s))) and card(bnodes(s)) in nn and forall([ssx_, ssy_], [ssx_, ssy_] in bsend(s) implies sends-to(bspace(s), ssx_, ssy_)) and forall([ssy_ in bnodes(s)], is-received(bspace(s), ssy_) implies forsome([ssx_], [ssx_, ssy_] in bsend(s) and forall([ssz_], [ssz_, ssy_] in bsend(s) implies ssz_ = ssx_))) and forall([ssy_ in bnodes(s), ssx_], same-strand-before(bspace(s), ssx_, ssy_) implies ssx_ in bnodes(s)) and forall([ssx_], not([ssx_, ssx_] in prec-strict(bspace(s), bnodes(s), bsend(s)))))
- `is-c-continuous-arrow-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-c-continuous-arrow(a, b, f) iff is-c-metric-space(a) and is-c-metric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and is-continuous(c-metric(a), c-metric(b), f))
- `is-c-metric-space` — forall([s], is-c-metric-space(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and dists(s) in fun(nn, fun(cartesian(pts(s), pts(s)), rr)) and forall([k_ in nn], is-pseudometric((dists(s))(k_), pts(s))) and forall([u in pts(s), v in pts(s)], forall([k_ in nn], ((dists(s))(k_))(u, v) = 0) implies u = v))
- `is-caratheodory-measurable` — forall([omega, mu, es], is-caratheodory-measurable(omega, mu, es) iff es subset omega and forall([a_ in power(omega)], mu(a_) = eplus(mu(intersection(a_, es)), mu(difference(a_, es)))))
- `is-cauchy-seq` — forall([s, f], is-cauchy-seq(s, f) iff is-metric-space(s) and f in fun(nn, pts(s)) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n in nn], forall([m in nn, n_ in nn], n <= m and n <= n_ implies (dist(s))(f(m), f(n_)) <= eps))))
- `is-cc-diff-at` — forall([g, a, l], is-cc-diff-at(g, a, l) iff g in fun(rr, cc) and a in rr and l in cc and is-diff-at(vnb-lambda(sv_, rr, real-part(g(sv_))), a, real-part(l)) and is-diff-at(vnb-lambda(sv_, rr, imag-part(g(sv_))), a, imag-part(l)))
- `is-cc-linear-functional` — forall([v, f], is-cc-linear-functional(v, f) iff f in fun(vec(v), cc) and forall([hlx_ in vec(v), hly_ in vec(v)], f((vadd(v))(hlx_, hly_)) = f(hlx_) + f(hly_)) and forall([hlc_ in cc, hlx_ in vec(v)], f((act(v))(hlc_, hlx_)) = hlc_ * f(hlx_)))
- `is-chain` — forall([grd, porel, ch], is-chain(grd, porel, ch) iff ch subset grd and forall([x in ch, y in ch], [x, y] in porel or [y, x] in porel))
- `is-closed` — forall([s, a], is-closed(s, a) iff is-metric-space(s) and a subset pts(s) and is-open(s, complement-in(pts(s), a)))
- `is-comm-monoid` — forall([s], is-comm-monoid(s) iff length(s) = 3 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and iden(s) in carr(s) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(opr(s), iden(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(opr(s), carr(s)))
- `is-commutative` — forall([op, crr], is-commutative(op, crr) iff forall([u in crr, v in crr], op(u, v) = op(v, u)))
- `is-commutative-ring-def` — forall([s], is-commutative-ring(s) iff is-ring(s) and forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s)], (mul(s))(a, b) = (mul(s))(b, a)))
- `is-compact` — forall([s], is-compact(s) iff is-metric-space(s) and forall([c], is-open-cover(s, c) implies forsome([f], f subset c and card(f) in nn and is-open-cover(s, f))))
- `is-compact-t` — forall([s], is-compact-t(s) iff is-top-space(s) and forall([c], forall([u in c], u in opens(s)) implies big-union(u, c, u) == pts(s) implies forsome([f], f subset c and card(f) in nn and big-union(u, f, u) == pts(s))))
- `is-complete` — forall([s], is-complete(s) iff is-metric-space(s) and forall([f], is-cauchy-seq(s, f) implies converges(s, f)))
- `is-complete-measure` — forall([omega, ca, mu], is-complete-measure(omega, ca, mu) iff is-measure(omega, ca, mu) and forall([nls_], is-null-set(omega, ca, mu, nls_) implies nls_ in ca))
- `is-complex-inner-product-space` — forall([s], is-complex-inner-product-space(s) iff length(s) = 7 and is-ring(scal(s)) and vec(s) in set and vadd(s) in fun(cartesian(vec(s), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vzero(s) in vec(s) and vneg(s) in fun(vec(s), vec(s)) and act(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(scal(s)), vec(s)), vec(s)) and ip(s) in fun(cartesian(vec(s), vec(s)), cc) and is-associative(vadd(s), vec(s)) and is-commutative(vadd(s), vec(s)) and is-identity(vadd(s), vzero(s), vec(s)) and has-inverses(vadd(s), vzero(s), vneg(s), vec(s)) and scal(s) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) and carr(scal(s)) = cc and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], (act(s))(r_, (vadd(s))(x_, y_)) = (vadd(s))((act(s))(r_, x_), (act(s))(r_, y_))) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)], (act(s))((add(scal(s)))(r_, s_), x_) = (vadd(s))((act(s))(r_, x_), (act(s))(s_, x_))) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)], (act(s))((mul(scal(s)))(r_, s_), x_) = (act(s))(r_, (act(s))(s_, x_))) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (act(s))(one(scal(s)), x_) = x_) and forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s), z_ in vec(s)], (ip(s))((vadd(s))(x_, y_), z_) = (ip(s))(x_, z_) + (ip(s))(y_, z_)) and forall([a_ in cc, x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], (ip(s))((act(s))(a_, x_), y_) = a_ * (ip(s))(x_, y_)) and forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], (ip(s))(y_, x_) = conjugate((ip(s))(x_, y_))) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (ip(s))(x_, x_) in rr) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], 0 <= (ip(s))(x_, x_)) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (ip(s))(x_, x_) = 0 iff x_ = vzero(s)))
- `is-concat-trace` — forall([sasp_, sas_], is-concat-trace(sasp_, sas_) iff forsome([sal_ in tuples(msg-set(tokens(sasp_), keys(sasp_)))], length(sas_) = succ(length(sal_)) and forall([sai_ in nn], 1 <= sai_ implies sai_ <= length(sal_) implies nth(sai_, sas_) = [received, nth(sai_, sal_)]) and nth(succ(length(sal_)), sas_) = [sent, lst(sal_)]))
- `is-connected` — forall([cns_, cna_], is-connected(cns_, cna_) iff is-metric-space(cns_) and cna_ subset pts(cns_) and forall([cnu_], is-open(cns_, cnu_) implies forall([cnv_], is-open(cns_, cnv_) implies cna_ subset union(cnu_, cnv_) implies forall([cnx_ in cna_], not(cnx_ in cnu_ and cnx_ in cnv_)) implies forsome([cnx_ in cna_], cnx_ in cnu_) implies not(forsome([cnx_ in cna_], cnx_ in cnv_)))))
- `is-cont-lin` — forall([m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt], is-cont-lin(m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt) iff is-linear-map(m1, m2, tt) and forall([seq in fun(nn, vec(m1)), lim in vec(m1)], fr-conv(m1, fam1, seq, lim) implies fr-conv(m2, fam2, vnb-lambda(i, nn, tt(seq(i))), tt(lim))))
- `is-continuous` — forall([s, t, f], is-continuous(s, t, f) iff is-metric-space(s) and is-metric-space(t) and f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) and forall([a in pts(s)], is-continuous-at(s, t, f, a)))
- `is-continuous-arrow-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-continuous-arrow(a, b, f) iff is-metric-space(a) and is-metric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and is-continuous(a, b, f))
- `is-continuous-at` — forall([s, t, f, a], is-continuous-at(s, t, f, a) iff is-metric-space(s) and is-metric-space(t) and f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) and a in pts(s) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([delta], pos-rr(delta) and forall([b in pts(s)], (dist(s))(a, b) <= delta implies (dist(t))(f(a), f(b)) <= eps))))
- `is-continuous-on` — forall([f, d], is-continuous-on(f, d) iff f in fun(d, rr) and forall([icp_ in d], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(rr-ms, d), rr-ms, f, icp_)))
- `is-convex-cc` — forall([cvu_], is-convex-cc(cvu_) iff cvu_ subset cc and forall([cvx_ in cvu_, cvy_ in cvu_, cvt_ in ccint(0, 1)], cvx_ + cvt_ * (cvy_ - cvx_) in cvu_))
- `is-countable` — forall([rpc_], is-countable(rpc_) iff rpc_ in set and (rpc_ = empty-set or forsome([rpen_ in fun(nn, rpc_)], forall([rpy_ in rpc_], forsome([rpn_ in nn], rpy_ = rpen_(rpn_))))))
- `is-countable-pseudometric-family` — forall([fam, ground], is-countable-pseudometric-family(fam, ground) iff forall([n_ in nn], is-pseudometric-space(fam(n_)) and pts(fam(n_)) == ground))
- `is-decrypt-trace` — forall([sasp_, sas_], is-decrypt-trace(sasp_, sas_) iff forsome([sak_ in keys(sasp_), sag_ in msg-set(tokens(sasp_), keys(sasp_))], sas_ = [[received, (kinv(sasp_))(sak_)], [received, encr(sag_, sak_)], [sent, sag_]]))
- `is-dense-seq` — forall([s, dseq], is-dense-seq(s, dseq) iff is-metric-space(s) and dseq in fun(nn, pts(s)) and forall([x in pts(s), eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([m in nn], (dist(s))(x, dseq(m)) < eps)))
- `is-diagonal` — forall([a, m, n, d], is-diagonal(a, m, n, d) iff forall([i, j], i in interval(1, m) implies j in interval(1, n) implies not(i = j) implies entry(d, i, j) = zero(a)))
- `is-diff-at` — forall([f, a, l], is-diff-at(f, a, l) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and a in rr and l in rr and forsome([phi in fun(rr, rr)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, phi, a) and phi(a) = l and forall([x in rr], f(x) - f(a) = phi(x) * (x - a))))
- `is-diff-at-v` — forall([m, f, a, l], is-diff-at-v(m, f, a, l) iff is-normed-vector-space(m) and f in fun(rr, vec(m)) and a in rr and l in vec(m) and forsome([phi in fun(rr, vec(m))], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, nvs-metric-space(m), phi, a) and phi(a) = l and forall([x_ in rr], (vadd(m))(f(x_), (vneg(m))(f(a))) = (act(m))(x_ - a, phi(x_)))))
- `is-diff-on` — forall([k, u, f, a, l], is-diff-on(k, u, f, a, l) iff is-normed-field(k) and is-open(nf-metric-space(k), u) and f in fun(u, carr(k)) and a in u and l in carr(k) and forsome([phi in fun(u, carr(k))], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(k), u), nf-metric-space(k), phi, a) and phi(a) = l and forall([x in u], (add(k))(f(x), (neg(k))(f(a))) = (mul(k))(phi(x), (add(k))(x, (neg(k))(a))))))
- `is-dir-diff-at` — forall([m, f, a, eta, dl], is-dir-diff-at(m, f, a, eta, dl) iff is-diff-at(seg-curve(m, f, a, eta), 0, dl))
- `is-distributive` — forall([addop, mulop, crr], is-distributive(addop, mulop, crr) iff forall([u in crr, v in crr, w in crr], mulop(u, addop(v, w)) = addop(mulop(u, v), mulop(u, w)) and mulop(addop(u, v), w) = addop(mulop(u, w), mulop(v, w))))
- `is-dynkin-system` — forall([omega, dd], is-dynkin-system(omega, dd) iff omega in set and dd subset power(omega) and omega in dd and forall([dya_ in dd, dyb_ in dd], dya_ subset dyb_ implies complement-in(dyb_, dya_) in dd) and forall([dyf_ in fun(nn, dd)], forall([dyn_ in nn], dyf_(dyn_) subset dyf_(succ(dyn_))) implies big-union(dyk_, nn, dyf_(dyk_)) in dd))
- `is-encrypt-trace` — forall([sasp_, sas_], is-encrypt-trace(sasp_, sas_) iff forsome([sak_ in keys(sasp_), sag_ in msg-set(tokens(sasp_), keys(sasp_))], sas_ = [[received, sak_], [received, sag_], [sent, encr(sag_, sak_)]]))
- `is-entry-point` — forall([ssp_, ssn_, ssi_], is-entry-point(ssp_, ssn_, ssi_) iff ssn_ in nodes(ssp_) and is-sent(ssp_, ssn_) and node-content(ssp_, ssn_) in ssi_ and forall([ssm_], same-strand-before(ssp_, ssm_, ssn_) implies not(node-content(ssp_, ssm_) in ssi_)))
- `is-eps-cauchy-seq` — forall([s, eps, y], is-eps-cauchy-seq(s, eps, y) iff is-metric-space(s) and y in fun(nn, pts(s)) and forall([m in nn, n_ in nn], (dist(s))(y(m), y(n_)) <= eps))
- `is-equicontinuous` — forall([s, t, fam], is-equicontinuous(s, t, fam) iff is-metric-space(s) and is-metric-space(t) and fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), pts(t))) and forall([x in pts(s), eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([del], pos-rr(del) and forall([k in nn, y in pts(s)], (dist(s))(x, y) < del implies (dist(t))((fam(k))(x), (fam(k))(y)) < eps))))
- `is-equivalence` — forall([rho, crr], is-equivalence(rho, crr) iff rho in power(cartesian(crr, crr)) and forall([u in crr], [u, u] in rho) and forall([u in crr, v in crr], [u, v] in rho implies [v, u] in rho) and forall([u in crr, v in crr, w in crr], [u, v] in rho and [v, w] in rho implies [u, w] in rho))
- `is-euclidean-ring-def` — forall([s], is-euclidean-ring(s) iff is-integral-domain(s) and forsome([dg in fun(carr(s), nn)], forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s)], not(b = zero(s)) implies forsome([q in carr(s), r in carr(s)], a = (add(s))((mul(s))(q, b), r) and (r = zero(s) or succ(dg(r)) <= dg(b))))))
- `is-field` — forall([s], is-field(s) iff length(s) = 8 and carr(s) in set and add(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and mul(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and neg(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and zero(s) in carr(s) and one(s) in carr(s) and non-zero(s) in set and non-zero(s) = difference(carr(s), singleton(zero(s))) and mul-inv(s) in fun(non-zero(s), non-zero(s)) and is-associative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(add(s), zero(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(add(s), zero(s), neg(s), carr(s)) and is-associative(mul(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(mul(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(mul(s), one(s), carr(s)) and is-distributive(add(s), mul(s), carr(s)) and not(zero(s) = one(s)) and forall([a_ in non-zero(s)], (mul(s))(a_, (mul-inv(s))(a_)) = one(s)))
- `is-field-ring-def` — forall([s], is-field-ring(s) iff is-commutative-ring(s) and not(one(s) = zero(s)) and forall([a_ in carr(s)], not(a_ = zero(s)) implies forsome([b_ in carr(s)], (mul(s))(a_, b_) = one(s))))
- `is-finite-cover` — forall([c, a], is-finite-cover(c, a) iff c in set and card(c) in nn and a subset big-union(u, c, u))
- `is-finite-dimensional` — forall([m], is-finite-dimensional(m) iff is-vector-space(m) and is-noetherian(m))
- `is-flush-trace` — forall([sasp_, sas_], is-flush-trace(sasp_, sas_) iff forsome([sag_ in msg-set(tokens(sasp_), keys(sasp_))], sas_ = [[received, sag_]]))
- `is-fr-bounded` — forall([m, fam, aa], is-fr-bounded(m, fam, aa) iff aa subset vec(m) and forall([k in nn], forsome([bd in rr], forall([y in aa], (fam(k))(y) <= bd))))
- `is-fr-equicont` — forall([m1, fam1, m2, fam2, ix, tf], is-fr-equicont(m1, fam1, m2, fam2, ix, tf) iff tf in fun(ix, fun(vec(m1), vec(m2))) and forall([k in nn], forsome([nb in nn, ck], pos-rr(ck) and forall([i in ix, x in vec(m1), r in rr], forall([j in nn], j <= nb implies (fam1(j))(x) <= r) implies (fam2(k))((tf(i))(x)) <= ck * r))))
- `is-frechet-structure` — forall([fld, m, fam], is-frechet-structure(fld, m, fam) iff is-seminorm-family(fld, m, fam) and forall([seq in fun(nn, vec(m))], fr-cauchy(m, fam, seq) implies forsome([lim in vec(m)], fr-conv(m, fam, seq, lim))))
- `is-fubini-set` — forall([xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu, cs], is-fubini-set(xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu, cs) iff is-measurable-fn(xs, ca, x-section-measure(xs, ys, nu, cs)) and is-measurable-fn(ys, cb, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, cs)) and integral(xs, ca, mu, x-section-measure(xs, ys, nu, cs)) = integral(ys, cb, nu, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, cs)))
- `is-gauge-countable` — forall([s], is-gauge-countable(s) iff is-top-space(s) and forsome([fam], is-countable-pseudometric-family(fam, pts(s)) and pseudo-gauge-top(fam, pts(s)) == s))
- `is-group` — forall([s], is-group(s) iff length(s) = 4 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and iden(s) in carr(s) and inv(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(opr(s), iden(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(opr(s), iden(s), inv(s), carr(s)))
- `is-group-norm` — forall([nm, op, invop, unit, crr], is-group-norm(nm, op, invop, unit, crr) iff nm in fun(crr, rr) and forall([u in crr], 0 <= nm(u) and (nm(u) = 0 iff u = unit) and nm(invop(u)) = nm(u) and forall([v in crr], nm(op(u, v)) <= nm(u) + nm(v))))
- `is-hausdorff` — forall([s], is-hausdorff(s) iff is-top-space(s) and forall([a, b], a in pts(s) implies b in pts(s) implies not(a == b) implies forsome([u, v], u in opens(s) and v in opens(s) and a in u and b in v and intersection(u, v) == empty-set)))
- `is-hilbert-space` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) iff is-complex-inner-product-space(v) and is-complete(ip-metric-space(v)))
- `is-hom-abelian-group-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-abelian-group(a, b, f) iff is-abelian-group(a) and is-abelian-group(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((opr(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (opr(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(iden(a)) = iden(b) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], f((inv(a))(x1_)) = (inv(b))(f(x1_))))
- `is-hom-bundle-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-bundle(a, b, f) iff is-bundle(a) and is-bundle(b) and f in fun(bnodes(a), bnodes(b)) and bspace(a) = bspace(b) and forall([x1_ in bnodes(a), x2_ in bnodes(a)], [x1_, x2_] in bsend(a) implies [f(x1_), f(x2_)] in bsend(b)))
- `is-hom-c-metric-space-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-c-metric-space(a, b, f) iff is-c-metric-space(a) and is-c-metric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and forall([x1_ in nn], (dists(a))(x1_) = (dists(b))(x1_)))
- `is-hom-comm-monoid-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-comm-monoid(a, b, f) iff is-comm-monoid(a) and is-comm-monoid(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((opr(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (opr(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(iden(a)) = iden(b))
- `is-hom-commutative-ring-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-commutative-ring(a, b, f) iff is-commutative-ring(a) and is-commutative-ring(b) and is-hom-ring(a, b, f))
- `is-hom-complex-inner-product-space-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-complex-inner-product-space(a, b, f) iff is-complex-inner-product-space(a) and is-complex-inner-product-space(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vzero(a)) = vzero(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((vneg(a))(x1_)) = (vneg(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], (ip(a))(x1_, x2_) = (ip(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))))
- `is-hom-euclidean-ring-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-euclidean-ring(a, b, f) iff is-euclidean-ring(a) and is-euclidean-ring(b) and is-hom-integral-domain(a, b, f))
- `is-hom-field-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-field(a, b, f) iff is-field(a) and is-field(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((add(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (add(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((mul(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (mul(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], f((neg(a))(x1_)) = (neg(b))(f(x1_))) and f(zero(a)) = zero(b) and f(one(a)) = one(b) and forall([x1_ in non-zero(a)], f((mul-inv(a))(x1_)) = (mul-inv(b))(f(x1_))))
- `is-hom-field-ring-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-field-ring(a, b, f) iff is-field-ring(a) and is-field-ring(b) and is-hom-commutative-ring(a, b, f))
- `is-hom-group-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-group(a, b, f) iff is-group(a) and is-group(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((opr(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (opr(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(iden(a)) = iden(b) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], f((inv(a))(x1_)) = (inv(b))(f(x1_))))
- `is-hom-infiltrated-space-def` — forall([a, b, f1, f2], is-hom-infiltrated-space(a, b, f1, f2) iff is-infiltrated-space(a) and is-infiltrated-space(b) and f1 in fun(adv-ids(a), adv-ids(b)) and f2 in fun(adv-tokens(a), adv-tokens(b)) and ispace(a) = ispace(b))
- `is-hom-integral-domain-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-integral-domain(a, b, f) iff is-integral-domain(a) and is-integral-domain(b) and is-hom-commutative-ring(a, b, f))
- `is-hom-measurable-space-def` — forall([s, t, f], is-hom-measurable-space(s, t, f) iff is-measurable-space(s) and is-measurable-space(t) and f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) and forall([u in sigma(t)], preimage(s, f, u) in sigma(s)))
- `is-hom-measure-space-def` — forall([s, t, f], is-hom-measure-space(s, t, f) iff is-measure-space(s) and is-measure-space(t) and f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) and forall([u in sigma(t)], preimage(s, f, u) in sigma(s)) and forall([u in sigma(t)], (meas(t))(u) = (meas(s))(preimage(s, f, u))))
- `is-hom-metric-space-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-metric-space(a, b, f) iff is-metric-space(a) and is-metric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and forall([x1_ in pts(a), x2_ in pts(a)], (dist(a))(x1_, x2_) = (dist(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))))
- `is-hom-metrizable-top-space-def` — forall([s, t, f], is-hom-metrizable-top-space(s, t, f) iff is-metrizable-top-space(s) and is-metrizable-top-space(t) and f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) and forall([u in opens(t)], preimage(s, f, u) in opens(s)))
- `is-hom-module-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-module(a, b, f) iff is-module(a) and is-module(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vzero(a)) = vzero(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((vneg(a))(x1_)) = (vneg(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))))
- `is-hom-monoid-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-monoid(a, b, f) iff is-monoid(a) and is-monoid(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((opr(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (opr(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(iden(a)) = iden(b))
- `is-hom-normed-ag-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-normed-ag(a, b, f) iff is-normed-ag(a) and is-normed-ag(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((opr(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (opr(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(iden(a)) = iden(b) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], f((inv(a))(x1_)) = (inv(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], (nrm(a))(x1_) = (nrm(b))(f(x1_))))
- `is-hom-normed-field-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-normed-field(a, b, f) iff is-normed-field(a) and is-normed-field(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((add(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (add(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((mul(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (mul(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], f((neg(a))(x1_)) = (neg(b))(f(x1_))) and f(zero(a)) = zero(b) and f(one(a)) = one(b) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], (fnrm(a))(x1_) = (fnrm(b))(f(x1_))))
- `is-hom-normed-vector-space-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-normed-vector-space(a, b, f) iff is-normed-vector-space(a) and is-normed-vector-space(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vzero(a)) = vzero(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((vneg(a))(x1_)) = (vneg(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], (vnrm(a))(x1_) = (vnrm(b))(f(x1_))))
- `is-hom-pid-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-pid(a, b, f) iff is-pid(a) and is-pid(b) and is-hom-integral-domain(a, b, f))
- `is-hom-pk-space-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-pk-space(a, b, f) iff is-pk-space(a) and is-pk-space(b) and f in fun(names(a), names(b)) and pk-inf(a) = pk-inf(b) and forall([x1_ in names(a)], (pubkey(a))(x1_) = (pubkey(b))(f(x1_))))
- `is-hom-pseudometric-space-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-pseudometric-space(a, b, f) iff is-pseudometric-space(a) and is-pseudometric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and forall([x1_ in pts(a), x2_ in pts(a)], (dist(a))(x1_, x2_) = (dist(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))))
- `is-hom-ring-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-ring(a, b, f) iff is-ring(a) and is-ring(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((add(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (add(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((mul(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (mul(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], f((neg(a))(x1_)) = (neg(b))(f(x1_))) and f(zero(a)) = zero(b) and f(one(a)) = one(b))
- `is-hom-ringoid-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-ringoid(a, b, f) iff is-ringoid(a) and is-ringoid(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and is-hom-ring(ringoid-as-ring(a), ringoid-as-ring(b), f) and forall([x_ in idl(a)], f(x_) in idl(b)))

- `is-hom-setoid-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-setoid(a, b, f) iff is-setoid(a) and is-setoid(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and forall([x1_ in pts(a), x2_ in pts(a)], [x1_, x2_] in rel(a) implies [f(x1_), f(x2_)] in rel(b)))
- `is-hom-strand-space-def` — forall([a, b, f1, f2, f3], is-hom-strand-space(a, b, f1, f2, f3) iff is-strand-space(a) and is-strand-space(b) and f1 in fun(tokens(a), tokens(b)) and f2 in fun(ids(a), ids(b)) and f3 in fun(keys(a), keys(b)) and forall([x1_ in ids(a)], (strand-map(a))(x1_) = (strand-map(b))(f2(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in keys(a)], f3((kinv(a))(x1_)) = (kinv(b))(f3(x1_))))
- `is-hom-top-space-def` — forall([s, t, f], is-hom-top-space(s, t, f) iff is-top-space(s) and is-top-space(t) and f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) and forall([u in opens(t)], preimage(s, f, u) in opens(s)))
- `is-hom-vector-space-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-vector-space(a, b, f) iff is-vector-space(a) and is-vector-space(b) and is-hom-module(a, b, f))
- `is-ideal` — forall([s, i], is-ideal(s, i) iff is-commutative-ring(s) and i subset carr(s) and zero(s) in i and forall([a in i, b in i], (add(s))(a, b) in i) and forall([a in i], (neg(s))(a) in i) and forall([r in carr(s), a in i], (mul(s))(r, a) in i))
- `is-ideal-in` — forall([i_, carr_, add_, mul_, neg_, zero_], is-ideal-in(i_, carr_, add_, mul_, neg_, zero_) iff i_ subset carr_ and zero_ in i_ and forall([a, b], a in i_ implies b in i_ implies add_(a, b) in i_) and forall([a in i_], neg_(a) in i_) and forall([x_, a], x_ in carr_ implies a in i_ implies mul_(x_, a) in i_) and forall([x_, a], x_ in carr_ implies a in i_ implies mul_(a, x_) in i_))
- `is-identity` — forall([op, unit, crr], is-identity(op, unit, crr) iff forall([u in crr], op(unit, u) = u and op(u, unit) = u))
- `is-infiltrated-space` — forall([s], is-infiltrated-space(s) iff length(s) = 3 and is-strand-space(ispace(s)) and adv-ids(s) in set and adv-tokens(s) in set and forall([sap_ in adv-ids(s)], sap_ in ids(ispace(s))) and forall([sat_ in adv-tokens(s)], sat_ in tokens(ispace(s))) and forall([sap_ in adv-ids(s)], is-adversary-trace(ispace(s), adv-tokens(s), (strand-map(ispace(s)))(sap_))))
- `is-init-strand` — forall([nlp_, nls_, nla_, nlb_, nlm_, nln_], is-init-strand(nlp_, nls_, nla_, nlb_, nlm_, nln_) iff nla_ in names(nlp_) and nlb_ in names(nlp_) and nlm_ in tokens(ispace(pk-inf(nlp_))) and nln_ in tokens(ispace(pk-inf(nlp_))) and not(nlm_ in names(nlp_)) and not(nlm_ in keys(ispace(pk-inf(nlp_)))) and not(nln_ in keys(ispace(pk-inf(nlp_)))) and nls_ = [[sent, encr(lst([nlm_, nla_]), (pubkey(nlp_))(nlb_))], [received, encr(lst([nlm_, nln_, nlb_]), (pubkey(nlp_))(nla_))], [sent, encr(nln_, (pubkey(nlp_))(nlb_))]])
- `is-integrable` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f], is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, f) iff is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) and integral(omega, ca, mu, pos-part(omega, f)) in rr and integral(omega, ca, mu, neg-part(omega, f)) in rr)
- `is-integral-domain-def` — forall([s], is-integral-domain(s) iff is-commutative-ring(s) and not(one(s) = zero(s)) and forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s)], (mul(s))(a, b) = zero(s) implies a = zero(s) or b = zero(s)))
- `is-invertible-mat` — forall([a, n, u], is-invertible-mat(a, n, u) iff u in mat(n, n, carr(a)) and forsome([v in mat(n, n, carr(a))], matmul(a, u, v) = identmat(a, n) and matmul(a, v, u) = identmat(a, n)))
- `is-isometry` — forall([s, t, f], is-isometry(s, t, f) iff is-metric-space(s) and is-metric-space(t) and f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) and forall([x in pts(s), y in pts(s)], (dist(t))(f(x), f(y)) = (dist(s))(x, y)))
- `is-k-linear` — forall([m, f], is-k-linear(m, f) iff is-module(m) and f in fun(vec(m), carr(scal(m))) and forall([x in vec(m), y in vec(m)], f((vadd(m))(x, y)) = (add(scal(m)))(f(x), f(y))) and forall([lam in carr(scal(m)), x in vec(m)], f((act(m))(lam, x)) = (mul(scal(m)))(lam, f(x))))

- `is-left-limit` — forall([f, x, l], is-left-limit(f, x, l) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and x in rr and l in rr and forall([eps_], pos-rr(eps_) implies forsome([delta_], pos-rr(delta_) and forall([t_], t_ in rr and x - delta_ <= t_ and t_ < x implies abs(f(t_) - l) <= eps_))))

- `is-linear-functional` — forall([m, f], is-linear-functional(m, f) iff f in fun(vec(m), rr) and forall([x_ in vec(m), y_ in vec(m)], f((vadd(m))(x_, y_)) = f(x_) + f(y_)) and forall([r_ in rr, x_ in vec(m)], f((act(m))(r_, x_)) = r_ * f(x_)))

- `is-linear-map` — forall([m1, m2, tt], is-linear-map(m1, m2, tt) iff is-module(m1) and is-module(m2) and scal(m1) = scal(m2) and tt in fun(vec(m1), vec(m2)) and forall([x in vec(m1), y in vec(m1)], tt((vadd(m1))(x, y)) = (vadd(m2))(tt(x), tt(y))) and forall([lam in carr(scal(m1)), x in vec(m1)], tt((act(m1))(lam, x)) = (act(m2))(lam, tt(x))))
- `is-lipschitz-arrow-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-lipschitz-arrow(a, b, f) iff is-metric-space(a) and is-metric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and forsome([lpk_ in rr], 0 <= lpk_ and forall([lpx_ in pts(a), lpy_ in pts(a)], (dist(b))(f(lpx_), f(lpy_)) <= lpk_ * (dist(a))(lpx_, lpy_))))
- `is-local-max-at` — forall([f, d, lmt_], is-local-max-at(f, d, lmt_) iff f in fun(d, rr) and lmt_ in d and forsome([lma_], pos-rr(lma_) and forall([lmx_ in d], abs(lmx_ - lmt_) <= lma_ implies f(lmx_) <= f(lmt_))))

- `is-maximal` — forall([grd, porel, mx], is-maximal(grd, porel, mx) iff mx in grd and forall([y in grd], [mx, y] in porel implies [y, mx] in porel))
- `is-meager` — forall([s, a], is-meager(s, a) iff is-metric-space(s) and a subset pts(s) and forsome([ee in fun(nn, power(pts(s)))], forall([n in nn], is-nowhere-dense(s, ee(n))) and a subset big-union(n, nn, ee(n))))
- `is-measurable-fn` — forall([omega, ca, f], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) iff is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) and f in fun(omega, rr-pos-star) and forall([alpha_ in rr], {x_ in omega: alpha_ < f(x_)} in ca))
- `is-measurable-map` — forall([omega, ca, omega2, cb, f], is-measurable-map(omega, ca, omega2, cb, f) iff is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) and is-sigma-algebra(omega2, cb) and f in fun(omega, omega2) and forall([b_ in cb], {x_ in omega: f(x_) in b_} in ca))
- `is-measurable-space` — forall([s], is-measurable-space(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and sigma(s) in power(power(pts(s))) and is-sigma-algebra(pts(s), sigma(s)))
- `is-measure` — forall([omega, ca, mu], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) iff is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) and mu in fun(ca, rr-pos-star) and mu(empty-set) = 0 and forall([f_ in fun(nn, ca)], forall([i_, j_], i_ in nn implies j_ in nn implies not(i_ = j_) implies intersection(f_(i_), f_(j_)) = empty-set) implies mu(big-union(n_, nn, f_(n_))) = esum(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, mu(f_(n_))))))
