- `is-ms-sequence` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) iff forall([n in nn], is-metric-space(ms(n))))
- `is-noetherian` — forall([m], is-noetherian(m) iff is-module(m) and forall([f_ in fun(nn, power(vec(m)))], forall([n_ in nn], is-submodule(m, f_(n_))) and forall([n_ in nn], f_(n_) subset f_(succ(n_))) implies forsome([k_ in nn], forall([n_], n_ in nn and k_ <= n_ implies f_(n_) = f_(k_)))))
- `is-nonmeager` — forall([s, a], is-nonmeager(s, a) iff is-metric-space(s) and a subset pts(s) and not(is-meager(s, a)))
- `is-nontrivially-valued` — forall([fld], is-nontrivially-valued(fld) iff is-normed-field(fld) and forsome([c in carr(fld)], 1 < (fnrm(fld))(c) and forsome([b in carr(fld)], (mul(fld))(c, b) = one(fld))))
- `is-norm` — forall([nm, addop, mulop, zr, crr], is-norm(nm, addop, mulop, zr, crr) iff nm in fun(crr, rr) and forall([a in crr], 0 <= nm(a) and (nm(a) = 0 iff a = zr) and forall([b in crr], nm(mulop(a, b)) = nm(a) * nm(b) and nm(addop(a, b)) <= nm(a) + nm(b))))
- `is-normally-convergent` — forall([u, cpsxs_], is-normally-convergent(u, cpsxs_) iff forall([cpsi_ in nn], cc-sup-norm(u(cpsi_), cpsxs_) in rr) and series-converges(vnb-lambda(cpsi_, nn, cc-sup-norm(u(cpsi_), cpsxs_))))
- `is-normed-ag` — forall([s], is-normed-ag(s) iff length(s) = 5 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and iden(s) in carr(s) and inv(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and nrm(s) in fun(carr(s), rr) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(opr(s), iden(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(opr(s), iden(s), inv(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-group-norm(nrm(s), opr(s), inv(s), iden(s), carr(s)))
- `is-normed-field` — forall([s], is-normed-field(s) iff length(s) = 7 and carr(s) in set and add(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and mul(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and neg(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and zero(s) in carr(s) and one(s) in carr(s) and fnrm(s) in fun(carr(s), rr) and is-associative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(add(s), zero(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(add(s), zero(s), neg(s), carr(s)) and is-associative(mul(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(mul(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(mul(s), one(s), carr(s)) and is-distributive(add(s), mul(s), carr(s)) and is-norm(fnrm(s), add(s), mul(s), zero(s), carr(s)) and not(zero(s) = one(s)) and forall([a_ in carr(s)], not(a_ = zero(s)) implies forsome([b_ in carr(s)], not(b_ = zero(s)) and (mul(s))(a_, b_) = one(s))))
- `is-normed-vector-space` — forall([s], is-normed-vector-space(s) iff length(s) = 7 and is-ring(scal(s)) and vec(s) in set and vadd(s) in fun(cartesian(vec(s), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vzero(s) in vec(s) and vneg(s) in fun(vec(s), vec(s)) and act(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(scal(s)), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vnrm(s) in fun(vec(s), rr) and is-associative(vadd(s), vec(s)) and is-commutative(vadd(s), vec(s)) and is-identity(vadd(s), vzero(s), vec(s)) and has-inverses(vadd(s), vzero(s), vneg(s), vec(s)) and scal(s) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], (act(s))(r_, (vadd(s))(x_, y_)) = (vadd(s))((act(s))(r_, x_), (act(s))(r_, y_))) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)], (act(s))((add(scal(s)))(r_, s_), x_) = (vadd(s))((act(s))(r_, x_), (act(s))(s_, x_))) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)], (act(s))((mul(scal(s)))(r_, s_), x_) = (act(s))(r_, (act(s))(s_, x_))) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (act(s))(one(scal(s)), x_) = x_) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], 0 <= (vnrm(s))(x_)) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (vnrm(s))(x_) = 0 iff x_ = vzero(s)) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)], (vnrm(s))((act(s))(r_, x_)) = abs(r_) * (vnrm(s))(x_)) and forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], (vnrm(s))((vadd(s))(x_, y_)) <= (vnrm(s))(x_) + (vnrm(s))(y_)))
- `is-nowhere-dense` — forall([s, a], is-nowhere-dense(s, a) iff is-metric-space(s) and a subset pts(s) and interior(s, closure(s, a)) = empty-set)
- `is-nsl-space` — forall([nlp_], is-nsl-space(nlp_) iff is-pk-space(nlp_) and forall([nli_ in ids(ispace(pk-inf(nlp_)))], nli_ in adv-ids(pk-inf(nlp_)) or forsome([nla_, nlb_, nlm_, nln_], is-init-strand(nlp_, (strand-map(ispace(pk-inf(nlp_))))(nli_), nla_, nlb_, nlm_, nln_)) or forsome([nla_, nlb_, nlm_, nln_], is-resp-strand(nlp_, (strand-map(ispace(pk-inf(nlp_))))(nli_), nla_, nlb_, nlm_, nln_))))
- `is-null-set` — forall([omega, ca, mu, ns], is-null-set(omega, ca, mu, ns) iff forsome([nla_ in ca], ns subset nla_ and mu(nla_) = 0))
- `is-open` — forall([s, u], is-open(s, u) iff is-metric-space(s) and u subset pts(s) and forall([y in u], forsome([r], pos-rr(r) and ball(s, y, r) subset u)))

- `is-open-lin-map` — forall([m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt], is-open-lin-map(m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt) iff is-linear-map(m1, m2, tt) and forall([n in nn, eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n_ in nn, eps_], pos-rr(eps_) and fr-ball(m2, fam2, n_, eps_) subset image(tt, fr-ball(m1, fam1, n, eps)))))
- `is-ord` — forall([x], is-ord(x) iff x in ord)
- `is-orthogonal-projection` — forall([v, ks, pk], is-orthogonal-projection(v, ks, pk) iff pk in fun(vec(v), vec(v)) and forall([opz_ in vec(v)], pk(opz_) in ks and (vadd(v))(opz_, (vneg(v))(pk(opz_))) in perp(v, ks)))
- `is-outer-measure` — forall([omega, mu], is-outer-measure(omega, mu) iff omega in set and mu in fun(power(omega), rr-pos-star) and mu(empty-set) = 0 and forall([a_, b_], a_ in power(omega) implies b_ in power(omega) implies a_ subset b_ implies mu(a_) <= mu(b_)) and forall([f_ in fun(nn, power(omega))], mu(big-union(n_, nn, f_(n_))) <= esum(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, mu(f_(n_))))))
- `is-partial-order` — forall([grd, porel], is-partial-order(grd, porel) iff grd in set and porel in set and forall([x in grd], [x, x] in porel) and forall([x in grd, y in grd], [x, y] in porel and [y, x] in porel implies x = y) and forall([x in grd, y in grd, z in grd], [x, y] in porel and [y, z] in porel implies [x, z] in porel))
- `is-partition` — forall([p, n, a, b], is-partition(p, n, a, b) iff n in nn and 1 <= n and a in rr and b in rr and a < b and p in fun(nn, rr) and p(0) = a and p(n) = b and forall([i_, j_], i_ in interval(0, n) and j_ in interval(0, n) and i_ < j_ implies p(i_) < p(j_)))
- `is-path` — forall([pgam, a, b], is-path(pgam, a, b) iff a in rr and b in rr and a < b and pgam in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) and forall([pax_ in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(a, b)), cc-ms, pgam, pax_)))
- `is-pi-system` — forall([pp], is-pi-system(pp) iff forall([pya_ in pp, pyb_ in pp], intersection(pya_, pyb_) in pp))
- `is-pid-def` — forall([s], is-pid(s) iff is-integral-domain(s) and forall([i], is-ideal(s, i) implies forsome([a in carr(s)], i = principal-ideal(s, a))))
- `is-piecewise-continuous` — forall([f, a, b], is-piecewise-continuous(f, a, b) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and a in rr and b in rr and a < b and forsome([n_, p_], is-partition(p_, n_, a, b) and forall([i_], i_ in interval(0, n_) and i_ < n_ implies forall([t_], t_ in rr and p_(i_) < t_ and t_ < p_(succ(i_)) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, t_)))))
- `is-pk-space` — forall([s], is-pk-space(s) iff length(s) = 3 and is-infiltrated-space(pk-inf(s)) and names(s) in set and pubkey(s) in fun(names(s), keys(ispace(pk-inf(s)))) and forall([nlx_ in names(s)], nlx_ in tokens(ispace(pk-inf(s)))) and forall([nlx_ in names(s)], not(nlx_ in keys(ispace(pk-inf(s))))) and forall([nlx_, nly_], nlx_ in names(s) implies nly_ in names(s) implies (pubkey(s))(nlx_) = (pubkey(s))(nly_) implies nlx_ = nly_))
- `is-positive-functional` — forall([s, lam], is-positive-functional(s, lam) iff lam in fun(cont-fns(s), rr) and forall([pff_ in cont-fns(s), pfg_ in cont-fns(s)], lam(vnb-lambda(sx_, pts(s), pff_(sx_) + pfg_(sx_))) = lam(pff_) + lam(pfg_)) and forall([pfc_ in rr, pff_ in cont-fns(s)], lam(vnb-lambda(sx_, pts(s), pfc_ * pff_(sx_))) = pfc_ * lam(pff_)) and forall([pff_ in cont-fns(s)], forall([pfx_ in pts(s)], 0 <= pff_(pfx_)) implies 0 <= lam(pff_)))
- `is-prec-closed` — forall([spc_, snd_, ssd_, srl_], is-prec-closed(spc_, snd_, ssd_, srl_) iff forall([ssx_, ssy_], [ssx_, ssy_] in ssd_ implies [ssx_, ssy_] in srl_) and forall([ssx_ in snd_, ssy_ in snd_], same-strand-before(spc_, ssx_, ssy_) implies [ssx_, ssy_] in srl_) and forall([ssx_, ssy_, ssz_], [ssx_, ssy_] in srl_ implies [ssy_, ssz_] in srl_ implies [ssx_, ssz_] in srl_))
- `is-premeasure` — forall([omega, cls, pm], is-premeasure(omega, cls, pm) iff omega in set and cls subset power(omega) and empty-set in cls and pm in fun(cls, rr-pos-star) and pm(empty-set) = 0)
- `is-primitive` — forall([rpg_, rpf_, rpa_, rpb_], is-primitive(rpg_, rpf_, rpa_, rpb_) iff rpa_ in rr and rpb_ in rr and rpa_ < rpb_ and rpg_ in fun(ccint(rpa_, rpb_), rr) and rpf_ in fun(ccint(rpa_, rpb_), rr) and is-continuous-on(rpg_, ccint(rpa_, rpb_)) and forsome([rps_], is-countable(rps_) and rps_ subset ccint(rpa_, rpb_) and forall([rpt_ in ooint(rpa_, rpb_)], not(rpt_ in rps_) implies has-deriv-at(rpg_, rpt_, rpf_(rpt_)))))
- `is-pseudometric` — forall([dst, crr], is-pseudometric(dst, crr) iff forall([u in crr], dst(u, u) = 0 and forall([v in crr], 0 <= dst(u, v) and dst(u, v) = dst(v, u) and forall([w in crr], dst(u, w) <= dst(u, v) + dst(v, w)))))
- `is-pseudometric-space` — forall([s], is-pseudometric-space(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and dist(s) in fun(cartesian(pts(s), pts(s)), rr) and is-pseudometric(dist(s), pts(s)))
- `is-ptwise-cauchy` — forall([s, fam], is-ptwise-cauchy(s, fam) iff is-metric-space(s) and fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), rr)) and forall([x in pts(s), eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap in nn], forall([k], k in nn and cap <= k implies forall([l], l in nn and cap <= l implies abs((fam(k))(x) - (fam(l))(x)) < eps)))))
- `is-pw-antiderivable` — forall([pphi_, a, b], is-pw-antiderivable(pphi_, a, b) iff forsome([paw_], is-primitive(paw_, pphi_, a, b)))
- `is-pw-continuous-on` — forall([pphi_, a, b], is-pw-continuous-on(pphi_, a, b) iff a in rr and b in rr and a < b and pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) and forsome([pas_ in set], card(pas_) in nn and pas_ subset ccint(a, b) and forall([pat_ in ooint(a, b)], not(pat_ in pas_) implies is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(a, b)), rr-ms, pphi_, pat_))))
- `is-r-net` — forall([s, f, a, r], is-r-net(s, f, a, r) iff f subset a and forall([p in a], forsome([c in f], (dist(s))(c, p) <= r and not((dist(s))(c, p) = r))))
- `is-real-measurable-fn` — forall([omega, ca, f], is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) iff f in fun(omega, rr) and is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, pos-part(omega, f)) and is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, neg-part(omega, f)))
- `is-received` — forall([ssp_, ssn_], is-received(ssp_, ssn_) iff node-dir(ssp_, ssn_) = received)
- `is-regular-node` — forall([sai_, san_], is-regular-node(sai_, san_) iff not(nth(2, san_) in adv-ids(sai_)))
- `is-regulated` — forall([f, a, b], is-regulated(f, a, b) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and a in rr and b in rr and a < b and forall([x_ in ccint(a, b)], (x_ < b implies forsome([l_], is-right-limit(f, x_, l_))) and (a < x_ implies forsome([l_], is-left-limit(f, x_, l_)))))
- `is-regulated-on` — forall([rpf_, rpa_, rpb_], is-regulated-on(rpf_, rpa_, rpb_) iff rpa_ in rr and rpb_ in rr and rpa_ < rpb_ and rpf_ in fun(ccint(rpa_, rpb_), rr) and forall([rpx_ in ccint(rpa_, rpb_)], rpx_ < rpb_ implies forsome([rpl_], is-right-limit-within(rpf_, ccint(rpa_, rpb_), rpx_, rpl_))) and forall([rpx_ in ccint(rpa_, rpb_)], rpa_ < rpx_ implies forsome([rpl_], is-left-limit-within(rpf_, ccint(rpa_, rpb_), rpx_, rpl_))))
- `is-resp-strand` — forall([nlp_, nls_, nla_, nlb_, nlm_, nln_], is-resp-strand(nlp_, nls_, nla_, nlb_, nlm_, nln_) iff nla_ in names(nlp_) and nlb_ in names(nlp_) and nlm_ in tokens(ispace(pk-inf(nlp_))) and nln_ in tokens(ispace(pk-inf(nlp_))) and not(nln_ in names(nlp_)) and not(nlm_ in keys(ispace(pk-inf(nlp_)))) and not(nln_ in keys(ispace(pk-inf(nlp_)))) and nls_ = [[received, encr(lst([nlm_, nla_]), (pubkey(nlp_))(nlb_))], [sent, encr(lst([nlm_, nln_, nlb_]), (pubkey(nlp_))(nla_))], [received, encr(nln_, (pubkey(nlp_))(nlb_))]])
- `is-right-limit` — forall([f, x, l], is-right-limit(f, x, l) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and x in rr and l in rr and forall([eps_], pos-rr(eps_) implies forsome([delta_], pos-rr(delta_) and forall([t_], t_ in rr and x < t_ and t_ <= x + delta_ implies abs(f(t_) - l) <= eps_))))
- `is-right-limit-within` — forall([rpf_, rpw_, rpx_, rpl_], is-right-limit-within(rpf_, rpw_, rpx_, rpl_) iff rpw_ subset rr and rpf_ in fun(rpw_, rr) and rpx_ in rr and rpl_ in rr and forall([rpe_], pos-rr(rpe_) implies forsome([rpdl_], pos-rr(rpdl_) and forall([rpt_ in rpw_], rpx_ < rpt_ implies rpt_ < rpx_ + rpdl_ implies abs(rpf_(rpt_) - rpl_) < rpe_))))
- `is-ring` — forall([s], is-ring(s) iff length(s) = 6 and carr(s) in set and add(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and mul(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and neg(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and zero(s) in carr(s) and one(s) in carr(s) and is-associative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(add(s), zero(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(add(s), zero(s), neg(s), carr(s)) and is-associative(mul(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(mul(s), one(s), carr(s)) and is-distributive(add(s), mul(s), carr(s)))
- `is-ringoid` — forall([s], is-ringoid(s) iff length(s) = 7 and carr(s) in set and add(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and mul(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and neg(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and zero(s) in carr(s) and one(s) in carr(s) and idl(s) in power(carr(s)) and is-associative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(add(s), zero(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(add(s), zero(s), neg(s), carr(s)) and is-associative(mul(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(mul(s), one(s), carr(s)) and is-distributive(add(s), mul(s), carr(s)) and is-ideal-in(idl(s), carr(s), add(s), mul(s), neg(s), zero(s)))
- `is-road` — forall([pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) iff is-path(pgam, a, b) and dgam in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) and is-regulated-on(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(dgam(pat_))), a, b) and is-regulated-on(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(dgam(pat_))), a, b) and is-primitive(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(pgam(pat_))), vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(dgam(pat_))), a, b) and is-primitive(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(pgam(pat_))), vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(dgam(pat_))), a, b))
- `is-semigroup` — forall([s], is-semigroup(s) iff length(s) = 2 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)))
- `is-seminorm` — forall([fld, m, p], is-seminorm(fld, m, p) iff is-normed-field(fld) and is-module(m) and scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(fld) and p in fun(vec(m), rr) and forall([x in vec(m)], 0 <= p(x)) and forall([x in vec(m), y in vec(m)], p((vadd(m))(x, y)) <= p(x) + p(y)) and forall([lam in carr(scal(m)), x in vec(m)], p((act(m))(lam, x)) = (fnrm(fld))(lam) * p(x)))
- `is-seminorm-family` — forall([fld, m, fam], is-seminorm-family(fld, m, fam) iff is-normed-field(fld) and is-module(m) and scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(fld) and fam in fun(nn, fun(vec(m), rr)) and forall([k in nn], is-seminorm(fld, m, fam(k))) and forall([x in vec(m)], not(x = vzero(m)) implies forsome([k in nn], not((fam(k))(x) = 0))))
- `is-sent` — forall([ssp_, ssn_], is-sent(ssp_, ssn_) iff node-dir(ssp_, ssn_) = sent)
- `is-separable` — forall([s], is-separable(s) iff is-metric-space(s) and forsome([dseq in fun(nn, pts(s))], forall([x in pts(s), eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n in nn], (dist(s))(x, dseq(n)) < eps))))
- `is-separate-trace` — forall([sasp_, sas_], is-separate-trace(sasp_, sas_) iff forsome([sal_ in tuples(msg-set(tokens(sasp_), keys(sasp_)))], length(sas_) = succ(length(sal_)) and nth(1, sas_) = [received, lst(sal_)] and forall([sai_ in nn], 1 <= sai_ implies sai_ <= length(sal_) implies nth(succ(sai_), sas_) = [sent, nth(sai_, sal_)])))
- `is-set` — forall([x], is-set(x) iff x in set)
- `is-setoid` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and rel(s) in power(cartesian(pts(s), pts(s))) and is-equivalence(rel(s), pts(s)))
- `is-sigma-algebra` — forall([omega, ca], is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) iff omega in set and ca subset power(omega) and omega in ca and forall([a_ in ca], complement-in(omega, a_) in ca) and forall([f_ in fun(nn, ca)], big-union(n_, nn, f_(n_)) in ca))
- `is-sigma-finite` — forall([omega, ca, mu], is-sigma-finite(omega, ca, mu) iff forsome([sff_ in fun(nn, ca)], forall([sfn_ in nn], mu(sff_(sfn_)) in rr) and big-union(sfk_, nn, sff_(sfk_)) = omega))
- `is-simple-fn` — forall([omega, ca, f], is-simple-fn(omega, ca, f) iff is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) and card(image(f, omega)) in nn and forall([x_ in omega], f(x_) in rr))
- `is-step-fn` — forall([f, a, b], is-step-fn(f, a, b) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and a in rr and b in rr and a < b and forsome([n_, p_], is-partition(p_, n_, a, b) and forall([i_], i_ in interval(0, n_) and i_ < n_ implies forsome([c_ in rr], forall([t_], t_ in rr and p_(i_) < t_ and t_ < p_(succ(i_)) implies f(t_) = c_)))))
- `is-strand-space` — forall([s], is-strand-space(s) iff length(s) = 5 and tokens(s) in set and ids(s) in set and keys(s) in set and strand-map(s) in fun(ids(s), strands(tokens(s), keys(s))) and kinv(s) in fun(keys(s), keys(s)) and is-token-set(tokens(s)) and forall([ssx_ in keys(s)], ssx_ in tokens(s)) and forall([ssx_ in keys(s)], (kinv(s))((kinv(s))(ssx_)) = ssx_))
- `is-strictly-below` — forall([porel, x, y], is-strictly-below(porel, x, y) iff [x, y] in porel and not([y, x] in porel))
- `is-strictly-increasing-on` — forall([f, s], is-strictly-increasing-on(f, s) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and s subset rr and forall([u in s, v in s], u < v implies f(u) < f(v)))
- `is-sublinear` — forall([m, p], is-sublinear(m, p) iff p in fun(vec(m), rr) and forall([hsx_ in vec(m), hsy_ in vec(m)], p((vadd(m))(hsx_, hsy_)) <= p(hsx_) + p(hsy_)) and forall([hst_ in rr], 0 <= hst_ implies forall([hsx_ in vec(m)], p((act(m))(hst_, hsx_)) = hst_ * p(hsx_))))
- `is-submodule` — forall([m, s], is-submodule(m, s) iff s subset vec(m) and vzero(m) in s and forall([x_ in s, y_ in s], (vadd(m))(x_, y_) in s) and forall([x_ in s], (vneg(m))(x_) in s) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(m)), x_ in s], (act(m))(r_, x_) in s))
- `is-subsequence` — forall([s, y, f], is-subsequence(s, y, f) iff f in fun(nn, pts(s)) and forsome([phi], strictly-mono-nn(phi) and y = subseq(f, phi)))
- `is-subspace` — forall([m, s], is-subspace(m, s) iff is-submodule(m, s))
- `is-subterm` — forall([smt_, smk_, sma_, smb_], is-subterm(smt_, smk_, sma_, smb_) iff [sma_, smb_] in subterm-rel(smt_, smk_))
- `is-subterm-closed` — forall([smt_, smk_, smr_], is-subterm-closed(smt_, smk_, smr_) iff forall([sma_ in msg-set(smt_, smk_)], [sma_, sma_] in smr_) and forall([sma_, sml_, smi_], sml_ in tuples(msg-set(smt_, smk_)) implies smi_ in nn implies 1 <= smi_ implies smi_ <= length(sml_) implies [sma_, nth(smi_, sml_)] in smr_ implies [sma_, lst(sml_)] in smr_) and forall([sma_, smg_, smy_], smg_ in msg-set(smt_, smk_) implies smy_ in smk_ implies [sma_, smg_] in smr_ implies [sma_, encr(smg_, smy_)] in smr_))
- `is-summable` — forall([grp, f], is-summable(grp, f) iff forsome([r in carr(grp)], sums-to(grp, f, r)))
- `is-taylor-family` — forall([d, n, a, b], is-taylor-family(d, n, a, b) iff n in nn and 1 <= n and a in rr and b in rr and a < b and d(n) in fun(ooint(a, b), rr) and forall([tk_ in nn], tk_ < n implies d(tk_) in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) and is-continuous-on(d(tk_), ccint(a, b)) and forall([tx_ in ooint(a, b)], has-deriv-at(d(tk_), tx_, (d(succ(tk_)))(tx_)))))
- `is-tee-trace` — forall([sasp_, sas_], is-tee-trace(sasp_, sas_) iff forsome([sag_ in msg-set(tokens(sasp_), keys(sasp_))], sas_ = [[received, sag_], [sent, sag_], [sent, sag_]]))
- `is-text-trace` — forall([sasp_, sap_, sas_], is-text-trace(sasp_, sap_, sas_) iff forsome([saa_ in sap_], sas_ = [[sent, saa_]]))
- `is-token-set` — forall([smt_], is-token-set(smt_) iff smt_ in set and forall([smx_ in smt_], not(smx_ in tuples(set))))
- `is-top-space` — forall([s], is-top-space(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and opens(s) in power(power(pts(s))) and empty-set in opens(s) and pts(s) in opens(s) and forall([u in opens(s), v in opens(s)], intersection(u, v) in opens(s)) and forall([fam], fam subset opens(s) implies big-union(u, fam, u) in opens(s)))
- `is-unif-cauchy` — forall([s, fam], is-unif-cauchy(s, fam) iff is-metric-space(s) and fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), rr)) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap in nn], forall([k], k in nn and cap <= k implies forall([l], l in nn and cap <= l implies forall([x in pts(s)], abs((fam(k))(x) - (fam(l))(x)) < eps))))))
- `is-unif-limit-on` — forall([fam, g, a, b], is-unif-limit-on(fam, g, a, b) iff fam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr)) and g in fun(rr, rr) and a in rr and b in rr and a < b and forall([eps_], pos-rr(eps_) implies forsome([n_ in nn], forall([k_], k_ in nn and n_ <= k_ implies forall([x_ in ccint(a, b)], abs(g(x_) - (fam(k_))(x_)) <= eps_)))))
- `is-uniformly-continuous` — forall([s, t, f], is-uniformly-continuous(s, t, f) iff is-metric-space(s) and is-metric-space(t) and f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([delta], pos-rr(delta) and forall([a in pts(s), b in pts(s)], (dist(s))(a, b) <= delta implies (dist(t))(f(a), f(b)) <= eps))))
- `is-uniformly-continuous-arrow-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-uniformly-continuous-arrow(a, b, f) iff is-metric-space(a) and is-metric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and is-uniformly-continuous(a, b, f))
- `is-upper-bound` — forall([grd, porel, ch, b], is-upper-bound(grd, porel, ch, b) iff b in grd and forall([x in ch], [x, b] in porel))
- `is-vector-space-def` — forall([s], is-vector-space(s) iff is-module(s) and is-field-ring(scal(s)))
- `keep-set-membership` — forall([phi, grd, porel, kset, alpha, y_], y_ in keep-set(phi, grd, porel, kset, alpha) iff y_ in grd and y_ = phi(alpha) and forall([z in kset], [z, y_] in porel))
- `lastcoeff-set-membership` — forall([md, p, u, sm, r_], r_ in lastcoeff-set(md, p, u, sm) iff r_ in carr(scal(md)) and forsome([c_ in mat(1, succ(p), carr(scal(md)))], entry(c_, 1, succ(p)) = r_ and lincomb(md, succ(p), c_, u) in sm))
- `lcd-stage-succ` — forall([mxn_ in nn], lcd-stage(succ(mxn_)) == vnb-lambda(mxe_, expr-stage(succ(mxn_)), if(mxe_ in expr-stage(mxn_), (lcd-stage(mxn_))(mxe_), if(nth(1, mxe_) = 3, {mxd_ in nn: forall([mxw_ in make-set(nth(3, mxe_))], mxd_ in (lcd-stage(mxn_))(mxw_))}, {mxd_ in nn: forall([mxw_ in make-set(nth(4, mxe_))], mxd_ in (lcd-stage(mxn_))(mxw_)) and mxd_ + nth(3, mxe_) in (lcd-stage(mxn_))(nth(5, mxe_))}))))
- `lcd-stage-zero` — lcd-stage(0) == vnb-lambda(mxe_, expr-stage(0), if(nth(1, mxe_) = 1, {mxd_ in nn: nth(2, mxe_) < mxd_}, nn))

- `qq-ring@neg` — neg(qq-ring) == vnb-lambda(x_, qq, -x_)

- `ring-add-assoc` — forall([s], is-ring(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (add(s))((add(s))(a, b), c) = (add(s))(a, (add(s))(b, c))))
- `ring-add-assoc-ringoid-as-ring` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies forall([a in carr(r), b in carr(r), c in carr(r)], (add(r))((add(r))(a, b), c) = (add(r))(a, (add(r))(b, c))))
- `ring-add-comm` — forall([s], is-ring(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s)], (add(s))(a, b) = (add(s))(b, a)))
- `ring-add-comm-ringoid-as-ring` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies forall([a in carr(r), b in carr(r)], (add(r))(a, b) = (add(r))(b, a)))
- `ring-add-left-id` — forall([s], is-ring(s) implies forall([a in carr(s)], (add(s))(zero(s), a) = a))
- `ring-add-left-id-ringoid-as-ring` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies forall([a in carr(r)], (add(r))(zero(r), a) = a))
- `ring-add-left-inv` — forall([s], is-ring(s) implies forall([a in carr(s)], (add(s))((neg(s))(a), a) = zero(s)))
- `ring-add-left-inv-ringoid-as-ring` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies forall([a in carr(r)], (add(r))((neg(r))(a), a) = zero(r)))
- `ring-additive-ag-is-abelian-group` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies is-abelian-group(ring-additive-ag(r)))
- `ring-carrier-closed-add` — forall([r, a, b], is-ring(r) and a in carr(r) and b in carr(r) implies (add(r))(a, b) in carr(r))
- `ring-class` — forall([s], s in ring iff is-ring(s))
- `ring-left-dist` — forall([s], is-ring(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (mul(s))(a, (add(s))(b, c)) = (add(s))((mul(s))(a, b), (mul(s))(a, c))))
- `ring-left-dist-ringoid-as-ring` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies forall([a in carr(r), b in carr(r), c in carr(r)], (mul(r))(a, (add(r))(b, c)) = (add(r))((mul(r))(a, b), (mul(r))(a, c))))
- `ring-mul-assoc` — forall([s], is-ring(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (mul(s))((mul(s))(a, b), c) = (mul(s))(a, (mul(s))(b, c))))
- `ring-mul-assoc-ringoid-as-ring` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies forall([a in carr(r), b in carr(r), c in carr(r)], (mul(r))((mul(r))(a, b), c) = (mul(r))(a, (mul(r))(b, c))))
- `ring-mul-left-id` — forall([s], is-ring(s) implies forall([a in carr(s)], (mul(s))(one(s), a) = a))
- `ring-mul-left-id-ringoid-as-ring` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies forall([a in carr(r)], (mul(r))(one(r), a) = a))
- `ring-mul-right-id` — forall([s], is-ring(s) implies forall([a in carr(s)], (mul(s))(a, one(s)) = a))
- `ring-mul-right-id-ringoid-as-ring` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies forall([a in carr(r)], (mul(r))(a, one(r)) = a))
- `ring-multiplicative-monoid-is-monoid` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies is-monoid(ring-multiplicative-monoid(r)))
- `ring-prod-n-succ` — forall([f, n in nn], ring-prod-n(f, succ(n)) == ring-prod(ring-prod-n(f, n), f(n)))
- `ring-prod-n-zero` — forall([f], ring-prod-n(f, 0) == zero-ring)
- `ring-right-dist` — forall([s], is-ring(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (mul(s))((add(s))(a, b), c) = (add(s))((mul(s))(a, c), (mul(s))(b, c))))
- `ring-right-dist-ringoid-as-ring` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies forall([a in carr(r), b in carr(r), c in carr(r)], (mul(r))((add(r))(a, b), c) = (add(r))((mul(r))(a, c), (mul(r))(b, c))))
- `ring-zero-in` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies zero(r) in carr(r))
- `ring-zero-in-ringoid-as-ring` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies zero(r) in carr(r))
- `ringoid-add-right-inv` — forall([r, a], is-ringoid(r) implies a in carr(r) implies (add(r))(a, (neg(r))(a)) = zero(r))
- `ringoid-as-ring-is-ring` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies is-ring(ringoid-as-ring(r)))
- `ringoid-carr-in-set` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies carr(r) in set)
- `ringoid-class` — forall([s], s in ringoid iff is-ringoid(s))
- `ringoid-ideal-add` — forall([r, a, b], is-ringoid(r) implies a in idl(r) implies b in idl(r) implies (add(r))(a, b) in idl(r))
- `ringoid-ideal-mul-left` — forall([r, x_, a], is-ringoid(r) implies x_ in carr(r) implies a in idl(r) implies (mul(r))(x_, a) in idl(r))
- `ringoid-ideal-mul-right` — forall([r, a, x_], is-ringoid(r) implies a in idl(r) implies x_ in carr(r) implies (mul(r))(a, x_) in idl(r))
- `ringoid-ideal-neg` — forall([r, a], is-ringoid(r) implies a in idl(r) implies (neg(r))(a) in idl(r))
- `ringoid-ideal-subset` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies idl(r) subset carr(r))
- `ringoid-ideal-zero` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies zero(r) in idl(r))
- `ringoid-rel-mem` — forall([r, a, b], [a, b] in ringoid-rel(r) iff [a, b] in cartesian(carr(r), carr(r)) and (add(r))(a, (neg(r))(b)) in idl(r))
- `ringoid-setoid-pts` — forall([r], pts(ringoid-setoid(r)) == carr(r))
- `rm-address` — forall([s, dseq, es, y], rm-address(s, dseq, es, y) iff y in pts(s) and forall([ran_ in nn], (es(ran_) = 1 implies y in rm-ball(s, dseq, ran_)) and (not(es(ran_) = 1) implies y in rm-shell(s, dseq, ran_))))
- `rm-address-below` — forall([s, dseq, es, nb, y], rm-address-below(s, dseq, es, nb, y) iff y in pts(s) and forall([rbn_ in nn], rbn_ < nb implies (es(rbn_) = 1 implies y in rm-ball(s, dseq, rbn_)) and (not(es(rbn_) = 1) implies y in rm-shell(s, dseq, rbn_))))
- `rm-realizes` — forall([s, dseq, es, nb, y], rm-realizes(s, dseq, es, nb, y) iff y in pts(s) and forall([rri_ in nn], rri_ < nb implies y in rm-ball(s, dseq, rri_) iff es(rri_) = 1))
- `rm-two-def` — rm-two == pair(0, 1)
- `rm-two-ms-def` — rm-two-ms == subspace-ms(rr-ms, rm-two)
- `rpow-def` — forall([a_, b_], rpow(a_, b_) == rpow-star(a_, b_))
- `rq-add` — forall([r], add(ringoid-quotient-ring(r)) == descend2(ringoid-setoid(r), vnb-lambda([a, b], cartesian(carr(r), carr(r)), class(ringoid-setoid(r), (add(r))(a, b)))))
- `rq-carr` — forall([r], carr(ringoid-quotient-ring(r)) == quotient(ringoid-setoid(r)))
- `rq-mul` — forall([r], mul(ringoid-quotient-ring(r)) == descend2(ringoid-setoid(r), vnb-lambda([a, b], cartesian(carr(r), carr(r)), class(ringoid-setoid(r), (mul(r))(a, b)))))
- `rq-neg` — forall([r], neg(ringoid-quotient-ring(r)) == descend(ringoid-setoid(r), vnb-lambda(a, carr(r), class(ringoid-setoid(r), (neg(r))(a)))))
- `rq-one` — forall([r], one(ringoid-quotient-ring(r)) == class(ringoid-setoid(r), one(r)))
- `rq-zero` — forall([r], zero(ringoid-quotient-ring(r)) == class(ringoid-setoid(r), zero(r)))
- `rr-abs-def` — forall([x in rr], (0 <= x implies abs(x) = x) and (not(0 <= x) implies abs(x) = -x))
- `rr-bounded-above` — forall([s], rr-bounded-above(s) iff forsome([b], rr-upper-bound(s, b)))
- `rr-bounded-ms-def` — rr-bounded-ms == bdd-metric(rr-ms)
- `rr-max-def` — forall([x in rr, y in rr], (y <= x implies max(x, y) = x) and (not(y <= x) implies max(x, y) = y))
- `rr-min-def` — forall([x in rr, y in rr], (x <= y implies min(x, y) = x) and (not(x <= y) implies min(x, y) = y))
- `rr-ms-def` — rr-ms = [rr, vnb-lambda([x, y], cartesian(rr, rr), abs(x - y))]
- `rr-ms@dist` — dist(rr-ms) == vnb-lambda([x, y], cartesian(rr, rr), abs(x - y))
- `rr-ms@pts` — pts(rr-ms) == rr
- `rr-normed-field-def` — rr-normed-field = [rr, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ + y_), vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ * y_), vnb-lambda(x_, rr, -x_), 0, 1, vnb-lambda(x_, rr, abs(x_))]
- `rr-normed-field@add` — add(rr-normed-field) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr, rr), x_ + y_)
